english: And you want me to listen to you? No. Begone.
translation: 而你想让我听你的？不。滚开。

english: You can walk away whenever you want.
translation: 你随时都可以走开。

english: In the trees.
translation: 在树上。

english: The Record Keeper looks through the book.
translation: 记录保管员翻阅着那本书。

english: Okay, thanks. I think I'll give that a go.
translation: 好的，谢谢。我想我会试一试。

english: Bark bark
translation: 汪汪

english: No! No kill friend Smorks!
translation: 不！不许杀朋友斯莫克斯！

english: But belief, sadly, won't help keep us open.
translation: 但遗憾的是，光靠信念无法让我们继续经营下去。

english: Emir's Arena.
translation: 埃米尔竞技场。

english: Well never mind, it's Fluffs loss.
translation: 算了别在意，那是弗拉夫的损失。

english: It's a collection of poems believed to be from the Second Age.
translation: 这是一本诗集，据信来自第二纪元。

english: I'm inclined to believe that's a no. Any clue where they could be?
translation: 我倾向于认为那是个“不”。你知道它们可能在哪里吗？

english: This... is enough...
translation: 这……已经够了……

english: No crab is coming out of the tree. Maybe they are too scared?
translation: 没有蟹从树上出来。也许它们太害怕了？

english: You saw your opportunity and took it well!
translation: 你看到了机会，并且很好地把握住了！

english: There are 4 mirrors and 1 crystal in the tray...
translation: 托盘里有4面镜子和1块水晶……

english: My power should be sufficient without her!
translation: 没有她，我的力量也应该足够了！

english: Let's make this quick, I have wandering to do.
translation: 我们快点吧，我还有地方要逛。

english: Please, [player name], walk the castle grounds with us. Regale us with the tale of how you came into possession of this relic.
translation: 求你了，[player name]，和我们一起在城堡庭院里走走吧。给我们讲讲你是如何得到这件遗物的故事。

english: Which union?
translation: 哪个工会？

english: Well, why didn't you say so?
translation: 那你为什么不早说？

english: Your Robe bottoms of the Eye (blue) has been reverted.
translation: 你的眼之长袍下装 (蓝) 已恢复原样。

english: Here are all the items that I was holding for you.
translation: 这是我为你保管的所有物品。

english: Do you need a breather yet?
translation: 你需要喘口气了吗？

english: Great, great.
translation: 很好，很好。

english: Meow-llo there.
translation: 喵——你好啊。

english: I'm a master of survival and an esteemed hunter. Specifically, I very much know a thing or two about surviving the Wilderness.
translation: 我是生存大师，也是一位受人尊敬的猎人。具体来说，我对在荒野中生存颇有心得。

english: Pizza Delivery!
translation: 披萨外卖！

english: You there! [player name]! Stand and deliver!
translation: 你！[player name]！站住，把东西交出来！

english: Ah, yes, the Banjo. He named it himself.
translation: 啊，是的，班卓。他自己取的名字。

english: I shouldn't be going around terrifying children without good reason.
translation: 我不该没有正当理由就到处吓唬儿童。

english: Hello, adventurer! How can I help you today?
translation: 你好，冒险者！今天我能帮你什么忙？

english: You pull the lever but nothing happens. Maybe it's broken.
translation: 你拉动拉杆，但什么也没发生。也许它坏了。

english: The headache from drinking from the bottle stops you from remembering how to teleport. Drinking from the bottle again may help with this.
translation: 喝下瓶子里的东西引起的头痛让你想不起如何传送。再喝一口瓶子里的东西可能会有所帮助。

english: The guard is standing watch and doesn't have time to chat.
translation: 守卫正在站岗，没时间闲聊。

english: So are you going to pay up then? You owe me 25 gold coins!
translation: 那你打算付钱了吗？你欠我 25 枚金币！

english: I've done enough talking. I'll wait here.
translation: 我已经说得够多了。我会在这里等着。

english: Vampyrium sure is dangerous...
translation: 瓦姆皮利姆确实很危险……

english: Yes, Master!
translation: 是的，主人！

english: Me certain of this one.
translation: 我确定是这个。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之长袍上衣重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: That's great news! Do tell.
translation: 那真是好消息！快告诉我。

english: Sounds like you agree! So you'll do it?
translation: 听起来你同意了！那你会去做吗？

english: I'm sure I can also rustle up some payment to encourage you, if you have any reservations.
translation: 如果你有任何顾虑，我相信我也能凑出一些报酬来鼓励你。

english: Well, then we'll have to just speed things along a bit. I'm going out there!
translation: 好吧，那我们只能加快点进度了。我要出去了！

english: Leaving me so soon?
translation: 这么快就要离开我？

english: You see some text scrolled above the altar on a symbol: Legs of giant frog and a cave eel uncooked...
translation: 你看到祭坛上方一个符号上滚动着一些文字：巨蛙的腿和一条未烹煮的洞穴鳗……

english: Always start on the right foot!
translation: 永远从右脚开始！

english: Well, I suppose that will have to be enough. You've not taken us down too many wrong paths today...
translation: 好吧，我想这就够了。你今天没带我们走太多错路……

english: ...Yes, Al Kharid. Now, to the south of Al Kharid there is a passageway, it is called the...
translation: ……是的，阿尔卡里德城。现在，阿尔卡里德城以南有一条通道，它叫做……

english: But he has a cool new instrument for himself and a collection of nice shells for other leaders.
translation: 但他给自己弄了一件很酷的新乐器，还给其他首领收集了一些漂亮的贝壳。

english: I considered being a cleric myself, but it doesn't pay well.
translation: 我自己也考虑过当牧师，但报酬不高。

english: You catch a weathered rosewood plank.
translation: 你接住了一块风化的玫瑰木木板。

english: Gate Keeper
translation: 守门人

english: Arrg!
translation: 阿格！

english: I look forward those challenges after work...
translation: 我期待下班后的那些挑战……

english: I'm pretty sure that means yes at this point.
translation: 到这个时候，我很确定那表示同意。

english: Yop yop!
translation: 哟普哟普！

english: Don't come back!
translation: 别再回来！

english: Yarr! This be no place fer an honest pirate!
translation: 呀哈！这可不是诚实的海盗该待的地方！

english: You like to hunt, are familiar with the Wilderness and want me to follow you... This seems rather suspicious Pete.
translation: 你喜欢狩猎，熟悉荒野，还想让我跟着你……这看起来相当可疑，皮特。

english: Where Grubfoot? Me need break.
translation: 格拉布福特在哪？我需要休息。

english: If you don't feed it, it will die.
translation: 如果你不喂它，它会死的。

english: That is a question that only my master could truly answer. What I can tell you is that it is one of a select few items that holds a power beyond even the gods.
translation: 这个问题只有我的主人才能真正回答。我能告诉你的是，它是少数几件拥有超越众神之力的物品之一。

english: Hello and welcome to my humble abode. It's sadly rather more humble than I'd like, to be honest.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到我简陋的住所。说实话，它比我希望的还要简陋得多。

english: So how are you doing getting me my perfect gold jewellery?
translation: 那么，你为我寻找完美金首饰的事进展如何？

english: This Wartface's fault.
translation: 这是疣脸的错。

english: And by 'we' you mean me?
translation: 你说的“我们”是指我吗？

english: Yo! This tune is going to be so good, I'm going to regret not being able to dance it.
translation: 哟！这首曲子会非常棒，我会后悔不能跟着它跳舞。

english: I'd like to help you, but...
translation: 我很想帮你，但是……

english: He must die!
translation: 他必须死！

english: Row to the barge and travel to the Digsite.
translation: 划船到驳船，然后前往挖掘场。

english: You need a raw cave eel to do that.
translation: 你需要一条生洞穴鳗才能这样做。

english: Overwhelming force? A good choice.
translation: 压倒性的力量？好选择。

english: I found the horn within the inner vault, Your Majesty. After defeating Guthix's corrupt guardian.
translation: 我在内金库中找到了号角，陛下。在击败了古斯吉克斯的腐化守护者之后。

english: : Ah, hello there, laddie! Did ye know that your little farmin' patch there is the exact spot where I once buried an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: ：啊，你好啊，小伙子！你知道你那块小农田正是我曾经埋下一个旧宝箱的确切地点吗。

english: No, no, no! Its just a coincidence. Err, I spend my time trading rope. Yes that's right. I'm a rope trader and I just happen to have my wares on me.
translation: 不，不，不！这只是巧合。呃，我平时做绳子生意。对，没错。我是个绳子商人，只是碰巧随身带着货物。

english: Indeed. Before he left, Armacus informed me you would clear the way whilst he and the others mobilised the rest of the troops.
translation: 确实。在他离开之前，阿玛库斯告诉我，你会负责清出一条路，而他和其余人会动员剩下的部队。

english: Are you there, Mistress [player name]?
translation: 你在吗，女主人[player name]？

english: The crab starts sketching on the bark of his tree.
translation: 这只蟹开始在他的树皮上写写画画。

english: I can blow bubbles.
translation: 我会吹气泡。

english: Nigel adds a trim to your Imbued ancient cape.
translation: 奈杰尔为你的灌注远古披风添加了装饰。

english: Human got needle?
translation: 人类有针吗？

english: Speak to me when you're ready to call it a day.
translation: 等你准备收工时再来找我。

english: However, thanks to Lucien, it is now at risk. His followers are preparing to attack the Archive. Not only that, but it seems various other groups are also mobilising their forces.
translation: 然而，多亏了卢西安，它现在岌岌可危。他的追随者正准备袭击档案馆。不仅如此，似乎其他几个团体也在动员他们的力量。

english: Are the girls joining soon?
translation: 姑娘们很快也会加入吗？

english: Take cleaning kit?
translation: 拿走清洁工具包？

english: We're not sure. The defence has been a success. Only a small number of enemies remain for us to deal with. We were preparing to do just that when we heard a disturbance coming from within the inner vault.
translation: 我们也不确定。防御很成功。只剩下少量敌人需要我们处理。我们正准备动手时，听到内金库传来一阵骚动。

english: If you can change your weapon and special attack at the same time, they will struggle to change their prayers in time.
translation: 如果你能同时更换武器和战技，他们将难以及时切换祈祷。

english: What if I'm currently dreaming? I won't get to keep anything I find. It's not worth it.
translation: 如果我现在正在做梦呢？我找到的任何东西都带不走。这不值得。

english: If you know of Ocellus, Ivy, then perhaps you are familiar with this blade as well?
translation: 如果你知道Ocellus，Ivy，那么也许你也熟悉这把刀片？

english: [player name] is my favourite hero!
translation: [player name]是我最喜欢的英雄！

english: Wheeee!
translation: 呜呼！

english: No, normally she's very friendly, although we haven't seen her for a few weeks...
translation: 不，她平时非常友好，虽然我们已经好几周没见过她了……

english: You have increased your hard clue scroll cap! You can now carry 3 hard clue scrolls and scroll boxes.
translation: 你的困难线索卷轴上限提高了！你现在可以携带3个困难线索卷轴和卷轴盒。

english: I'm one of the Varrock guards. We've grown fond of this old girl.
translation: 我是维洛克城的守卫之一。我们渐渐喜欢上了这个老姑娘。

english: Our current predicament is evidence enough of that.
translation: 我们目前的困境就是充分的证据。

english: What would you need to keep the shelter open?
translation: 你需要什么才能让收容所继续开放？

english: Another 3 boxes should do the trick.
translation: 再来3个盒子应该就够了。

english: Let's go over there where it's a bit less crowded.
translation: 我们去那边吧，那里人少一点。

english: Well maybe I could help with that?
translation: 也许我能帮上忙？

english: Bork crush now!
translation: Bork现在要砸碎！

english: We are still recovering from our losses... but our enemies are not affording us much time. The opening of the Archive is taking its toll.
translation: 我们仍在从损失中恢复……但敌人不给我们多少时间。档案馆的开启正在造成损失。

english: I think I'm starting to understand what's got you so upset.
translation: 我想我开始明白是什么让你这么难过了。

english: AAARRGGH!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！

english: Gertrude.
translation: 格特鲁德。

english: The problem is we keep giving it away! There'll be nothing left!
translation: 问题是我们一直在往外送！最后会什么都不剩的！

english: Relatives.
translation: 亲戚。

english: Blink here thinks he's unbeatable. Use the Armadyl godsword special attack, quickly switch to the granite maul, then use its special attack. That will show him.
translation: Blink这家伙自以为天下无敌。使用阿玛杜尔神剑的战技，迅速切换到花岗岩锤，然后使用它的战技。这就能让他见识见识。

english: This is so fun!
translation: 这太好玩了！

english: This one moves a lot like I do...
translation: 这家伙的动作跟我很像……

english: So fascinating! Your carapace here seems to be very different from that of your upper limbs. Can I take a few measurements?
translation: 太迷人了！你这里的甲壳似乎与上肢的甲壳大不相同。我能做几项测量吗？

english: We must mount a defence. We have discovered an entrance that we can use to take a central position, but our enemies are many and we will need all of the help we can get. The Alliance between Crux Eqal, the Temple Knights, and the Guardians of Armadyl is formally calling upon your aid once more. Please, find us in the caverns beneath Lumbridge.
translation: 我们必须组织防御。我们发现了一个入口，可以利用它占据中心位置，但敌人众多，我们需要一切能得到的帮助。Crux Eqal、圣殿骑士和Armadyl守护者之间的联盟再次正式请求你的援助。请到仑桥镇下方的洞穴中找我们。

english: Aaaah... say no more, friend. I have some in specially.
translation: 啊……不用多说了，朋友。我特意留了一些。

english: I think I saw her heading towards her den, north of the Apothecary.
translation: 我想我看到她朝她的巢穴去了，就在药剂师北边。

english: Reports on which of the two gangs ended up in possession of the Shield of Arrav were inconsistent, so the location of the shield is now sadly unknown. However, King Roald III has recently declared that the reward for its return still stands.
translation: 关于两个帮派中哪一个最终拥有阿拉夫之盾的报告前后矛盾，因此盾牌的下落如今已无从知晓。不过，罗尔德国王三世最近宣布，归还盾牌的赏金依然有效。

english: Would you like a candy apple?
translation: 你想要一个糖果苹果吗？

english: No, I want to talk about something else.
translation: 不，我想聊点别的。

english: You successfully dye your Robe top of the Eye (green).
translation: 你成功为你的眼之长袍上衣 (绿) 染色。

english: Can I interest you in some double glazing?
translation: 我能向你推荐一些双层玻璃吗？

english: Surely it can't be so...
translation: 这不可能吧……

english: For example, here in Fortis, you'll find yourself surrounded by Perican architecture, whereas over in the Tlati Rainforest, the influence of the Talkasti remains clear.
translation: 比如说，在福蒂斯这里，你会发现自己被佩里坎建筑所环绕，而在特拉蒂雨林那边，塔卡斯蒂的影响依然清晰可见。

english: Why did you steal these puppies? You need to give them back.
translation: 你为什么要偷这些小狗？你得把它们还回去。

english: Heave to, mister [player name]!
translation: 停船，先生[player name]！

english: Easy girl! Calm down!
translation: 放松点，姑娘！冷静下来！

english: The Alliance has come together nicely.
translation: 联盟已经顺利集结起来了。

english: Wait, wait! Could I make you something?
translation: 等等，等等！我能给你做点什么吗？

english: Revert your Robe bottoms of the Eye (green)?
translation: 要还原你的眼之长袍下装 (绿) 吗？

english: It is never said exactly what it was he was tasked with, but the stories call him the Guardian of Ascension.
translation: 从未有人确切说过他受命做什么，但传说称他为飞升守护者。

english: You fill the bowl with hot lava.
translation: 你把碗装满了炽热的熔岩。

english: Start the A Ruff Situation quest?
translation: 开始“A Ruff Situation”任务吗？

english: OK! I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的！我很快就回来。

english: A string instrument. The string vibrates and makes a sound.
translation: 一种弦乐器。琴弦振动就会发出声音。

english: No... You escaped us!
translation: 不……你们逃掉了！

english: Something tells me that I shouldn't take advice from you.
translation: 直觉告诉我，我不该听你的建议。

english: As easy as a troll.
translation: 像巨魔一样简单。

english: It's a bass!
translation: 这是一条鲈鱼！

english: And what do you make of it?
translation: 那你对此怎么看？

english: Human find goblins dog that no need all that... extra stuff, then goblins give human this useless dog.
translation: 人类找到哥布林狗，不需要那些……多余的东西，然后哥布林给人类这只没用的狗。

english: This should give me a tenth life!
translation: 这应该能给我第十条命！

english: Now just in case, I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allow you carry out this task with some element of safety.
translation: 现在以防万一，我要对你施一个法术，让你能在一定程度上安全地完成这项任务。

english: We're fresh out of crossbows, but apparently they have plenty. If someone were to acquire a couple for us, it would be very much appreciated.
translation: 我们的弩已经用完了，但据说他们有很多。如果有人能为我们弄到几把，那就太感谢了。

english: One fewer tower full of wizards.
translation: 又少了一座满是魔法师的塔。

english: Human not survive long in village if goblin.
translation: 如果哥布林，人类在村庄活不久。

english: You smash the barrel open.
translation: 你把木桶砸开了。

english: Can you make one that makes a nice deep sound with what you find around here? There's rubbish over there floating in the sea.
translation: 你能用这附近找到的东西做一个发出好听低沉声音的吗？那边海面上漂着些垃圾。

english: How do I look?
translation: 我看起来怎么样？

english: You find nothing of interest inside the chest.
translation: 你在宝箱里没有找到任何有趣的东西。

english: First up, a Saradominist knight seems intent on raiding the Archive. We've tried to convince him we fight for the same thing, but to no avail.
translation: 首先，一名萨拉多明骑士似乎执意要袭击档案馆。我们试图让他相信我们为同一目标而战，但无济于事。

english: Well done! Now your opponent will start to change their gear and prayer. Make sure you switch to the correct gear to counter that when attacking them.
translation: 干得好！现在你的对手会开始更换装备和祈祷。攻击他们时，确保切换到正确的装备来克制。

english: Okay, I think I can make something better for you.
translation: 好，我想我能给你做个更好的。

english: Caleb hands over his crest piece to you again.
translation: 迦勒再次把他的纹章碎片交给了你。

english: Would you sign this oak longbow for me?
translation: 你能帮我在这把橡木长弓上签名吗？

english: The Corgi heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 柯基犬前往狗收容所。

english: Indeed... Your exploits are most impressive, [player name].
translation: 确实……你的功绩令人印象深刻，[player name]。

english: Even Grubfoot see that coming, and Grubfoot stupid!
translation: 连格拉布福特都看出来了，而格拉布福特很笨！

english: Go on then, make a move. Ain't got all day... I suppose you're trying that new skill everyone's been blabbering about on Tutorial Island.
translation: 那就来吧，走一步。我可没一整天……我猜你是在试那个大家都在教学岛上唠叨的新技能吧。

english: Not really. The only reason I have come up with to date is that by keeping the station open, people will become familiar with it.
translation: 不完全是。我至今想出的唯一理由是，让这个站点保持开放，人们就会熟悉它。

english: We get you next time!
translation: 下次再收拾你！

english: Wintertodt Camp.
translation: 寒冬营地。

english: I wonder what that was all about?
translation: 我想知道那到底是怎么回事？

english: With a religion as large as Saradominism, a few bad apples are inevitable. We make efforts to deal with a lot of them, but those victories are rarely seen by those outside the faith.
translation: 对于像萨拉多明教这样庞大的宗教来说，几个害群之马是不可避免的。我们努力处理其中许多，但那些胜利很少被信仰之外的人看到。

english: Oh you are strong, aren't you?
translation: 哦，你很强，不是吗？

english: Answer this question: How often do we witness super-ceremonies?
translation: 回答这个问题：我们多久能见证一次超级仪式？

english: So soon? Would you mind if I tagged along? For science?
translation: 这么快？你介意我跟着一起去吗？为了科学？

english: Every good story must start with a foundation.
translation: 每个好故事都必须从根基开始。

english: Bark bark.
translation: 汪汪。

english: Father Aereck says he saw something in the cellar
translation: 艾瑞克神父说他在地窖里看到了什么东西

english: Yip!
translation: 汪！

english: I'd like to resupply.
translation: 我想补充物资。

english: You hand the crest over to Dimintheis.
translation: 你把纹章交给了迪明塞斯。

english: You talked about going to the park and playing gnomeball.
translation: 你谈到了去公园玩地精球的事。

english: Yippee! It's all ours!
translation: 太棒了！全是我们的了！

english: Your headache seems to have cleared a little. You remember where you moored your boat.
translation: 你的头痛似乎减轻了一些。你记起了自己停船的地方。

english: But, rules are rules. Pay up!
translation: 但是，规矩就是规矩。付钱吧！

english: Well, all that politics downstairs was getting a bit dry, but then I heard there'd been a bit of a commotion. I thought I'd come see what the fuss was all about. You don't mind, do you?
translation: 嗯，楼下那些政治话题有点枯燥，但后来我听说出了点骚动。我想来看看这阵喧闹是怎么回事。你不介意吧？

english: It bigger before.
translation: 它以前更大。

english: Someone else is already repairing this cow.
translation: 已经有人在修理这头奶牛了。

english: You attempt to pick the first lock...
translation: 你尝试撬开第一把锁……

english: Can you prove your skills?
translation: 你能证明你的技能吗？

english: You find a strange tome by the skeleton which you take.
translation: 你在骷髅旁发现了一本奇怪的书，并把它拿走了。

english: You notice a small symbol, similar to the one you've seen the Knights of the Round Table wear.
translation: 你注意到一个小符号，与你见过的圆桌骑士所佩戴的符号相似。

english: The problem however for me, is that not just any old gold will be suitable. I seek only the purest, the most high quality of gold - what I seek, if you will, is perfect gold.
translation: 然而对我来说，问题在于并非任何旧金子都合适。我只寻求最纯净、品质最高的金子——如果你愿意的话，我所寻求的是完美的金子。

english: Thank you, adventurer, this is just what the shelter needed!
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者，这正是收容所所需要的！

english: That's right, little mice...come to Bob.
translation: 没错，小老鼠们……到鲍勃这儿来。

english: 'Ello ther, [player name]!
translation: 你好啊，[player name]！

english: Well, in that case, I think I'll give it a miss.
translation: 那样的话，我想我还是算了吧。

english: The arm cannot be rotated while the claw is down.
translation: 爪子放下时手臂无法旋转。

english: You must have a lot of faith in your process.
translation: 你一定对自己的方法很有信心。

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [player name]. However, she appears to be ignoring me...
translation: 抱歉，我想和[player name]说话。但她似乎在无视我……

english: Lucien will use the Stone to do as the gods once did. He will upset the balance so drastically, that it may not recover. This cannot be allowed to happen.
translation: 卢西安会利用石头做神明曾经做过的事。他会如此剧烈地扰乱平衡，以至于可能无法恢复。这绝不能发生。

english: Some food can be eaten much faster than others. For example, karambwan. When your opponent hits you, eat a shark and then a karambwan quickly, in that order!
translation: 有些食物可以比其他食物吃得快得多。例如，卡兰姆万。当对手攻击你时，先吃一条鲨鱼，然后迅速吃一个卡兰姆万，就按这个顺序！

english: My mission must be successful!
translation: 我的任务必须成功！

english: Impressive, you may actually challenge me.
translation: 令人印象深刻，你或许真的能挑战我。

english: Every 100 years.
Maybe if I got both gangs a camel, I could use the mutual goodwill to find out what happened to Ali's nephew.
translation: 也许如果我给两个帮派各弄一头骆驼，我就能利用这份共同的好意来查明阿里侄子遭遇了什么。

english: Adam reaches inside the jar and takes a soul.
translation: 亚当把手伸进罐子里，取出了一个灵魂。

english: Well, that's no good! What if they come after our sweets instead?
translation: 嗯，那可不行！要是他们反过来打我们糖果的主意怎么办？

english: Hmm... What was Ocellus' fate, [player name]?
translation: 嗯……Ocellus的命运如何，[player name]？

english: Aaaaaaaaaah! You can talk!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！你会说话！

english: Your concern warms my old heart, young [player name]. But no, I am afraid everybody else is in need of respite as much as I am, if not more. That is simply the nature of our circumstances.
translation: 你的关心温暖了我这把老骨头，年轻的[player name]。但不行，恐怕其他所有人都和我一样需要休息，甚至更需要。这就是我们处境的本质。

english: Right, but I'm sure she can point you in the right direction. You'll find her house near the western entrance to Varrock.
translation: 对，但我相信她能给你指对方向。她的房子就在维洛克城西门附近。

english: That's cool. Keep at it! We're going to need quite a few more.
translation: 不错。继续加油！我们还需要不少呢。

english: Find any texts with powers from the gods.
translation: 找到任何带有神明力量的典籍。

english: Let's make sure that wasn't a fluke...
translation: 让我们确认一下那不是侥幸……

english: You talked about being tickled and going to the park.
translation: 你谈到了被挠痒痒和去公园的事。

english: Do what you just did, but faster. I've brought in a more speedy foe.
translation: 照你刚才做的再做一遍，但要更快。我带来了一个更迅捷的对手。

english: Come back when you do then.
translation: 那等你有了再回来吧。

english: Sure, I can check in with her.
translation: 当然，我可以去问问她。

english: That may complicate things.
translation: 那可能会让事情变复杂。

english: Perhaps I should talk to the archaeologists before updating their displays.
translation: 也许我应该在更新他们的展示柜之前先和考古学家谈谈。

english: You don't look like a local.
translation: 你看起来不像本地人。

english: Are you sure you wish to revert your Robe bottoms of the Eye (red)? The dye used will not be returned.
translation: 你确定要还原你的眼之长袍下装 (红) 吗？所使用的染料不会退还。

english: Ah yes, that was it!
translation: 啊对，就是那个！

english: How is the practice going?
translation: 练习进行得怎么样？

english: I've seen my fair share of friendly folk perish. It's time to empower those that dare enter the Wilderness to give them a fighting chance.
translation: 我见过不少友善的人丧命。是时候赋予那些敢于进入荒野的人力量，让他们有一战之力。

english: Sounds cool! I want to try one.
translation: 听起来很酷！我想试试。

english: The stray dog indicates towards her makeshift den.
translation: 流浪狗朝她临时搭建的窝示意。

english: I don't know. Why don't you name it?
translation: 我不知道。不如你来给它起个名字？

english: No, keep holding the cargo.
translation: 不，继续搬着货物。

english: Mum and Dad bought this giant bowl of sweets for trick or treaters like you! They said whatever's left at the end, we can keep.
translation: 爸爸妈妈买了这一大碗糖果，就是给像你这样来讨糖的人准备的！他们说最后剩下多少，我们都可以留着。

english: Un-note the banknotes?
translation: 要把银行票据兑换成物品吗？

english: To finally be seen...
translation: 终于能被看见了……

english: I'd say she's happy to see you.
translation: 我看她很高兴见到你。

english: You see some text scrolled above the altar on a symbol: Swordfish raw and chicken uncooked...
translation: 你看到祭坛上方一个符号上滚动着一些文字：生剑鱼和未煮熟的鸡……

english: I'll talk to the Ironman tutor.
translation: 我会去找铁人导师谈谈。

english: What information do you have for me?
translation: 你有什么信息可以告诉我？

english: Hello there, Gertrude.
translation: 你好，格特鲁德。

english: : Ah, hello there, lassie! Did ye know that your little farmin' patch there is the exact spot where I once buried an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: ：啊，你好啊，小姑娘！你知道你那块小农田正是我曾经埋下一个旧宝箱的地方吗。

english: That is not information I am privy to.
translation: 那不是我所能知晓的信息。

english: Embrace... annihilation...
translation: 拥抱……湮灭……

english: It shouldn't be. This is the only way in or out of the vault, and yet... someone... or something has managed to get in there all the same.
translation: 不应该啊。这是进出金库的唯一通道，然而……有人……或者什么东西还是设法进去了。

english: Arrr! I wants me treasure!
translation: 啊啊！我要我的宝藏！

english: Woohoo!
translation: 哇呼！

english: Beautiful and adventurous, just like Neite!
translation: 美丽又爱冒险，就像奈特一样！

english: Sorry, human. We have big plan. Keep village safe.
translation: 抱歉，人类。我们有重大计划。保护村庄安全。

english: Actually, I've already got those. You can keep them.
translation: 其实，我已经有那些了。你可以留着。

english: Go on, let me in. You know you want to. I could... make it worth your while...
translation: 来吧，让我进去。你知道你想的。我可以……让你觉得值得……

english: Well spotted!
translation: 眼力不错！

english: Hmm? What what?
translation: 嗯？什么什么？

english: I always wanted to be a Nurse!
translation: 我一直想当一名护士！

english: I like them all so much I carve their portraits on my tree. I go to all of the ceremonies. I even got a ceremonial shell once, scratched by the leader! I almost fainted!
translation: 我太喜欢他们了，所以把他们的肖像刻在我的树上。所有仪式我都会去。我甚至得到过一次仪式贝壳，还是首领亲手刻的！我差点晕过去！

english: Wow! Is there anything he cannot do?
translation: 哇！还有他做不到的事吗？

english: There's no real need to. It's just a poem.
translation: 其实没必要。那只是一首诗。

english: Purrr...purr...
translation: 呼噜……呼噜……

english: We're here to protect the Archive from intruders, not to beat them to the punch.
translation: 我们来这里是为了保护档案库免受入侵者侵害，而不是抢在他们前面动手。

english: My strongest allies, welcome to the action.
translation: 我最强大的盟友，欢迎加入行动。

english: You won't fool anyone with that trick again.
translation: 你那套把戏再也骗不了任何人了。

english: What? All this running about for a cursed map! Couldn't you have made this little revelation before I fed you?
translation: 什么？为了张被诅咒的地图跑这么多路！你就不能在我喂你之前告诉我这点小发现吗？

english: Sounds like it's going to be quite the party!
translation: 听起来会是一场相当盛大的聚会！

english: Would you please listen to me?
translation: 你能不能听我说？

english: There goes your flanking move!
translation: 你的侧翼包抄没戏了！

english: Of course. Do bear in mind that our stock runs low rather quickly, so opportunities to resupply are limited.
translation: 当然。请记住我们的库存消耗得相当快，所以补给的机会有限。

english: I suppose I can see where you're coming from.
translation: 我想我能理解你的意思。

english: I'm nearly ready to take on Pete's challenge.
translation: 我差不多准备好接受皮特的挑战了。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye (red)? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之长袍上衣 (红) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: Ah, yes, the Disaster.
translation: 啊，是的，那个灾难。

english: There is a raw sardine placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一条生沙丁鱼。

english: When the moment is right, freeze them both, take cover behind the tree and stay out of their line of sight to complete the challenge!
translation: 时机合适时，把两人都冻结，躲到树后并保持在他们的视线之外，以完成挑战！

english: Codename: Pop
translation: 代号：波普

english: That's not how it's done! There are ceremonial leaders and we pick who joins us, not the other way around.
translation: 不是那样做的！有仪式首领，是我们挑选谁加入我们，而不是反过来。

english: I think I got it! 101!
translation: 我想我懂了！101！

english: Excellent! Although, you don't seem to have enough space to hold the sugar. Come back when you do!
translation: 太好了！不过，你似乎没有足够的空间装糖。等你有了再来吧！

english: Fast and precise, just like me!
translation: 又快又准，就像我一样！

english: Can you explain the scenario?
translation: 你能解释一下这个情景吗？

english: I found a stray dog in Varrock, but her puppies have gone missing.
translation: 我在维洛克城发现了一只流浪狗，但她的幼崽们不见了。

english: Well, things got deep very quickly. Is this how you normally introduce yourself to someone?
translation: 好吧，事情很快就变得深奥了。你平时都是这样向别人介绍自己的吗？

english: I... Don't know it.
translation: 我……不知道。

english: Yes. In fact, I already have everything we need.
translation: 是的。事实上，我已经准备好了我们需要的一切。

english: It's hard to put into words... There was someone in the inner vault... but he was Guthixian!
translation: 很难用言语表达……内金库里有人……但他是古斯希克斯的信徒！

english: Riiiiight... So I'm just going to scout him out for you then.
translation: 好吧……那我就替你去侦察他一下。

english: Start the Gertrude's Cat quest?
translation: 开始格特鲁德的猫任务？

english: What mean Picklenose lose other dog?
translation: 皮克诺斯弄丢另一只狗是什么意思？

english: You carry the various instruments onto the heights... As promised, you also transport one of the crabs.
translation: 你带着各种乐器登上高处……如约而至，你还搬运了其中一只蟹。

english: You're asking me to cancel Halloween? Ruin the holiday? Be a Hallowed Scrooge?
translation: 你是要我取消万圣节？毁掉这个节日？当个神圣的守财奴？

english: Here kid, have some...
translation: 来，孩子，给你一些……

english: Your panic... is futile...
translation: 你的恐慌……是徒劳的……

english: I know how you feel... for such a long time I have searched and searched for the elusive perfect gold... I thought I had gotten a good lead on finding it when I heard talk of a dwarven expert on gold some time back.
translation: 我明白你的感受……很长一段时间以来，我一直在寻找那难以捉摸的完美金子……前些时候我听说有位矮人金子专家，还以为自己找到了找到它的好线索。

english: Only what you're already doing. Help with the defence of the Archive where you can. We'll be sure to let you know the moment Lucien himself makes his next move.
translation: 做你已经在做的事就好。尽你所能协助防御档案馆。一旦卢西安本人有下一步行动，我们一定会立刻通知你。

english: You do know I can see those coming, yes?
translation: 你知道我看得见那些东西过来吧？

english: You are about to trade 1 x Crystal weapon seed for 1 x Crystal acorn.
translation: 你即将用1个水晶武器种子交换1个水晶橡子。

english: I just have a few questions to ask. I've been told you're good with animals.
translation: 我只是有几个问题想问。听说你很擅长和动物打交道。

english: Keep an eye on my gear and prayers, and be ready to adapt. Use your own prayers, switch your gear and look for opportunities to catch me off guard.
translation: 留意我的装备和祈祷，并随时准备应变。使用你自己的祈祷，切换你的装备，并寻找机会打我一个措手不及。

english: I've asked five friends to let you practice on them. Change your weapon and special attack each of them in one go to do some damage!
translation: 我请了五个朋友来让你在他们身上练习。一次性改变你的武器和战技，对他们每个人造成伤害！

english: On it.
translation: 这就去办。

english: The bonus shape has changed to the cube.
translation: 奖励形状已变为立方体。

english: Noooo!
Harrrr harrrr...Good joke...
translation: 哈哈哈……好笑话……

english: Well, you might need to meet with them some other time. You're needed back at the palace.
translation: 好吧，你可能得改天再见他们了。宫殿那边需要你回去。

english: My mistake milady, I was thinking yer be some other lass! Take this swag, and we'll be saying no more about it! Yarrr!
translation: 是我的错，小姐，我还以为你是别的姑娘呢！拿着这些赃物，咱们就当没这回事！呀嗬！

english: Look what we got 'ere.
translation: 看看咱们弄到了什么。

english: Ha! It is important to remember, young [player name], that whilst the fight for goodness and justice may feel desperate, the fight for evil is twice as much so.
translation: 哈！年轻的[player name]，要记住，虽然为善良与正义而战可能让人感到绝望，但为邪恶而战的绝望程度要加倍。

english: Mistakes won't get you far against me!
translation: 失误可没法让你在我面前讨到便宜！

english: I have lost the fragment that you gave me...
translation: 我把你给我的那块碎片弄丢了……

english: Well, it should be any time now!
translation: 嗯，应该随时都会好了！

english: Death... awaits...
translation: 死亡……在等待……

english: Guthix... wanted... balance... Balance... through... death...
translation: 古斯……想要……平衡……通过……死亡……实现……平衡……

english: What a dismal little spot this is!
translation: 这地方真是又小又凄凉！

english: Emboldened by his theft of the Stone, Lucien has dispatched his forces to raid the Archive. To make matters worse, Lucien's actions have resulted in various other groups also becoming aware of the Archive. They are gathering strength as we speak.
translation: 卢西安因窃取贾斯之石而胆气大增，已派兵突袭档案馆。更糟的是，卢西安的举动还让其他各方势力也得知了档案馆的存在。他们此刻正在集结力量。

english: Still, that is often enough to save your skin. When you're ready, step up to your partner and he will attack!
translation: 不过，这通常足以保命。准备好后，走到你的搭档面前，他就会发起攻击！

english: Um okay...
translation: 呃，好吧……

english: Would you like to buy some lucky heather?
translation: 你想买些幸运石楠花吗？

english: You wound me! Is it so hard to believe that this old man has a heart?
translation: 你伤到我了！这个老人有颗心就那么难以置信吗？

english: Goblin army weakening, we should reinforce.
translation: 哥布林军队正在削弱，我们应该增援。

english: The horn belonging to Bran?!
translation: 属于布兰的号角？！

english: This feels a little mean-spirited, but I'll give it a go.
translation: 这感觉有点刻薄，不过我就试试吧。

english: Get yourself a friend like Pete.
translation: 找个像皮特这样的朋友吧。

english: Codenames: Paxton and Philbert
translation: 代号：Paxton和Philbert

english: Welcome! Here you will learn about a few special attacks and how to use them effectively.
translation: 欢迎！在这里你将了解几种战技以及如何有效使用它们。

english: Start the Troll Romance quest?
translation: 开始巨魔浪漫史任务？

english: I found her in Varrock. She's one of the stray dogs.
translation: 我在维洛克城找到了她。她是那些流浪狗之一。

english: You spend ages travelling out to end up on a noisy overcrowded beach, crammed with crabs who climb all over you and don't respect you at all, you can't see anything, it's cold, and there's sand everywhere!
translation: 你花了好长时间赶路，结果来到一片嘈杂拥挤的海滩，挤满了爬到你身上、完全不尊重你的蟹，你什么都看不见，又冷，而且到处都是沙子！

english: I was just heading into the cave...
translation: 我正要去那个洞穴……

english: I had a bit of fun though, the whole job was quite diverting.
translation: 不过我玩得挺开心，整件事还挺有意思的。

english: Great switches!
translation: 切换得漂亮！

english: Seashell, of course. We are not so coarse as to bash coconuts. Now playing shell... That requires some finesse that only the most delicate crab can manage.
translation: 当然是贝壳。我们可没那么粗俗去敲椰子。现在演奏贝壳……那需要一些只有最精致的蟹才能掌握的技巧。

english: Swaying and waving my claws?
translation: 摇摆挥舞我的钳子？

english: How many would you like to convert?
translation: 你想转换多少个？

english: Gives us power, of course!
translation: 当然是给我们力量！

english: Say, would you be able to help us, ma'am? If you could get rid of the trick or treaters, then we'd get to keep the lot!
translation: 我说，女士，你能帮帮我们吗？如果你能赶走那些捣蛋鬼，那我们就能把这一大堆都留下了！

english: Yes, for up to an hour.
translation: 是的，最多一小时。

english: That usually results in some crabs complaining loudly about how much they paid to be there.
translation: 那通常会导致一些蟹大声抱怨他们花了多少钱才到那里。

english: For a start. I... get all red. In fact I get all red just thinking about him!
translation: 一开始是这样。我……会满脸通红。事实上，光是想到他我就满脸通红！

english: Can I buy a Escape crystal (Members)?
translation: 我可以买一个逃脱水晶吗（会员）？

english: Cliiick-click cliiick-cliiick-cliiick.
translation: 咔——咔咔 咔——咔——咔。

english: As the day draws to an end, you suddenly feel very tired. You close your eyes...
translation: 随着一天接近尾声，你突然感到非常疲倦。你闭上了眼睛……

english: You manage to shoot down the target.
translation: 你成功射下了目标。

english: We're not sure exactly what's inside, but we can't take any risks. We need to assume that the contents could have the potential to be on par with the Stone of Jas itself.
translation: 我们不确定里面究竟有什么，但我们不能冒任何风险。我们必须假设其中的物品有可能与贾斯之石本身不相上下。

english: That wouldn't be very Halloween-y of me.
translation: 那我可就不够万圣节了。

english: Cancel teleport
translation: 取消传送

english: You can't kill me!
translation: 你杀不了我！

english: Switch to world 344?
translation: 切换到344号世界？

english: I'll accept your offer.
translation: 我接受你的提议。

english: Like the Stone of Jas or the Staff of Armadyl?
translation: 比如贾斯之石或阿玛杜尔杖？

english: You catch a sea-soaked bowstring.
translation: 你捞到一根被海水浸透的弓弦。

english: Hello, there, friend. I heard about your exploits on your recent... journey. Good work!
translation: 你好啊，朋友。我听说了你最近……旅途中的事迹。干得好！

english: Can I collect the items from that gravestone now?
translation: 我现在可以从那座墓碑取回物品了吗？

english: No, I want to leave it as it is.
translation: 不，我想保持原样。

english: Cute, aren't they.
translation: 很可爱，对吧。

english: Although the last crab that did that has been nicknamed Dipper ever since.
translation: 不过上一只这么做的螃蟹从此就被叫做迪珀了。

english: He didn't? I thought the things inside were a danger to the world.
translation: 他没有？我以为里面的东西对世界是个威胁。

english: Come with me, little one.
translation: 跟我来，小家伙。

english: Yes! It's right here. Let me give it to you.
translation: 是的！就在这里。让我把它给你。

english: Heave to, missus [player name]!
translation: 停船，[player name]女士！

english: No, Toetaller still want guard dog. We make this one guard dog without all that.
translation: 不，Toetaller还是要看门狗。我们就把这只做成看门狗，不要那些。

english: Man of few words I see.
translation: 看来是个寡言少语的人。

english: I see. What's the current situation? Have your soldiers entered the Archive already?
translation: 我明白了。目前情况如何？你的士兵已经进入档案馆了吗？

english: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Mazchna.
translation: 哦，那好吧，我去找马斯纳谈谈。

english: The Black Guard, what's that?
translation: 黑卫队，那是什么？

english: The bellows already look fixed to you.
translation: 风箱看起来已经修好了。

english: Burny gloop!
translation: 燃烧的黏浆！

english: Oh, hello. How can I help?
translation: 哦，你好。有什么可以帮你的？

english: Be careful where you put that...something might happen to it!
translation: 小心放置它……可能会发生什么事！

english: I'm afraid I've found all the crabs that were willing to assist.
translation: 恐怕我已经找到了所有愿意帮忙的螃蟹。

english: Sorry for losing you, little fella.
translation: 抱歉把你弄丢了，小家伙。

english: You may not pass!
translation: 你不能通过！

english: Yes! Long live the Blue Opal!
translation: 是的！蓝色蛋白石万岁！

english: I don't usually get out of bed for less than a hundred gold bars!
translation: 我通常不会为少于一百块金锭起床！

english: Oh, er... carry on then.
translation: 哦，呃……那你继续吧。

english: I hope you're happy with your wish. I must be leaving now, though.
translation: 希望你对你的愿望感到满意。不过我现在必须离开了。

english: No, no, it's okay! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach.
translation: 不，不，没关系！我是代表我在海滩上的螃蟹朋友来的。

english: Pay Death's fee.
translation: 支付死神的费用。

english: Hey, [player name], surprise exam!
translation: 嘿，[player name]，突击测验！

english: After all, should we fail, the power will end up in nefarious hands either way. But! Worry not. There is fight left in me yet. And whilst there is, such a future will not come to pass.
translation: 毕竟，如果我们失败了，这股力量无论如何都会落入邪恶之手。但是！别担心。我仍有斗志。只要还有斗志，这样的未来就不会发生。

english: It's worth a shot. Okay, I will do it.
translation: 值得一试。好吧，我来做。

english: Well, hurry back. We need everyone at their posts.
translation: 好吧，快点回来。我们需要每个人都坚守岗位。

english: The Border Collie heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 边境牧羊犬前往狗收容所。

english: You only think you're ahead, as I planned.
translation: 你以为你领先了，其实一切都在我的计划之中。

english: You need a big net to gather items from this floatsam.
translation: 你需要一张大网才能从这些漂浮物中收集物品。

english: Good luck in there, [player name].
translation: 祝你在里面好运，[player name]。

english: Ah, the Book of Life and Death.
translation: 啊，生死之书。

english: You're not even sure any of this is real. You probably can't drop your items here, even if you wanted to.
translation: 你甚至不确定这一切是否真实。即使你想，你大概也无法在这里丢弃物品。

english: Well done, you beat me. But you still owe me 25 gold pieces.
translation: 干得好，你打败了我。但你还欠我25枚金币。

english: Aww, me is all alone.
translation: 呜呜，我孤零零一个人。

english: We shall learn what we can, but feel free to find some use for it.
translation: 我们会尽可能了解它，但你可以随意找些它的用途。

english: Smart! Your frontline is a valuable tool.
translation: 聪明！你的前线是宝贵的工具。

english: Replaceable.
translation: 可替换的。

english: We don't want it! We just want to keep this place safe!
translation: 我们不想要它！我们只想保护这个地方的安全！

english: We could do with, er, more girl leaders.
translation: 我们倒是可以多来点，呃，女性领袖。

english: I've got an update.
translation: 我有新消息。

english: [player name] is the bestest adventurer EVER!
translation: [player name]是有史以来最棒的冒险者！

english: Could you take me somewhere?
translation: 你能带我去个地方吗？

english: Hot stuff!
translation: 好烫的东西！

english: So you don't have any troubles with Guthix?
translation: 所以你和古斯没有过节？

english: You'll have to go in through the staff entrance unfortunately. I can't be seen entering with the help.
translation: 很遗憾，你得从员工入口进去。我不能被人看到和帮手一起进去。

english: Thanks for playing!
translation: 感谢游玩！

english: The power of Saradomin prevents you taking armour or weaponry to Entrana.
translation: 萨拉多明的力量阻止你将盔甲或武器带到恩特纳岛。

english: Cheersh, matey...
translation: 干杯，伙计……

english: You take the Diamond of Smoke from the ashes of the warrior.
translation: 你从战士的灰烬中取出了烟雾钻石。

english: I think it's really hungry!
translation: 我觉得它真的很饿！

english: Well, a top-notch adventurer like yourself is just the right sort we've been seeking for our organisation.
translation: 嗯，像你这样顶尖的冒险者，正是我们组织一直在寻找的人选。

english: The entrance to the cave is covered in too much ice to get through.
translation: 洞穴入口被太多冰覆盖，无法通过。

english: Maybe human is chosen commander.
translation: 也许人类是被选中的指挥官。

english: Sure, I'll help you!
translation: 当然，我会帮你！

english: You've left a soft spot exposed!
translation: 你露出了一个破绽！

english: Excellent idea. I've helped her out before. I can check in with her.
translation: 好主意。我以前帮过她。我可以去看看她。

english: The Chihuahua heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 吉娃娃前往狗收容所。

english: Use an ice spell to freeze your partner, then run underneath him and stay there long enough to complete the first challenge.
translation: 用冰系法术冻结你的搭档，然后跑到他下方并停留足够长的时间以完成第一个挑战。

english: Right, well, in that case, I'd better get to it. I'd like to have a look around down here. Hopefully I can find some sort of clue as to how Livius died.
translation: 好吧，既然如此，我最好开始行动了。我想在下面四处看看。希望能找到一些关于利维乌斯死因的线索。

english: Mrrph
translation: 呜噜

english: Say... Even though you only have 2 legs, they're pretty long. You could probably walk around the island and find good shells in no time!
translation: 我说……虽然你只有 2 条腿，但它们挺长的。你大概很快就能绕着岛走一圈，找到好贝壳！

english: This spirit seems to be busy.
translation: 这个灵魂似乎很忙。

english: Congratulations! You have unlocked the Zeal prayer.
translation: 恭喜！你解锁了热忱祈祷。

english: Toetaller doubt that.
translation: 脚趾高个怀疑那个。

english: Word has spread of our shelter and we've received letters about stray dogs across the world.
translation: 我们的收容所已经声名远播，我们收到了世界各地关于流浪狗的信件。

english: Why? Are you afraid I will become irresistible to a certain someone?
translation: 为什么？你是怕我会让某个人无法抗拒吗？

english: I would have loved to see it!
translation: 我本来很想看看的！

english: Usually Wartface give up by now!
translation: 通常疣脸到现在就放弃了！

english: Maybe I could make something with some fur...?
translation: 也许我可以用一些毛皮做点什么……？

english: Down with Lathas!
translation: 打倒拉萨斯！

english: The Archive?
translation: 档案馆？

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (blue)? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍下装 (蓝) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: Can you teach me?
translation: 你能教我吗？

english: Greetings! In this scenario, you'll master gear switching.
translation: 你好！在这个场景中，你将掌握装备切换。

english: It can't be! I must have misheard!
translation: 不可能！我一定听错了！

english: Umm... ok...Sir.
translation: 呃……好的……先生。

english: What will you take notes on if you leave the tree behind?
translation: 如果你把树留下，你要在什么上面做笔记？

english: My goodness
translation: 我的天哪

english: The power of Zamorak protects us!
translation: 萨莫拉克的力量保护着我们！

english: You should leave this place - it is not safe for you.
translation: 你应该离开这个地方——这里对你来说不安全。

english: However, while defending the Archive is essential, we must also remain focused on Lucien himself.
translation: 然而，虽然保卫档案馆至关重要，我们也必须继续专注于卢西安本人。

english: Actually I'll go and collect them at the gravestone.
translation: 其实我会去墓碑那里收集它们。

english: Well met, Armacus.
translation: 幸会，Armacus。

english: And now, you wait...
translation: 现在，你等着……

english: Start the Contact! quest?
translation: 开始接触！任务？

english: A strange object made of stone and vines found within the Fractured Archive. It looks like a key of some sort.
translation: 在破碎档案馆中发现的一个由石头和藤蔓制成的奇怪物体。它看起来像是某种钥匙。

english: Oh don't worry, I'm sure I'll work something out. I just need some time to think.
translation: 哦别担心，我肯定能想出办法的。我只是需要点时间思考。

english: Start the Mountain Daughter quest?
translation: 开始山的女儿任务吗？

english: As it is in your bank you know that it is unlikely to be hidden on the shelf again.
translation: 既然它在你银行里，你就知道它不太可能再藏在架子上。

english: Aha, you'll do [player name]!
translation: 啊哈，你正合适，[player name]！

english: Well, I'm actually something of an adventurer myself.
translation: 嗯，其实我自己也算是个冒险者。

english: Sorry, no way.
translation: 抱歉，不行。

english: You hand in a really large rose shell.
translation: 你交上了一枚非常大的玫瑰贝壳。

english: You find something unexpected in the ore pack... it's a broken pickaxe, cool!
translation: 你在矿石包里发现了意想不到的东西……是一把破损的镐，真酷！

english: Somehow, yes. But anyways, we are done here. Thank you for coming to my demonstration.
translation: 不知怎么的，是的。不过总之，我们到此为止。感谢你来观看我的演示。

english: That was quite a ride!
translation: 那真是一段刺激的旅程！

english: Aaaaaagh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！

english: Even Grubfoot manage this move.
translation: 连格拉布福特都能走出这一步。

english: The Bandosian forces are mostly goblins. You wouldn't think they'd pose much of a threat, but they've managed to build some sort of siege engine. If that weren't enough, they're being led by a huge ork.
translation: 班多斯军队大多是哥布林。你本以为他们构不成多大威胁，但他们竟然造出了某种攻城引擎。更糟的是，他们由一个巨大的兽人率领。

english: Let me at it!
translation: 让我来试试！

english: Ghommal's luck will remain with you, so long as you continue to prove your combat prowess.
translation: 只要你继续证明自己的战斗实力，戈马尔的运气就会一直伴随着你。

english: Another 2 boxes should do the trick.
translation: 再来 2 个盒子应该就够了。

english: I should finish helping Talia with my current task before bringing back another stray.
translation: 在带回另一只流浪狗之前，我应该先完成帮塔莉亚的当前任务。

english: Now, your final task is one of the utmost importance. It has come to my attention that there is a traitor in our midst.
translation: 现在，你的最后一项任务至关重要。我注意到我们中间有一个叛徒。

english: I don't have much to offer in return, but maybe I could show you the ceremonial dance of my kin? Just promise me you won't do it during the ceremony.
translation: 我没什么能回报你的，不过也许我可以给你表演我族人的仪式之舞？只要答应我别在仪式期间跳就行。

english: You successfully dye your Robe bottoms of the Eye (blue).
translation: 你成功将眼之长袍下装 (蓝) 染色。

english: Don't worry your highness! We'll find it!
translation: 别担心，殿下！我们会找到它的！

english: Are you sure you wish to revert your Robe bottoms of the Eye (green)? The dye used will not be returned.
translation: 你确定要将眼之长袍下装 (绿) 还原吗？所用的染料不会退还。

english: You pull the lever but nothing happens. Maybe the tank needs to be empty first.
translation: 你拉动拉杆，但什么也没发生。也许水箱需要先清空。

english: You try and try, but I keep taking pieces.
translation: 你试了又试，但我一直在吃掉你的棋子。

english: My lovely neighbour is also really kind to me. She seems to care for me more than I can fathom.
translation: 我可爱的邻居对我也非常好。她似乎比我想象中更关心我。

english: I don't think I need to do this right now. I should speak to Tamara.
translation: 我觉得我现在不需要这么做。我应该和塔玛拉谈谈。

english: For a small fee.
translation: 收取少量费用。

english: On all websites I visit.
translation: 在我访问的所有网站上。

english: You can't block this one.
translation: 你挡不住这一击。

english: You may as well just make me the Captain.
translation: 你干脆让我当船长算了。

english: You pinned the tail to the cow's nose.
translation: 你把尾巴钉在了奶牛的鼻子上。

english: On the beach.
translation: 在海滩上。

english: You're lucky we're understaffed...
translation: 算你走运，我们人手不足……

english: Be friendly and answer the questions.
translation: 保持友好并回答问题。

english: Hmmm... For some reason the name Banjo calls to me.
translation: 嗯……不知为何，Banjo 这个名字在呼唤我。

english: The details of my mission must remain a secret. You can't make me talk.
translation: 我任务的细节必须保密。你没法让我开口。

english: Hang on, if you thought it was going to be such a terrible idea, why did you even do it?
translation: 等等，如果你觉得这是个糟糕的主意，那你为什么还要这么做？

english: You give Dunstan an Iron bar and the climbing boots.
translation: 你给了邓斯坦一个铁锭和登山靴。

english: All you see is the barren wasteland of the Wilderness.
translation: 你看到的只有荒野的荒芜废土。

english: Who made this massive nest?
translation: 谁造了这个巨大的鸟巢？

english: Hey, stop!
translation: 嘿，站住！

english: Drink from the bottle again?
translation: 再从瓶子里喝一口吗？

english: Well, there's actually no need. Ennius killed him as soon as we found out.
translation: 嗯，其实没必要。我们一发现，恩尼乌斯就杀了他。

english: Click the links in the email to visit the website.
translation: 点击电子邮件中的链接访问网站。

english: You use your your Thieving skills to remove the block without triggering the spikes.
translation: 你运用偷窃技能移除了石块，且没有触发尖刺。

english: What's your function here?
translation: 你在这里的职责是什么？

english: Interrupting who?
translation: 打扰谁？

english: Die, intruder!
translation: 去死吧，入侵者！

english: There we go. That's your new boat all set up, mate. Don't forget, you can kit it out at much as you fancy over at the shipyard. Just check in with Seb if you need a hand once you're there.
translation: 好了。你的新船都准备好了，伙计。别忘了，你可以在船厂随意改装它。到了那儿如果需要帮忙，找塞布就行。

english: Luckily, the rubbish didn't stay away from our island for long. Maybe you can just fish the materials for another one.
translation: 幸运的是，垃圾并没有远离我们的岛屿太久。也许你可以直接钓到材料再做一艘。

english: Well... there is something you could do for me if you're interested. Though it is quite dangerous.
translation: 嗯……如果你有兴趣，其实有件事你可以帮我。不过相当危险。

english: How interesting... Does it have anything else on it?
translation: 真有趣……上面还有别的东西吗？

english: I've shown Filliman the fungus, but I'm not sure what to do now?
translation: 我已经给菲利曼看过蘑菇了，但我不知道现在该做什么？

english: The Shiba heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 柴犬前往狗收容所。

english: I'll steal that back after the game.
translation: 比赛结束后我会把它偷回来。

english: : Is that a little clearer?
translation: ：这样清楚一点了吗？

english: You may view some of the records, should your curiosity need satisfying.
translation: 如果你的好奇心需要满足，你可以查看一些记录。

english: You want to shake hands! Awww.
translation: 你想握手！哎呀。

english: The pumpkins! Smash them all, please!
translation: 那些南瓜！请把它们全砸烂！

english: The Samoyed heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 萨摩耶朝狗收容所走去。

english: I was told, but I wasn't listening.
translation: 有人告诉过我，但我没在听。

english: I'm afraid not... It might hold off some of the intruders, but it won't manage all of them. And without getting in there to establish defences of our own, we won't stand a much better of a chance.
translation: 恐怕不行……它也许能挡住一些入侵者，但挡不住全部。而且如果不进去建立我们自己的防御，我们的胜算也不会大多少。

english: Believe it or not, that's exactly what he said.
translation: 信不信由你，他确实是这么说的。

english: Pineapple!
translation: 菠萝！

english: Are you sure you wish to pull it?
translation: 你确定要拉它吗？

english: I'd be happy to. Any ideas where I could start?
translation: 我很乐意。你知道我可以从哪里开始吗？

english: Careful. They did that with Asgarnia's King and he still hasn't come out again.
translation: 小心。他们对阿斯加尼亚的国王就是这么做的，而他到现在还没再出来。

english: Yes, I work with it on occasion... But you're happy with just plain sugar...? Out of the bag...?
translation: 是的，我偶尔会用到它……但你只要普通的糖就行……？直接从袋子里拿……？

english: You may have stopped me for now...
translation: 你也许暂时阻止了我……

english: Fare-thee-well, Defender, we watch you with great interest.
translation: 再会了，防御者，我们满怀兴趣地注视着你。

english: Hi again. Filliman has turned into the Nature Spirit. I've just gotten the Silver sickle that he asked me to get. He says he's going to bless it!
translation: 又见面了。菲利曼已经变成了自然之灵。我刚拿到了他让我去取的银镰刀。他说他要为它祝福！

english: Movement not too complicated for mighty goblin!
translation: 动作对强大的哥布林来说不算太复杂！

english: Outlandish story or not, he did retrieve the horn.
translation: 不管故事多离奇，他确实取回了号角。

english: Build into your strategy confidently if you want to win!
translation: 如果你想赢，就自信地把它纳入你的策略！

english: Oh no you don't!
translation: 哦，你可不行！

english: I have been given this letter by an examiner at the Dig Site. Can you stamp this for me?
translation: 考古挖掘场的一位考官给了我这封信。你能帮我盖个章吗？

english: You show the Claws of Callisto to Andros Mai.
translation: 你把卡利斯托的爪拿给安德罗斯.迈看。

english: Every piece where I want it.
translation: 每一枚棋子都在我想要的位置。

english: Well, then we're on the same side. I'm part of an alliance defending this place. The danger is mostly gone though. We held off the attackers.
translation: 那么，我们站在同一边。我是保卫此地的联盟的一员。不过危险基本已经过去了。我们击退了进攻者。

english: Can I have a loo-
translation: 我能看一眼——

english: What a sight to behold!
translation: 多么壮观的景象！

english: Bring my items here now; I'll pay your fee.
translation: 现在把我的物品带到这里；我会付你的费用。

english: Well, I can't see any more candy-hungry adults. I should return to Henja and Angel.
translation: 好了，我再也看不到那些馋糖的大人了。我该回到亨雅和天使那里了。

english: It appears some puppies were playing here at one point...
translation: 看来曾有一些小狗在这里玩耍……

english: You too, your highness!
translation: 也祝您一切顺利，陛下！

english: Don't worry, I don't intend to let him.
translation: 别担心，我不打算让他得逞。

english: So my master's blade has been discovered once more. This is troubling news. Tell me more of your encounter with Ocellus?
translation: 那么我主人的刀片又被发现了。这消息令人不安。跟我说说你与奥塞勒斯遭遇的更多细节？

english: Let's remain seated for the rest of the performance.
translation: 演出剩下的时间我们就坐着吧。

english: No! Stay away!
translation: 不！离我远点！

english: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you when a new assignment.
translation: 祝你好运！有了新任务记得回来。

english: My only wish is that people would not judge the faith only by those who wield it with malice. Either judge the faith itself, or judge each follower individually.
translation: 我唯一的愿望是人们不要只凭那些心怀恶意使用信仰的人来评判信仰本身。要么评判信仰本身，要么单独评判每个信徒。

english: Her puppies were stolen by some goblins west of the Cooks' Guild. I was trying to get them back.
translation: 她的小狗被厨师公会西边的一些哥布林偷走了。我当时正想把它们救回来。

english: Noooooo
translation: 不oooooo

english: There's a cat in there alright!
translation: 里面确实有只猫！

english: Ever closer to ultimate power!
translation: 离终极力量越来越近了！

english: That's right! I have some supplies with me if you need them, but I only have a small amount left. We took a heavy toll getting here.
translation: 没错！如果你需要，我身上带了一些补给品，但我只剩一点了。我们到这里来付出了惨重的代价。

english: Impressive
translation: 令人印象深刻

english: You're doing it!
translation: 你做到了！

english: The cave goblins are too scared to talk to you.
translation: 洞穴哥布林太害怕了，不敢和你说话。

english: The stray dog sniffs the air...
translation: 流浪狗嗅了嗅空气……

english: Thanks, I really appreciate that.
translation: 谢谢，我真的很感激。

english: When the company reported a jellied demon, we weren't quite sure what to think. It seems the Zamorakian mages leveraged the Archive's powerful magics to attempt to summon a long banished demon back to Gielinor. Were it not for their evil intent, their choice to encase the demon in jelly to preserve what parts they had managed to summon could be considered ingenious. With the demon's power limited, the company was able to break the jelly down and banish the demon once more.
translation: 当公司报告出现一个果冻化的恶魔时，我们不太确定该怎么想。看来扎莫拉克的法师们利用了档案馆的强大魔法，试图将一个被放逐已久的恶魔召唤回盖林诺。若不是出于邪恶意图，他们选择用果冻包裹恶魔以保存他们设法召唤出的部分，倒可算是巧妙之举。由于恶魔的力量受限，公司得以分解果冻，再次将恶魔放逐。

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to another player. However, they appear to be ignoring me...
translation: 抱歉，我正在和另一位玩家说话。不过，对方似乎无视了我……

english: She's still easier to find than I am.
translation: 她仍然比我更容易找到。

english: As you wish, as you wish!
translation: 如你所愿，如你所愿！

english: Oh dear... I suppose that's why you're here?
translation: 天哪……我想这就是你来的原因吧？

english: Naturally, I will go there right away! They can't possibly get this right without some proper directions.
translation: 当然，我马上就去那里！没有正确的指示，他们不可能做对。

english: So they were never here to begin with?
translation: 所以他们从一开始就不在这里？

english: The power of Life and Death itself!
translation: 生死本身的力量！

english: Good, good. Well, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us beat back these villains once more!
translation: 好，好。那么，我想我们能负担的闲聊就到此为止了。让我们再次击退这些恶徒！

english: Six letters long, I hold no breath, Sealed with nails, I'm the box of death...
translation: 六个字母长，我不呼吸，用钉子封住，我是死亡之箱……

english: Stuffed dog.
translation: 填充狗。

english: It was... a sword of some sorts. It had been shattered, but Ocellus was still able to use it. Its power was... extraordinary.
translation: 那是……某种剑。它已被击碎，但奥塞勒斯仍能使用它。它的力量……非同寻常。

english: Yes! Exactly.
translation: 是的！正是如此。

english: As long as I'm around.
translation: 只要我在就行。

english: Okay, then I'll be heading off.
translation: 好，那我就走了。

english: I think [player name] should be the queen of Halloween!
translation: 我觉得[player name]应该当万圣节女王！

english: Ah-ah-ah! The pleasure of being robbed by me is not yours this day!
translation: 啊-啊-啊！今天你可没福气被我抢劫！

english: As you look at the bottle, you notice familiar shells nearby. You collect them.
translation: 当你看着瓶子时，你注意到附近有熟悉的贝壳。你把它们收集了起来。

english: As many different ones as you can find. Bring them here and I'll try them out.
translation: 你能找到多少种不同的就找多少种。把它们带到这里，我来试试。

english: How comes?
translation: 怎么会呢？

english: Dominic's Coffer (5,000 coins)
translation: 多米尼克的保险箱（5,000 金币）

english: Once again, you've skilfully protected against all the sets in this scenario!
translation: 你又一次巧妙地防住了这个场景中的所有套装！

english: Look, honestly, I don't think it's working out. Got any other moves?
translation: 听着，说实话，我觉得这不太行。还有别的招吗？

english: En garde!
translation: 准备战斗！

english: You can stick the ratsies your cat splats on it.
translation: 你可以把你猫拍死的老鼠串在上面。

english: I tick eat th ose
translation: 我滴个天，那些我吃

english: No! My prawn!
translation: 不！我的虾！

english: That'll be five coins. I suggest lying down before you drink it. That way you have less distance to collapse.
translation: 五枚金币。我建议你喝之前先躺下。这样你倒下的距离就短一些。

english: Mioaw-wow meow meow...Oh, sorry, I wasn't wearing my Humanspeak Amulet.
translation: 喵-哇喵喵……哦，抱歉，我没戴人类语护身符。

english: Sorry, but you don't look like much of a sailor to me.
translation: 抱歉，但在我看来你可不太像个水手。

english: What human leader doing?
translation: 人类首领在做什么？

english: She's proven her bravery, we'd be delighted to bring her into our ranks.
translation: 她已经证明了她的勇敢，我们很乐意让她加入我们的队伍。

english: I might be able to help with that.
translation: 也许我能帮上忙。

english: Dog intimidate invaders, save goblin lives.
translation: 狗吓退入侵者，拯救哥布林性命。

english: Maybe... I think I'll leave you to your reading now.
translation: 也许吧……我想我还是让你继续看书吧。

english: What do they use 'em for?
translation: 他们拿它们做什么用？

english: You receive 100x Blighted ancient ice sack.
translation: 你获得了 100x 被污染的古代冰袋。

english: Use a style that counters your opponent!
translation: 使用能克制对手的战斗风格！

english: Hey there! I'm not here to fight. I'm here on behalf of my crab friend over there.
translation: 嘿！我不是来打架的。我是代表那边我的螃蟹朋友来的。

english: Very unlikely! But maybe I will take a peek. The good thing about being pessimistic is that you're happy when you're wrong!
translation: 非常不可能！但也许我会去瞄一眼。悲观的好处就是，当你错了的时候你会很开心！

english: The crab scutters away to practise.
translation: 螃蟹匆匆爬走去练习了。

english: I am sorry to be the bearer of bad news, [player name]. There has been a disturbance in the inner vault. Ivy has requested your presence immediately.
translation: 很抱歉带来坏消息，[player name]。内金库出了乱子。常春藤要求你立刻到场。

english: I'm sorry, I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

english: Hmm... I suppose you may view some of the records, should your curiosity need satisfying.
translation: 嗯……既然你好奇心难耐，我想你可以查看一些记录。

english: Human only capture piece because Bentnoze in charge!
translation: 人类只捕获棋子，因为 Bentnoze 在指挥！

english: I did it. The local kids are running home!
translation: 我做到了。当地的孩子们都跑回家了！

english: Oh, you have returned. I have cancelled your current assignment; I do not feel Morytania to be a suitable place for you to slay.
translation: 哦，你回来了。我已经取消了你的当前任务；我觉得莫利塔尼亚不适合你去杀戮。

english: The Zamorakians seems to consist of two separate groups. One is a group of mages intent on summoning some sort of powerful demon. The other is the Dagon'hai, who seem to have cut ties with Lucien.
translation: 扎莫拉克信徒似乎由两个独立的群体组成。一个是一群意图召唤某种强大恶魔的法师。另一个是 Dagon'hai，他们似乎已与卢西安断绝了关系。

english: Careful now, you wouldn't want to take the wrong thing.
translation: 小心点，你可不想拿错东西。

english: It can take one of us hours just to coerce a puppy out of hiding.
translation: 光是哄一只小狗从藏身处出来，就可能要花上我们其中一人好几个小时。

english: Choose again.
translation: 重新选择。

english: Joooooin uuuuus!
The problem with things like the Blade or the Stone of Jas is that the world was not prepared for their power.
translation: 像刀片或贾斯之石这样的东西，问题在于世界还没有为它们的力量做好准备。

english: You wake up with a headache.
translation: 你醒来时头痛欲裂。

english: I am afraid that your patch has died, my friend. I am truly sorry.'
translation: 恐怕你的地块已经枯死了，我的朋友。我真的很抱歉。'

english: Yes, huge and scary. Defend village from outsiders.
translation: 是的，又大又吓人。保卫村庄免受外人侵扰。

english: Well I hope you find it soon.
translation: 好吧，我希望你很快就能找到它。

english: Don't worry, Ivy, leave it with us.
translation: 别担心，常春藤，交给我们吧。

english: So close...
translation: 好险……

english: I have already slain the Shaikahan!
translation: 我已经杀死了沙伊卡汉狮！

english: The crab scutters away.
translation: 那只蟹匆匆爬走了。

english: That sounds interesting. Can I help somehow?
translation: 听起来很有趣。我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: Great Guardian
translation: 伟大的守护者

english: The incubator is processing Glough's perfected mutagen formula.
translation: 孵化器正在处理格劳夫的完善诱变剂配方。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Hat of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之帽重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换现有的任何重新染色。

english: There is a tangle of farming equipment in here. Good job you do not need to sort through it any more!
translation: 这里有一堆缠结的农业设备。幸好你不用再翻找它们了！

english: Huh... there's a rope already down here. I hope noone else has got to this monster first.
translation: 咦……这里已经有一条绳子了。希望没有别人先找到这只怪物。

english: You hold the staff above the well and feel the power of Zamorak flow through you.
translation: 你将法杖举在水井上方，感到扎莫拉克的力量流经全身。

english: Oh...Sorry, but I don't have any sweets or coins for you this year.
translation: 哦……抱歉，但我今年没有糖果或金币给你。

english: Can't catch meeeee!
translation: 你抓不到我啊啊啊啊！

english: That is the way of the world. Rivers twist and turn, alliances shift and change. Guthix believed in the natural process. So do I.
translation: 世界就是这样运转的。河流蜿蜒曲折，联盟分分合合。古斯吉信奉自然进程。我也一样。

english: Are you there master [player name]?
translation: 你在吗，主人[player name]？

english: You have a point.
translation: 你说得有道理。

english: If lost, you can collect your shell collection from the bottle, here, on Dognose Island.
translation: 如果丢失了，你可以从多格诺斯岛这里的瓶子中取回你的贝壳收藏。

english: Oh, yes please!
translation: 哦，好的，拜托了！

english: You need to switch to a full set of gear. Streak reset.
translation: 你需要换上一整套装备。连胜已重置。

english: It was my pleasure, [player name]. Good luck in there.
translation: 这是我的荣幸，[player name]。祝你在里面好运。

english: In my attempts to slay the fiendish Chronozon, the blood demon, I lost a lot of equipment in our last battle when he bested me and forced me away from his den. He probably still has it now.
translation: 在我试图斩杀恶魔克罗诺宗——那个血魔——的过程中，上次交战时他击败了我，把我赶出了他的巢穴，我因此丢失了大量装备。他现在很可能还留着那些装备。

english: Which side would you like to teleport to?
translation: 你想传送到哪一侧？

english: Awww. Sorry little buddy, but I can't be an instrument for the band! You have a lovely shell right there, however!
translation: 哎呀。抱歉小家伙，但我没法当乐队的乐器！不过你那儿有个漂亮的贝壳！

english: I'll give it to you, you can count. But I'm going to need more than that before I believe you.
translation: 我会给你的，你可以数数。但在我相信你之前，我需要的不止这些。

english: Which way do you want to go?
translation: 你想走哪条路？

english: Errr... what are you saying exactly?
translation: 呃……你到底在说什么？

english: Wartface let another goblin die on his watch!
translation: 疣脸值班时又让一个哥布林死了！

english: He spends most of his time recovering from his injuries in some tavern, east of Varrock, near the edge of The Wilderness. You'll probably find him there.
translation: 他大部分时间都在维洛克城以东、靠近荒野边缘的某家酒馆里养伤。你大概能在那里找到他。

english: That is a rare breed. For the deal to be fair, you would need to be compensated more blood runes than I can offer.
translation: 那可是稀有品种。要让交易公平，你得得到的血符石补偿会超出我能提供的数量。

english: I'll see yer swing from the yard arm fer this, missus [player name]!
translation: 为这事我要看着你被吊在帆桁上晃荡，[player name] 女士！

english: Chase has been keeping a log of all the reports. If you speak with him, he'll show you.
translation: 蔡斯一直在记录所有的报告。如果你和他谈谈，他会给你看。

english: What a tune!
translation: 真是首好曲子！

english: Barbarian Outpost.
translation: 野蛮人前哨站。

english: There is a bloated toad already placed at this location.
translation: 这个位置已经放置了一只膨胀的蟾蜍。

english: Errr...never mind. It was a joke.
translation: 呃……算了。那是个玩笑。

english: The rubble is too compact for you to dig through from this side.
translation: 瓦砾太密实了，你无法从这一侧挖穿。

english: That sounds useful to the Alliance.
translation: 那对联盟来说听起来很有用。

english: Ceremonial leaders? Oh they are all so awesome! Putting themselves out there to make music for the ceremony like that, it's so selfless!
translation: 仪式领袖？哦，他们都太棒了！像那样挺身而出为仪式演奏音乐，真是太无私了！

english: You'd better start listenin', young lassie!!
translation: 你最好开始听着，小姑娘！！

english: Enchant your crystal teleport seeds?
translation: 要为你的水晶传送种子附魔吗？

english: I can count on you to join!
translation: 我可以指望你加入！

english: My mistake milady, I was thinking yer be some other fella! Take this swag, and we'll be saying no more about it! Yarrr!
translation: 是我的错，女士，我还以为你是别的家伙！拿着这些赃物，咱们就当没这回事！呀哈！

english: It seems you're a step behind.
translation: 看来你慢了一步。

english: Arf!
translation: 汪！

english: You attempt to pick the second lock...
translation: 你尝试撬开第二把锁……

english: Yes! This one shall be my new favourite toy.
translation: 对！这个将成为我的新宠玩具。

english: We are born in the shadows!
translation: 我们生于阴影之中！

english: Err...sorry.
translation: 呃……抱歉。

english: Now wait a minute, this concerns a friend of yours...
translation: 等等，这关系到你的一个朋友……

english: Pointless...
translation: 毫无意义……

english: There is nothing in the tray...
translation: 托盘里什么也没有……

english: Hey now, you shouldn't be so harsh on yourself. Even dubious decisions can turn out well. For instance, I just drank from this random bottle I found, which sounds like a terrible idea.
translation: 嘿，你不该对自己这么苛刻。即使是可疑的决定也可能有好结果。比如，我刚喝了我在这随便找到的这瓶东西，这听起来是个糟糕的主意。

english: I'd better not in that case.
translation: 那样的话我还是不要了。

english: It can be hard to keep up with a cat!
translation: 跟上猫可不容易！

english: That's definitely a skill I need to level up.
translation: 这绝对是我需要升级的技能。

english: PLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEASE???
translation: 求求求求求求求求求求求求求求求求求求求求你了？？？

english: I am afraid that your patch has succumbed to disease, my friend. You must attend to it immediately, before it dies.'
translation: 恐怕你的地块已经染病了，我的朋友。你必须在它枯死之前立刻处理它。'

english: Recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (green)?
translation: 要将你的眼之长袍下装 (绿) 重新染色吗？

english: That's not very scary. You're not even wearing a full costume...
translation: 这可不怎么吓人。你连整套服装都没穿……

english: Errr... ok...
translation: 呃……好吧……

english: You need to freeze your partner first, then move under him.
translation: 你需要先冻结你的搭档，然后移动到他下方。

english: Maybe a guard dog isn't the best idea?
translation: 也许看门狗不是最好的主意？

english: Bury the bone
translation: 埋葬骨头

english: Of course. Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: 当然。如果你还需要别的什么，请告诉我。

english: Smorks feeling drum beat now!
translation: 斯莫克斯现在感觉到鼓点了！

english: A little mangy mutt. Can we keep 'em?
translation: 一只有点疥癣的小杂种狗。我们能养它吗？

english: Revert your Robe bottoms of the Eye (blue)?
translation: 要将你的眼之长袍下装 (蓝) 还原吗？

english: Don't give up! Freeze your partners then run behind a tree!
translation: 别放弃！冻结你的搭档们，然后跑到树后面！

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [player name]. However she appears to be ignoring me...
translation: 抱歉，我正想和 [player name] 说话。但她似乎在无视我……

english: I'll strengthen the bond!
translation: 我会强化这纽带！

english: Dunstan has given you the Spiked boots.
translation: 邓斯坦给了你钉鞋。

english: Here ya go! Thanks for getting my mom and dad away from the bad man!
translation: 给你！谢谢你把我爸爸妈妈从那个坏人手里救出来！

english: Answer the questions and ask the player back for their details.
translation: 回答问题，并反过来询问玩家的详细信息。

english: Off I go!
translation: 我出发了！

english: Revert your Robe top of the Eye (green)?
translation: 还原你的眼之长袍上衣 (绿)？

english: You can't carry any more floatsam.
translation: 你无法携带更多漂浮物了。

english: Good. Toetaller no want human show up to village and cry in front of Generals.
translation: 很好。脚趾高个不想人类出现在村庄，在将军们面前哭。

english: So there's nothing I could do to get you teach me how to charm rats?
translation: 那么我没办法让你教我如何魅惑老鼠了吗？

english: He called himself Ocellus.
translation: 他自称Ocellus。

english: Oh, thank you kindly! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
translation: 哦，太感谢你了！在下面的地窖里，你会找到四个齿轮。它们对我来说太重了，但你应该能一次搬一个。

english: Of course! How does 2,000 coins sound? I'll even throw in my cabin boy, Jenkins, for free! He'll swab the decks and splice the mainsails for you!
translation: 当然！2,000金币怎么样？我甚至免费附送我的船舱侍应詹金斯！他会为你擦洗甲板、拼接主帆！

english: I was going to nap on that tower!
translation: 我本来打算在那座塔上打个盹的！

english: The void... will take you...
translation: 虚空……将带走你……

english: Happy to help!
translation: 乐意帮忙！

english: Oh no, the angry talking earthquake is back!
translation: 哦不，那个愤怒的会说话的地震又回来了！

english: You sound slightly disappointed.
translation: 你听起来有点失望。

english: West
translation: 西

english: A lone knight?
translation: 一名孤身骑士？

english: Well, it just seemed polite to ask. We have all sorts of fun methods back home in Varlamore. We could give one or two of them a go if you want?
translation: 嗯，问一下只是出于礼貌。我们在瓦拉莫尔的家乡有各种有趣的方法。如果你愿意，我们可以试一两个？

english: Nope, still don't understand what you are talking about. What's a computer?
translation: 不，我还是不明白你在说什么。什么是电脑？

english: I was in an industriaaaaal aaaacideeent...
translation: 我经历了一场工工工工业业业业事故……

english: Whine
translation: 呜咽

english: Trick!
translation: 捣蛋！

english: I have no idea. She just started barking at me.
translation: 我完全不知道。她突然开始冲我叫。

english: You cannot fight against fate. This here is more proof of that.
translation: 你无法对抗命运。这就是更多的证据。

english: Wow, you're pretty cool, whatever you are!
translation: 哇，不管你是谁，你都挺酷的！

english: The whole band is complete! Thanks for your help.
translation: 整个乐队都齐了！谢谢你的帮助。

english: On Old School RuneScape and all fansites.
translation: 在Old School RuneScape及所有粉丝网站上。

english: You successfully dye your Robe top of the Eye (blue).
translation: 你成功将你的眼之长袍上衣 (蓝) 染色。

english: Ask about lost dogs.
translation: 询问走失的狗。

english: Greetings, adventurer. How can I be of service?
translation: 你好，冒险者。我能为你效劳吗？

english: I think I've done enough grave robbing.
translation: 我想我盗墓已经盗够了。

english: Good luck in there, [player name]. Leave the rest of the defence to us. We're almost there.
translation: 祝你在里面好运，[player name]。剩下的防御交给我们。我们快到了。

english: Excellent work! However, that isn't our only problem.
translation: 干得漂亮！不过，那不是我们唯一的问题。

english: Got it.
translation: 明白了。

english: Oh, don't worry, I'm totally fine. I locked myself in here for protection, but I've left the key somewhere.
translation: 哦，别担心，我完全没事。我把自己锁在这里是为了保护自己，但我把钥匙落在某处了。

english: Ah, knights. Let's see if you can evade them like I've often done.
translation: 啊，骑士。让我们看看你能否像我经常做的那样躲开他们。

english: You told me no such thing, and I am not a girl. She is, however.
translation: 你没跟我说过这种话，而且我不是女孩。不过她是。

english: I have it!
translation: 我拿到了！

english: Are you sure you want to do that?
translation: 你确定要那么做吗？

english: I'd like to customise it now.
translation: 我现在想自定义它。

english: Sounds like it. No luck in finding anyone then?
translation: 听起来是这样。那么没找到任何人？

english: Human got everything human need then. Waste goblin time by asking. Goblin time very important, can't waste.
translation: 那人类就得到人类需要的一切了。问问题浪费哥布林时间。哥布林时间很重要，不能浪费。

english: Trade in 1x Tome of Earth (empty) for 250x soiled pages?
translation: 用1x 大地之书 (空) 换取250x 染上污渍的书页？

english: Well done! Here you go.
translation: 干得好！给你。

english: [player name] is the best!
translation: [player name]最棒了！

english: Remember to freeze him, then run behind a tree!
translation: 记得冻住他，然后跑到树后面！

english: Amazing! Your opponent couldn't see the weapon until it was too late.
translation: 太棒了！你的对手直到为时已晚才看到武器。

english: You successfully dye your Robe top of the Eye.
translation: 你成功将你的眼之长袍上衣染色。

english: Ah Akrisae, welcome to my service.
translation: 啊，阿克里赛，欢迎为我效力。

english: You've still got the last lot I gave you! Don't be so greedy.
translation: 你还留着我上次给你的那批！别这么贪心。

english: Wonderful, you will all be happy and safe here!
translation: 太好了，你们在这里都会幸福又安全！

english: It means something to me.
translation: 它对我来说有意义。

english: You hear the sound of the flow gates resetting.
translation: 你听到流水闸门重置的声音。

english: You search the skeleton but find nothing of interest.
translation: 你搜索了骷髅，但没有发现任何有趣的东西。

english: You see some text scrolled above the altar on a symbol: Raw meat of jubbly bird and a lobster raw...
translation: 你看到祭坛上方的符号上滚动着一些文字：胖食人鸟的生肉和一只生龙虾……

english: Not yet. I can't remember where I was supposed to look.
translation: 还没有。我记不起我该去哪里找了。

english: Bark bark!
translation: 汪汪！

english: I felt... strangely compelled to? It's hard to explain. I just had the conviction that I needed to do it, no matter the consequences.
translation: 我感到……一种奇怪的冲动？很难解释。我就是坚信自己必须这么做，无论后果如何。

english: You create a stuffed dog. It will probably convince the goblins.
translation: 你制作了一只填充狗。它大概能骗过哥布林。

english: Earthquake! Earthquake!
translation: 地震了！地震了！

english: Ceremonial leaders are respected and looked up to as long as they lead the ceremony successfully. It's not usually my thing to stand in front of others, but maybe that's what it takes.
translation: 只要仪式领袖能成功主持仪式，就会受到尊敬和敬仰。站在别人面前通常不是我的风格，但也许这就是必须付出的代价。

english: Await... the void...
translation: 等待……虚空……

english: The Plain of Mud.
translation: 泥沼平原。

english: ... So I brought Aubury's notes to Sedridor, and from then on I was able to mine Rune Essence.
translation: ……于是我把奥伯里的笔记带给了塞德里克，从那以后我就能开采符文精华了。

english: The adamant kite shield is free to convert!
translation: 精金盾可以免费转换！

english: The mind is quiet, the coconut is not.
translation: 心是静的，椰子不是。

english: I suppose you're right, but I imagine many would consider there to be grey areas. If the world were in severe danger, and an artefact could help, many would want to leverage it.
translation: 我想你说得对，但我猜很多人会认为存在灰色地带。如果世界面临严重危险，而一件文物能帮上忙，很多人会想利用它。

english: Well, I've just spoken with Effigy about this tower. He tells me he hired you to work but you're on strike. Something about an extended tea break?
translation: 嗯，我刚和雕像谈过这座塔的事。他告诉我他雇你来干活，但你却在罢工。好像是因为延长了喝茶休息时间？

english: On a similar note, Lucien's forces also seem to be split in two. First we have Moia, a powerful necromancer leading a horde of skeletons.
translation: 同样地，卢西安的部队似乎也分成了两股。首先我们有莫伊娅，一位强大的死灵法师，率领着一群骷髅。

english: I'm afraid puppies don't work like that.
translation: 恐怕小狗不是那样运作的。

english: That's big dog...
translation: 那是大狗……

english: Aaaaah! No! I'm too old to die!
translation: 啊啊啊！不！我太老了，不能死！

english: You can't... escape... the end...
translation: 你无法……逃脱……终结……

english: You use your ancestral key to unlock the doors.
translation: 你用古老钥匙打开了门。

english: Aaaaaah!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！

english: Do you have sand in your ears, I said, 'What are you guarding?'
translation: 你耳朵里进沙子了吗，我说的是，“你在守卫什么？”

english: The Bernese Mountain Dog heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 伯恩山犬前往狗收容所。

english: Curious. I may have to use that one myself.
translation: 有意思。我或许得亲自用用那一招。

english: I'll start my search there then. You've been a great help!
translation: 那我就从那里开始找。你帮了大忙！

english: The stray dog cocks her head and begins to sniff the air.
translation: 流浪狗歪了歪头，开始嗅闻空气。

english: Greetings [player name]!
translation: 你好，[player name]！

english: Do your records say anything about this?
translation: 你的记录里有关于这个的任何记载吗？

english: This one go in direction of compromise.
translation: 这一个走向妥协的方向。

english: You shouldn't ignore a genie, Mistress [player name]?
translation: 你不该无视精灵，女主人 [player name]？

english: What's wrong? Have you caught their scent?
translation: 怎么了？你闻到它们的气味了吗？

english: You give Golrie the key.
translation: 你把钥匙交给了戈尔里。

english: We represent one side of the sphere too much. Order, justice... They are in a similar space. Even I myself lean outside of my usual balance due to Lucien.
translation: 我们过多地代表了球体的一面。秩序、正义……它们处于相似的位置。甚至我自己也因卢西安而偏离了通常的平衡。

english: Yarr! That's the spirit!
translation: 呀哈！这才对嘛！

english: Even I couldn't stop you from making that error!
translation: 连我都无法阻止你犯下那个错误！

english: There is nothing left here.
translation: 这里什么都不剩了。

english: Halloween.
translation: 万圣节。

english: Saradominist zeal, feed the flame!
translation: 萨拉多明信徒的热忱，为火焰添薪！

english: Human has returned.
translation: 人类回来了。

english: Of course, can't leave him behind.
translation: 当然，不能把他落下。

english: That stuck like the bank robbery charges.
translation: 那就像银行抢劫指控一样甩不掉了。

english: It takes a master to see the options I do!
translation: 只有大师才能看出我所看到的那些选择！

english: You will need a lockpick for this lock.
translation: 你需要一个开锁器才能打开这把锁。

english: Previous: Endurance (hard)
translation: 上一个：耐力（困难）

english: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend over there. He's looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.
translation: 你好！我是代表那边我的蟹朋友来的。他正在寻找能成为仪式领袖的蟹。

english: Sounds like you should play the smallest shell then. That one definitely requires finesse.
translation: 听起来你应该演奏最小的贝壳。那个绝对需要技巧。

english: Every other year.
translation: 每隔一年。

english: This bridge will hold a thousand marching soldiers once I'm done with it!
translation: 等我完工，这座桥能承受一千名行军的士兵！

english: More potions, coming up!
translation: 更多药水，马上就来！

english: You search the books
translation: 你翻找书籍

english: Hey there! I'm looking for ceremonial leaders to help my friend on the beach.
translation: 嘿！我正在寻找仪式领袖，来帮助我在海滩上的朋友。

english: When you put it like that, chaos does start to sound like an okay alternative.
translation: 听你这么一说，混乱听起来确实像是个还行的选择。

english: That's ridiculous, I won't hear another word from you.
translation: 太荒唐了，我一个字也不想再听你说。

english: It happens sometimes... I feel the urge to do something daft, like attacking someone I wanted to talk to. Sometimes I can resist it, and sometimes I can't.
translation: 有时会这样……我有种冲动想干些蠢事，比如攻击一个我本想交谈的人。有时我能忍住，有时忍不住。

english: The crab stares past you serenely.
translation: 螃蟹平静地越过你望向远方。

english: You kindly tense the string a bit more to tune the instrument to the pitch of the shells. The crab starts practising.
translation: 你友善地将琴弦再绷紧一些，使乐器调到贝壳的音高。螃蟹开始练习。

english: Hmm... Yes...
translation: 嗯……是的……

english: Codename: Pablo
translation: 代号：Pablo

english: Not much for dogs.
translation: 不太喜欢狗。

english: Look for more leaders.
translation: 寻找更多领袖。

english: Fetch
translation: 取物

english: When we sink, can I have yer stuff?
translation: 我们沉船的时候，能把你的东西给我吗？

english: I could think of a couple if needed, but truthfully, no. While many Saradominists dislike Guthix for banishing Saradomin, they forget that we are connected to him through faith, not his physical presence.
translation: 如果需要的话，我能想出几个，但说实话，没有。虽然许多萨拉多明信徒因古斯放逐萨拉多明而憎恨他，但他们忘了我们是通过信仰与他相连，而非他的实体存在。

english: Happy Halloween!
translation: 万圣节快乐！

english: Yes, return to where I was.
translation: 是的，回到我原来的地方。

english: Of course, anything for the hero who returned Fluffs to me.
translation: 当然，为那位把 Fluffs 还给我的英雄，什么都行。

english: We'll need... a ritual!
translation: 我们需要……一场仪式！

english: Good work, [player name]. Our forces have held so far, but the next foes await.
translation: 干得好，[player name]。我们的部队至今坚守住了，但下一个敌人正在等待。

english: Ah! Sorry. Thought that was a mouse.
translation: 啊！抱歉。我还以为那是只老鼠。

english: Your agent did well. We are a step closer to welcoming the Dark Lord into this realm. You will yet live to see Camelot crushed under foot.
translation: 你的特工干得不错。我们离迎接黑暗领主降临此界又近了一步。你终将活着看到卡米洛特被踏在脚下。

english: I'll feed the flames!
translation: 我来添火！

english: Oh dear! You must help her! Please, return to her at once!
translation: 天哪！你必须帮助她！请立刻回到她那里！

english: Pretty good! We've got enough leaders to practice properly. There's room for more, of course, but I expect if we don't look for them, they will come by themselves.
translation: 相当不错！我们有足够的领袖来好好练习了。当然还有更多空间，但我估计就算我们不去找，他们也会自己过来。

english: Unferth wouldn't have done that to me.
translation: 昂弗斯不会那样对我。

english: Hello there. My research on these crystals is going well. Don't forget, you can always help by mining some for me.
translation: 你好。我对这些水晶的研究进展顺利。别忘了，你随时可以帮我采一些来帮忙。

english: Your sole job will be to survive! It sounds easy, but let's put you to the test.
translation: 你唯一的任务就是活下去！听起来很简单，但让我们来考验你一下。

english: Could it be you're offering me a worthy challenge here?
translation: 难道你是在向我提出一个值得一战的挑战？

english: Hmm-mmm! I got you!
translation: 嗯嗯！抓到你了！

english: I'm afraid not, but for Ocellus to be guarding it, I fear it is of a power far beyond our understanding.
translation: 恐怕不知道，但既然 Ocellus 在守护它，我担心它的力量远超我们的理解。

english: The bonus shape has changed to the pentamid.
