translation: 奖励形状已变为五面体。

english: Then why are you here talking to me. Go help her find them!
translation: 那你为什么还在这里跟我说话。去帮她找它们啊！

english: Fascinating... and terrifying...
translation: 太迷人了……也太可怕了……

english: Delete it - it's a fake!
translation: 删掉它——这是假的！

english: Hey hey! It's okay, I'm not going to hurt you.
translation: 嘿嘿！没事的，我不会伤害你。

english: How odd. I can see her lips moving.... But there's no sound.
translation: 真奇怪。我能看到她的嘴唇在动……但没有声音。

english: You seem enthusiastic enough. Let's head out.
translation: 你看起来够热情了。我们出发吧。

english: The crab's voice trails off as he looks up towards the trees and his face, somehow, appears to turn redder.
translation: 螃蟹的声音渐渐消失，他抬头望向树林，他的脸不知怎的似乎变得更红了。

english: Burthorpe.
translation: 伯索普公国。

english: These High Priests always lack my experience on the battlefield.
translation: 这些大祭司总是缺乏我在战场上的经验。

english: Hang on, let me take something out of my pockets first.
translation: 等等，让我先从口袋里拿出点东西。

english: Dialogue 1:
translation: 对话 1：

english: Don't run away! I've got you right where I want you...
translation: 别跑！你正落在我想让你待的地方……

english: You can't possibly expect me to know that!
translation: 你总不能指望我知道那个吧！

english: Pleae
translation: 求求了

english: I am the record keeper's... yes 'the' record keeper's... apprentice.
translation: 我是记录保管人的……对，'那位'记录保管人的……学徒。

english: Ooh I love rituals!
translation: 哦，我爱死仪式了！

english: You inspect the horn-like item...
translation: 你仔细查看这个号角状的物品……

english: Observations thus far:
translation: 目前的观察结果：

english: Well, it will have to do. You're needed over at the palace.
translation: 好吧，也只能这样了。你需要去宫殿那边。

english: Thankfully, we're in a good place to hold them back, but any help you can provide is always appreciated. In the meantime, we're doing everything we can to find Lucien himself.
translation: 幸好我们处于有利位置，能够挡住他们，但你能提供的任何帮助我们都非常感激。与此同时，我们正竭尽全力寻找卢西安本人。

english: The Records certainly whisper to a similar rhythm.
translation: 《记录》确实以相似的韵律低语着。

english: We are just drawing a circle.
translation: 我们只是在画一个圆圈。

english: Take the crystals.
translation: 拿走水晶。

english: Wonderful, because our work has just begun!
translation: 太好了，因为我们的工作才刚刚开始！

english: Email them back with the information it asks for.
translation: 回复邮件，附上它要求的信息。

english: I'm STILL waiting for the bit where this wasn't a terrible idea.
translation: 我还在等那个证明这不算糟糕主意的部分呢。

english: ...cutting edge medical practices?
translation: ……最前沿的医疗手段？

english: That makes sense. And what's the book about?
translation: 有道理。那这本书讲的是什么？

english: Fireeeeeeeeee!
translation: 火火火火火火火！

english: You show the book to the Record Keeper.
translation: 你把书拿给记录保管员看。

english: I can try and explain. You pluck the string and you make a noise. You might be able to change the pitch by making the string shorter somehow.
translation: 我可以试着解释一下。你拨动琴弦，就会发出声音。你也许能通过某种方式缩短琴弦来改变音高。

english: Give Coins
translation: 给金币

english: Let us hope that you are right, for these are dark times indeed, [player name].
translation: 但愿你是对的，因为这确实是个黑暗的时代，[player name]。

english: Do you have sand in your ears? I said, 'What are you guarding?'
translation: 你耳朵里进沙子了吗？我说的是，‘你在守卫什么？’

english: Don't put supplies into the looting bag.
translation: 不要把补给品放进战利品袋。

english: Yelp!
translation: 嗷呜！

english: I already can't handle how awesome he is. If he was a ceremonial leader as well, how could I possibly approach him? I already can't!
translation: 我已经受不了他有多棒了。如果他还是个仪式领袖，我怎么可能接近他？我已经做不到了！

english: You show the goblins the stuffed dog.
translation: 你把填充狗拿给哥布林们看。

english: But to be honest, the only thing that really matters...
translation: 但说实话，唯一真正重要的……

english: What if you do? Messing up is a part of life. You fall and pick yourself back up again.
translation: 那又怎样？搞砸也是生活的一部分。跌倒了，再爬起来就好。

english: We can fight again, or you can leave using the portals on either side.
translation: 我们可以再打一场，或者你可以从两侧的传送门离开。

english: With the current state of affairs, practically anybody willing to help. But if I had my choice, I would try to make the alliance less... lopsided.
translation: 以目前的情况来看，任何愿意帮忙的人都行。但如果让我选，我会试着让联盟不那么……失衡。

english: How are the Temple Knights faring?
translation: 圣殿骑士们情况如何？

english: This be your last chance, [player name]!!
translation: 这是你最后的机会，[player name]！！

english: Hey, is that one of your puppies?
translation: 嘿，那是你的一只小狗吗？

english: Interesting. Could you read me one?
translation: 有意思。能给我读一首吗？

english: You use the Ancient fabric on the Imbued Saradomin cape to create an Imbued ancient cape.
translation: 你在被强化的萨拉多明斗篷上使用远古织物，制作出被强化的远古斗篷。

english: Greetings! You've proven you can handle my challenges. Now let's see how you fight against a real opponent.
translation: 你好！你已经证明能应付我的挑战。现在让我们看看你如何对抗真正的对手。

english: I don't think I'll make much headway along that icy slope without some spiked boots...
translation: 没有钉鞋的话，我想我很难在那片冰坡上前进……

english: This furnace is not hot enough to smelt elemental ore.
translation: 这个熔炉的温度不足以熔炼元素矿石。

english: Sniff sniff
translation: 嗅嗅

english: I'm not sure. What type of services do you provide?
translation: 我不确定。你提供什么类型的服务？

english: Your Amulet of the Eye has been reverted.
translation: 你的眼之护符已被还原。

english: Quite the selection.
translation: 选择还真不少。

english: There is a raw lobster placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一只生龙虾。

english: You receive 100x Blighted manta ray.
translation: 你获得了100x被污染的魔鬼鱼。

english: The child drops some sweets as they flee!
translation: 那孩子在逃跑时掉下了一些糖果！

english: Hey, how are you doing?
translation: 嘿，你怎么样？

english: It is likely one of Guthix's creations, left behind to defend the Archive from intruders.
translation: 它很可能是古斯吉克斯的造物之一，被留下来保护档案库免受入侵者侵扰。

english: As the swallow carries the coconut, the body must toil.
translation: 正如燕子承载椰子，身体也必须劳作。

english: Yo! The angry bird... Did it go?
translation: 哟！那只愤怒的鸟……它走了吗？

english: Oh. Sorry. You've come to the wrong crab!
translation: 哦。抱歉。你找错蟹了！

english: It's not long until the ceremony. We're going to get into position. Can you help us?
translation: 仪式马上就要开始了。我们要各就各位了。你能帮我们吗？

english: Well, there's nothing like a little dunk to sober you up a bit. Azali, come with me.
translation: 嗯，没什么比泡一下水更能让人清醒的了。阿扎利，跟我来。

english: Yes. The scouting report is spotty. Only one of our people made it back alive, but they were heavily wounded. Apparently this knight took out a whole squadron by himself.
translation: 是的。侦察报告断断续续。我们的人只有一个活着回来，而且身负重伤。据说这名骑士独自干掉了一整支小队。

english: Who would do such a thing?
translation: 谁会做出这种事？

english: Perhaps we could instead say that the world contains pockets of enduring goodness?
translation: 或许我们可以换个说法，说这世上仍存有持久不灭的善意？

english: I'd enjoy it a lot more if our destinations weren't generally so dangerous, but yes, I like seeing the world.
translation: 如果我们的目的地不是普遍这么危险，我会更享受得多，不过没错，我喜欢看看这个世界。

english: Bigger than Nosorog.
translation: 比Nosorog还大。

english: Hey kid, wanna see something scary?
translation: 嘿，小孩，想看点吓人的东西吗？

english: Never mind! Every other ceremonial leader will use either seashells or coconuts. Maybe I'd stand out more if I played something else...
translation: 算了！其他所有仪式领袖都会用海螺或椰子。也许我演奏点别的会更出众……

english: I suppose they are right, [player name]. You have done us a great service. I would like to offer you something in return.
translation: 我想他们说得对，[player name]。你为我们立了大功。我想给你一些回报。

english: Okay, have a bite. (Offer a blood tithe).
translation: 好吧，咬一口。（献上一份血税）。

english: Anyway, what instrument do you play?
translation: 话说回来，你演奏什么乐器？

english: Nicely done! 3/5.
He fell nobly.
translation: 他英勇地倒下了。

english: I know that, and yet I can't help it. I have this uneasy feeling that I don't belong... But I just really want to be accepted.
translation: 我知道，可我就是忍不住。我总有种不安的感觉，觉得自己格格不入……但我真的很想被接纳。

english: Hello agai-
translation: 又见面——

english: That explains why she went missing for so long. Are the puppies still there?
translation: 这就解释了为什么她失踪了那么久。小狗们还在那里吗？

english: You decide against drinking from the bottle after all.
translation: 你最终还是决定不喝瓶子里的东西。

english: Ah... I am sorry to hear that, friend. It is true that evil's grip has been tight of late. Even the strongest resolves are being tested.
translation: 啊……听到这个我很遗憾，朋友。确实，近来邪恶的掌控愈发紧逼。就连最坚定的意志也在经受考验。

english: Cool, isn't it?
translation: 很酷，对吧？

english: : Sorry, I must have misunderstood your instructions. Could I hear them again please?
translation: ：抱歉，我一定是误解了你的指示。能请你再说一遍吗？

english: Recolour your Robe top of the Eye (red)?
translation: 要为你的眼之长袍上衣 (红) 重新着色吗？

english: My defenses won't fall for your tricks!
translation: 我的防御不会中你的诡计！

english: You're crazy. The only thing you will find out here in the desert is your death.
translation: 你疯了。在这沙漠里你唯一能找到的就是你的死亡。

english: Perhaps you'll see them again one day.
translation: 也许有一天你会再见到他们。

english: The Gielinor Union of Undead Creatures, Plumbers and Allied Tradesmen.
translation: 盖林诺亡灵生物、水管工及同业工匠联合会。

english: Yes, but it's clear that now is very much not the right time for it to be opened. And so our duty now is to guard it rather than bury it.
translation: 是的，但很明显现在绝不是打开它的合适时机。所以我们现在的职责是守护它，而不是埋葬它。

english: Come and talk to me if you'd like to replay the final challenge or leave.
translation: 如果你想重玩最终挑战或离开，就来和我谈谈。

english: What we really need is someone worldly who can bring strays back for us.
translation: 我们真正需要的是一个见多识广、能为我们带回流浪动物的人。

english: What's the current situation? Have your soldiers entered the Archive already?
translation: 目前情况如何？你的士兵已经进入档案馆了吗？

english: To pass you must answer me this: Who is it okay to share my account with?
translation: 要通过，你必须回答我这个问题：我可以和谁共享我的账户？

english: Ha! I suppose I am a little winded. Our opponents are fierce, and our resources are few and spread thin. However, you need not worry about me.
translation: 哈！我想我是有点喘不过气了。我们的对手很凶猛，而我们的资源稀少且分散。不过，你不必为我担心。

english: I know your game guttersnipe.
translation: 我识破你的把戏了，小混混。

english: I guess I will never know...
translation: 我想我永远也不会知道了……

english: You need a raw lobster to do that.
translation: 你需要一条生龙虾才能这么做。

english: Perhaps I should replace Unferth with you.
translation: 也许我该用你来取代昂弗斯。

english: Life and death, at our command!
translation: 生死，皆听我们号令！

english: A horn, Your Majesty. It has an engraving that looks like the symbol of Camelot.
translation: 一只号角，陛下。上面刻有看起来像卡美洛符号的纹样。

english: With my wife, Talia, yes.
translation: 是的，和我的妻子塔莉亚一起。

english: Maybe Bentnoze take this choice instead.
translation: 也许这次让Bentnoze来做这个选择。

english: Thank you, [player name]. We're almost there. There are only two sets of intruders left.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。我们快到了。只剩下两批入侵者了。

english: Um... can I fish here then please?
translation: 呃……那请问我可以在这里钓鱼吗？

english: I think [player name] should be the ruler of Halloween!
translation: 我觉得[player name]应该当万圣节的统治者！

english: That one sounds absolutely awful. Yeet!
translation: 那个听起来糟透了。扔！

english: You are not worthy of holding that Diamond of Smoke!
translation: 你不配持有那颗烟雾钻石！

english: Your Robe top of the Eye (green) has been reverted.
translation: 你的眼之长袍上衣 (绿) 已被还原。

english: Fare-thee-well, Aspirant, we watch you with great interest.
translation: 再会了，见习者，我们饶有兴致地注视着你。

english: I'm scared!
translation: 我好害怕！

english: You're not from around here, are you? Very well, then, I will explain.
translation: 你不是本地人，对吧？那好吧，我来解释一下。

english: I don't think people would be very happy if I did that.
translation: 我觉得如果我那么做，人们不会很高兴的。

english: I doubt she'd leave her puppies alone with the goblins. I bet she's gone back there to keep them safe.
translation: 我不信她会把幼犬单独留给哥布林。我敢说她回那儿去保护它们了。

english: I wanted to ask you about something. Does the name Ocellus mean anything to you?
translation: 我想问你点事。Ocellus 这个名字对你有意义吗？

english: Wrong gear. Streak reset.
translation: 齿轮不对。连胜重置。

english: Your money or your life, [player name]!
translation: 要钱还是要命，[player name]！

english: I'd be happy to contribute to the records!
translation: 我很乐意协助记录！

english: Previous: Customisable Rumble (hard)
translation: 上一个：可自定义的隆隆声（困难）

english: Dungeon stairs room
translation: 地牢楼梯房间

english: Okay then. Try this potion. Do you need anything else?
translation: 好吧。试试这瓶药水。你还需要别的什么吗？

english: I don't feel like helping right now.
translation: 我现在不想帮忙。

english: Wait a minute - am I going to have to translate everything he says using that dictionary again?
translation: 等等——我是不是又得用那本字典来翻译他说的每一句话？

english: He told me quite a story. You may want to take notes...
translation: 他给我讲了一个相当精彩的故事。你也许想记些笔记……

english: Right, well, the bird hide is done. Are we going to start observing?
translation: 好了，鸟舍已经建好了。我们要开始观察了吗？

english: Erm, good luck with that.
translation: 呃，祝你好运吧。

english: How was I supposed to bury your daughter again?
translation: 我到底该怎么安葬你的女儿来着？

english: Not right now, but maybe another time.
translation: 现在不行，也许改天吧。

english: No! You're not putting your hands on my things!
translation: 不行！你别想碰我的东西！

english: Break down your spike into 80 shards?
translation: 将你的尖刺分解为80个碎片？

english: Decline the offer and report that player.
translation: 拒绝该提议并举报那名玩家。

english: The bonesack
translation: 骨袋

english: Two-factor authentication on your account and your registered email.
translation: 为你的账户和注册邮箱开启双重验证。

english: Nonsense, old boy, we take our work very seriously. The fate of the world rests in our hands, don't you know.
translation: 胡说，老伙计，我们对工作可是非常认真的。世界的命运就掌握在我们手中，你难道不知道吗。

english: Create perfect killing edge... very good for sword.
translation: 打造完美的杀戮之刃……对剑来说非常不错。

english: We are all related, brother, for we are all children of the flame.
translation: 我们血脉相连，兄弟，因为我们都是火焰之子。

english: Row out to sea, north of the island.
translation: 划船出海，到岛屿以北。

english: I don't know, it looks rough out there.
translation: 我不知道，外面看起来风浪很大。

english: Create a key using the key print?
translation: 用钥匙印模制作一把钥匙？

english: It incorporates your real name or birthday.
translation: 它包含你的真实姓名或生日。

english: Insert your cat (Wily hellcat).
translation: 放入你的猫（机灵的地狱猫）。

english: 'Always to slay enemies of Big High War God! Enemies must die!' This mean we slay other races who not believe.
translation: “永远要杀死大高战争之神的敌人！敌人必须死！”这意味着我们要杀死那些不信奉的其他种族。

english: I'll need to wield a more appropriate tool.
translation: 我需要使用更合适的工具。

english: How do I get an invitation?
translation: 我怎样才能得到邀请？

english: I'm very sorry but you need to complete more quests before you can go on this quest. Additionally you need to gain 46 more quest points. They don't call it the Legends Guild for nothing you know!
translation: 非常抱歉，但你需要完成更多任务才能进行这个任务。此外，你还需要再获得46个任务点数。毕竟它叫传说公会可不是白叫的，你知道的！

english: Crate of platebodies (The Pandemonium).
translation: 装有胸甲的箱（潘德莫尼姆岛）。

english: It could be dangerous in there. Are you sure you want to enter?
translation: 里面可能很危险。你确定要进去吗？

english: Okay, which route should we take?
translation: 好吧，我们该走哪条路线？

english: What would you like to take from the cupboard?
translation: 你想从橱柜里拿什么？

english: Do you wish to create a pair of avernic treads (pr)(pe)?
translation: 你希望制作一双阿弗尼克战靴 (祈祷)(PE)吗？

english: Cancel port task: Pandemonium rum delivery?
translation: 取消港口任务：潘德莫尼姆朗姆酒运送？

english: Thank you, [player name]. I appreciate that neither you nor Persten meant for things to go this way.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。我很感激你和Persten都不是有意让事情变成这样的。

english: Your new task is to kill 106 Wyrms.
translation: 你的新任务是杀死106条蛇龙。

english: Take from pile of notes.
translation: 从笔记堆中拿取。

english: I have a message from Malcolm. He wants you to know that he still loves you, despite his ghostly state.
translation: 我带来了马尔科姆的口信。他想让你知道，尽管他已是幽灵之身，他仍然爱你。

english: Don't destroy it.
translation: 别摧毁它。

english: Carlem...
translation: 卡勒姆……

english: ~ next ~
translation: ~ 下一页 ~

english: Have a complicated password set to my email.
translation: 为我的电子邮箱设置一个复杂的密码。

english: Buying 450 additional bank slots will cost 888,000,000 coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
translation: 购买450个额外银行栏位将花费888,000,000金币。请注意，此购买不可撤销。你确定要继续吗？

english: Carlem
translation: 卡勒姆

english: And a good day to you, my child.
translation: 也祝你美好的一天，我的孩子。

english: Clockwork mouse
translation: 发条老鼠

english: Hmm... Nahta will know what to do with these. [player name], take them to her in Cam Torum's magic shop. Tell her I sent you.
translation: 嗯……纳赫塔会知道该怎么处理这些。 [player name]，把它们带到卡姆托鲁姆魔法商店交给她。告诉她是我派你来的。

english: Er.... okay.
translation: 呃……好吧。

english: There's a trapdoor hidden under the crates.
translation: 板条箱下藏着一个活板门。

english: Do you wish to create a pair of avernic treads (max)?
translation: 你希望制作一双阿弗尼克战靴 (最大)吗？

english: I am afraid I have lost the boat you gave to me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的船弄丢了。

english: Thankfully, since the quarantine started, the Pharaoh has still allowed the dead to be transported here if that was their wish. However, I fear he will soon prevent that as well.
translation: 庆幸的是，自隔离开始以来，法老仍允许将死者运送到这里，只要那是他们的意愿。然而，我担心他很快就会连这也禁止。

english: Ok, I suppose it's my job. You have: 0 Telekinetic, 0 Alchemist, 0 Enchantment, and 0 Graveyard Pizazz Points.
translation: 好吧，我想这是我的工作。你有：0 念力、0 炼金、0 附魔和 0 墓地风采点数。

english: Yes... that sample you showed me had very similar properties to Law runes. I believe that the fungus ring could create an effect similar to my moving-over- distance spheres.
translation: 是的……你给我看的那个样本与律法符石的性质非常相似。我相信那个蘑菇环能产生类似我的远距离移动球体的效果。

english: Certainly, mortal. Here's 10 ectotokens.
translation: 当然，凡人。这是10枚异界代币。

english: Stop right there, sir. You can tell Willow she can do the heavy lifting herself.
translation: 站住，先生。你可以告诉柳木，重活她可以自己干。

english: Indeed. I have determined precisely how to cook them for so that they become edible. I finally got around to repairing that statue too!
translation: 确实。我已经精确确定了如何烹饪它们，使它们变得可食用。我终于也抽空修好了那座雕像！

english: I'm still up for joining the Temple Knights, I just don't really feel like spending five years running around shining peoples boots for them.
translation: 我仍然愿意加入圣殿骑士，我只是不太想花五年时间到处替他们给人擦靴子。

english: It is often the way under Pharaoh Kemesis. He leads the Menaphites in a more secular manner than we would like. Respect for the old ways is diminishing.
translation: 在法老凯米西斯统治下常常如此。他以比我们所愿更世俗的方式领导梅纳菲特人。对古老传统的尊重正在减少。

english: Have you now, laddie? I was wondering when they'd send someone.
translation: 是吗，小伙子？我还在想他们什么时候会派人来。

english: Cancel port task: Musa Point logs delivery?
translation: 取消港口任务：穆萨角原木运送？

english: Thanks; I'll remember that.
translation: 谢谢；我会记住的。

english: Crate of furs (Catherby).
translation: 装有毛皮的箱（凯瑟比镇）。

english: Why are you hanging around in a scorpion pit?
translation: 你为什么在蝎子坑里闲逛？

english: Yes, it seems to be getting more dangerous in Morytania doesn't it?
translation: 是的，莫利塔尼亚似乎变得越来越危险了，不是吗？

english: This is My Arm. We'd like to go to Karamja.
translation: 这是"我的手臂"。我们想去卡拉姆詹岛。

english: Switch to world 362?
translation: 切换到世界362？

english: Cancel port task: Port Sarim coconut delivery?
translation: 取消港口任务：沙林港椰子运送？

english: Take some yellow dye.
translation: 拿一些黄色染料。

english: Okay, okay. The other day I was drying my clothes on a line down by the shore. A storm hit and some of my clothing went missing.
translation: 好吧，好吧。前几天我在岸边晾衣服。一场暴风雨袭来，我的一些衣服不见了。

english: I should have a beer with my kebab as well. I'd better get another kebab from the kebab seller and return here.
translation: 我还应该配着烤肉喝杯啤酒。我最好再从烤肉商那里买一份烤肉，然后回到这里。

english: There are no fish in the net.
translation: 网里没有鱼。

english: Buy more for 500 coins.
translation: 再花500金币购买更多。

english: I threw it down the Edgeville well like you told me.
translation: 我照你说的把它扔进了边陲镇的水井里。

english: * Ranged *
translation: * 远程 *

english: Fascinating... a crystal seed. You should have a look at the crystal bowl in the other room. Must be related...
translation: 真有趣……一颗水晶种子。你该去看看另一个房间里的水晶碗。它们一定有关联……

english: Gillie Groats the Milkmaid
translation: 挤奶女工吉利.格罗茨

english: --- Go to Skill Menu 2 ----
translation: --- 前往技能菜单 2 ----

english: Can we go visit Gertrude? I'd like to see her again, she's very nice.
translation: 我们能去看望格特鲁德吗？我想再见到她，她人很好。

english: I've filled stodgy mattresses with feathers, made pot lids to help cure an ailing metal-smith....and that's all the thanks I get? 'Thanks!'
translation: 我用羽毛填满了笨重的床垫，做了罐盖来帮助治愈一位生病的金属工匠……这就是我得到的全部感谢？‘谢谢！’

english: About those camels. I've lost the receipt. Can I have another?
translation: 关于那些骆驼。我把收据弄丢了。能再给我一张吗？

english: Of course you are, old boy. Now you will need access to some of the more restricted resources of the Temple Knights.
translation: 你当然可以，老伙计。现在你需要获取圣殿骑士团一些更机密的资源。

english: Menaphos
translation: 梅纳福斯

english: Talk about your mission.
translation: 谈谈你的任务。

english: Oh, no, not another favour! I just can't do another one!
translation: 哦，不，别再帮忙了！我实在没法再帮一次了！

english: Select a tool
translation: 选择一件工具

english: --- More ---
Who are all the other people here?
translation: 这里其他那些人都是谁？

english: * Defence *
translation: * 防御 *

english: Take it down.
translation: 把它取下来。

english: Thank you. I need 26 more.
translation: 谢谢你。我还需要26个。

english: Pandemonium platebody delivery.
translation: 潘德莫尼姆板甲运送。

english: Start the Enakhra's Lament quest?
translation: 开始伊纳克拉的哀歌任务？

english: A crunchy tray
translation: 一个脆饼烤盘

english: Of course, my lord, I meant no disrespect.
translation: 当然，我的大人，我无意冒犯。

english: That ice looks three feet thick! I don't think I can melt it using a normal fire.
translation: 那冰看起来有三英尺厚！我觉得用普通的火是融化不了它的。

english: No, I'll keep the Bone Key.
translation: 不，我要留着骨匙。

english: Your hands are full.
translation: 你的双手已经满了。

english: Of course, my lord. I trust you will find it all there and in good order.
translation: 当然，我的大人。我相信您会发现一切都在那里，井然有序。

english: Wowee! Let me just write those down for you.
translation: 哇哦！让我帮你把这些记下来。

english: You are correct.
translation: 你说得对。

english: You're right with that one, laddie. Someone or something has made a small hole in the Doors.
translation: 你说得对，小伙子。某人或某物在门上弄出了一个小洞。

english: Many salutations to you. Have you made any progress in uncovering the reasons for our curse yet?
translation: 向你致以诚挚的问候。你查明我们诅咒的原因有什么进展了吗？

english: Talk about Caranock...
translation: 谈谈卡兰诺克……

english: Mord
translation: 莫德

english: Give them your password since they're a friend in real life.
translation: 既然他是现实中的朋友，就把你的密码告诉他吧。

english: Don't give out your password to anyone. Not even close friends.
translation: 不要把你的密码告诉任何人。即使是亲密的朋友也不行。

english: Purchai
translation: 普尔柴

english: I am trying to get to the bottom of the feud between you and the Bandits.
translation: 我正在努力查明你和强盗之间世仇的真相。

english: Tell me more about this 'makeover'.
translation: 跟我详细说说这个“改造”吧。

english: Well, in that case, why don't you take this kebab to one of our connoisseurs outside and see what they reckon.
translation: 那么，既然如此，你为什么不把这烤肉拿给外面的某位行家，看看他们怎么评价。

english: I discovered some disturbing yet heroic information about the vampyres of Morytania.
translation: 我发现了一些关于莫利塔尼亚吸血鬼的令人不安却又英勇的信息。

english: What do you want to talk to the King about?
translation: 你想和国王谈什么？

english: I feel like you're not being totally honest with me.
translation: 我觉得你没有完全对我说实话。

english: Caranock suggested they were blown off course by extreme southerly winds.
translation: 卡拉诺克认为他们是被强烈的南风吹离了航线。

english: Once you have solved the maze, the statue will change back into the Guardian and he will award you with Telekinetic Pizazz Points and teleport you to the next maze.
translation: 一旦你解开了迷宫，雕像就会变回守护者，他会奖励你念力华丽点数，并将你传送到下一个迷宫。

english: Yes, I can. I see you already have the ingredients - the water, flour, ashes and redberries. Would you like me to mix some for you now?
translation: 是的，我可以。我看你已经有了材料——水、面粉、灰烬和红莓。你想让我现在为你混合一些吗？

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a embertailed jerboa. You'll need to bring back its tail.
translation: 你目前正在为我狩猎。这个传闻是关于一只焰尾跳鼠的。你需要带回它的尾巴。

english: Hmm... time to move over to the grindstone.
translation: 嗯……该去磨石那边了。

english: There's been rumours of a rare barb-tailed kebbit coming in. Once you find it, bring back some of its fur.
translation: 有传闻说一只稀有的钩尾凯比特兔出现了。一旦你找到它，就带回一些它的毛皮。

english: Yes, I have what we need.
translation: 是的，我已经有了我们需要的东西。

english: Dark wizards
translation: 黑巫师

english: Do you have a favourite dish?
translation: 你有最喜欢的菜肴吗？

english: That's great to hear. Anything I can help with?
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Spellbook/portal default: Varrock
translation: 法术书/传送门默认：维洛克城

english: Start the Eagles' Peak quest?
translation: 开始鹰峰任务吗？

english: Libra
translation: 天秤座

english: Thank you, madam. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: 谢谢你，女士。变成一只鸡真是太难受了。我该怎么感谢你呢？

english: I should talk to Kovac before I start pouring metal.
translation: 在开始浇铸金属之前，我应该先和科瓦克谈谈。

english: Recover and repair your boat for 375 coins?
translation: 花费375金币修复并修理你的船？

english: Perhaps I need a bolt of linen as well to craft a gem pouch with this silk.
translation: 也许我还需要一卷亚麻布，才能用这些丝绸制作一个宝石袋。

english: Hello again. Well done on freeing Prince Ali.
translation: 又见面了。恭喜你解救了阿里王子。

english: Yes, don't ask again.
translation: 是的，别再问了。

english: Would you like to fill a jug with coolant?
translation: 你想用冷却液装满一个壶吗？

english: What is there to do in Lovakengj?
translation: 在洛瓦肯吉城有什么可做的？

english: That would be me, sir. What can I do for you?
translation: 那就是我，先生。有什么能为您效劳的？

english: Recover your boat for 3,750 coins? Some cargo will be lost.

translation: 双子座

english: Ok, I will bring you some Karamja Rum.
translation: 好，我会给你带一些卡拉姆詹朗姆酒来。

english: Well, just one small favour... and then I'll do you a small favour.
translation: 嗯，就一个小忙……然后我就帮你一个小忙。

english: Malcolm says he won't trust me with the bank pass.
translation: 马尔科姆说他不放心把银行通行证交给我。

english: Cancel port task: Port Sarim amulet delivery?
translation: 取消港口任务：沙林港护符运送？

english: It is someone else with whom I desire to speak, but she seems to be preoccupied.
translation: 我想交谈的是另一个人，但她似乎正忙。

english: Wow. I swear we've seen him five times already.
translation: 哇。我发誓我们已经见过他五次了。

english: I am a nagua of earth and streams. Being close to both empowers me to do my task. Just as being far from moonlight weakens the Moons of Peril.
translation: 我是土与溪流的纳瓜。靠近两者能赋予我力量去完成我的任务。正如远离月光会削弱灾厄之月。

english: Agree to pay 5,000 coins?
translation: 同意支付5,000金币吗？

english: Well, let's not start celebrating just yet. There's a reason why we're lurking in this crypt.
translation: 好了，先别急着庆祝。我们潜伏在这座墓穴里是有原因的。

english: He was plotting to start a war between the Gnomes and humankind.
translation: 他正密谋挑起地精与人类之间的战争。

english: They never cease to bother me. They swarm around me like flies, all hoping to win my attention.
translation: 他们从不停止烦扰我。他们像苍蝇一样围着我转，都希望能得到我的关注。

english: Aquarius
translation: 水瓶座

english: No way! I'm reporting you to Jagex!
translation: 不可能！我要向Jagex举报你！

english: You've got one of the feathers somewhere - off you go.
translation: 你已经在某处拿到了其中一根羽毛——去吧。

english: Okay, I'll check things out then and report back.
translation: 好吧，那我去查看一下情况，然后回来汇报。

english: Yes - release them
translation: 是的——释放它们

english: Clockwork penguin
translation: 发条企鹅

english: Oh, what I have to deal with these days - to think this is what being a Queen has become. Very well then: would you... good sir help me with a little project of mine?
translation: 唉，如今我要应付这些事——想想当个女王竟变成了这样。那好吧：你……好先生，愿意帮我做个小项目吗？

english: Scorpio
translation: 天蝎座

english: Well, you're a customs officer, right?
translation: 嗯，你是海关官员，对吧？

english: Builder 1
translation: 建筑工人1

english: Well done - I feel this serum is really working on me. I think you've cracked it, my friend! I'd like to give you something for your trouble!
translation: 干得好——我觉得这血清对我真的有效。我想你已经成功了，朋友！我想给你点东西作为酬谢！

english: Well, in that case, just through there is the lab we use to produce potions for the kingdom. However, before you head in and get started, there's a couple of things to note.
translation: 嗯，既然这样，那边就是我们为王国生产药水的实验室。不过，在你进去开始之前，有几件事要注意。

english: Oh... Well, I suppose I can help then, as long as you make it quick. What did you say you needed?
translation: 哦……好吧，既然这样，只要你能快点，我想我可以帮忙。你说你需要什么？

english: Well, it's less boring than what I've done before, so I can't complain!
translation: 嗯，这比我以前做的事没那么无聊，所以我没什么好抱怨的！

english: To pass you must answer me this: A player trades you some valuable items, provides you a bond, then asks if you want to share your account so he can help you make progress. How do you respond?
translation: 要通过，你必须回答我这个问题：一名玩家与你交易了一些贵重物品，给了你一张债券，然后问你是否愿意共享账号，好让他帮你推进进度。你如何回应？

english: So, he's been keeping an eye on you while you do important magical research...
translation: 所以，在你进行重要的魔法研究时，他一直在盯着你……

english: We stick to bronze and iron for this sword... We keep the first sword simple.
translation: 这把剑我们只用青铜和铁……第一把剑保持简单。

english: You best not be here to start any trouble, sir.
translation: 先生，你最好不是来惹麻烦的。

english: Because we have a ban on the import and export of certain intoxicating spirits.
translation: 因为我们禁止某些致醉烈酒的进出口。

english: So then, old bean; with that in mind, we have a mission for you.
translation: 那么，老伙计；考虑到这一点，我们有个任务交给你。

english: Aye, you do that. Remember, it takes four balls of wool to make strong rope.
translation: 是啊，你就这么做吧。记住，制作结实的绳子需要四团羊毛。

english: You can, but you'll need to be searched before you can board.
translation: 可以，但登船前你需要接受搜查。

english: Perhaps I should use the needle with the leather instead.
translation: 也许我应该改用针来缝皮革。

english: Exchange Big bones?
translation: 兑换大骨头？

english: So you can't be anymore specific about where to look for these warriors and their diamonds?
translation: 所以你说不出更具体的地点，来寻找这些战士和他们的钻石吗？

english: Two woad leaves and five coins to you.
translation: 两片菘蓝叶和五枚金币归你。

english: You're still hunting monkeys; you have 27 to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 你还在猎杀猴子；还剩27只。完成任务后再回来。

english: Three lots of redberries and five coins to you.
translation: 三份红莓和五枚金币归你。

english: 2: Ardougne
translation: 2：阿多尼城

english: Do you have any other quests for me? That last one of yours was fun!
translation: 你还有别的任务给我吗？你上一个任务真有趣！

english: Clockwork doll
translation: 发条玩偶

english: I don't think you need to worry about that. Now, I'd better go and speak with Commander Fullore.
translation: 我觉得你不用担心那个。现在，我最好去和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: Here ya go, mister! Thanks for getting my mom and dad away from the bad man!
translation: 给你，先生！谢谢你把我爸爸妈妈从坏人那里救出来！

english: Oh! Okay then. So, what did you need me to do?
translation: 哦！那好吧。那么，你需要我做什么？

english: Death rune: Really put it down?
translation: 死亡符石：真的要放下吗？

english: Enter the Crypt?
translation: 进入墓穴？

english: Correct! Allowing someone else to use your account means they may steal it, or may get it banned by cheating on it.
translation: 正确！让别人使用你的账户意味着他们可能会盗走它，或者可能因作弊而导致它被封禁。

english: That's unnecessary...
translation: 那没必要……

english: You see a picture of the sun getting eaten and instead of a warning, you see evidence of your god? You really are beyond saving.
translation: 你看到一幅太阳被吞噬的图画，却看不到警告，反而看到了你神明存在的证据？你真是无可救药了。

english: This is the Hosidius Kitchen. Here, under my expert eye, we prepare the finest food in all of Kourend.
translation: 这里是霍西迪乌斯城厨房。在这里，在我的专业眼光下，我们制作全库兰德王国最上等的食物。

english: Hmm... How strange that you don't. Well anyway, it has been some days since last I heard from Drezel, the priest who lives there. Be a sport and go check in on the silly old codger for me, would you?
translation: 嗯……你没有，真是奇怪。好吧，总之，我已经好几天没听到住在那里的祭司德雷泽尔的消息了。帮个忙，替我去看看那个糊涂的老家伙，好吗？

english: Cancel port task: Pandemonium platebody delivery?
translation: 取消港口任务：潘德莫尼姆胸甲运送？

english: Sorry, this is all just very confusing.
translation: 抱歉，这一切实在太令人困惑了。

english: Erm, yes... Anyway, I managed to get half the Shield of Arrav back.
translation: 呃，是的……总之，我设法拿回了阿拉夫之盾的一半。

english: 1: Varrock
translation: 1：维洛克城

english: Insert your cat (Hell cat).
translation: 放入你的猫（地狱猫）。

english: A gnome bowl
translation: 一个地精碗

english: * Crafting *
translation: * 制作 *

english: Correct! Enabling two-factor authentication on your email account wil help protect your email account from hijackers.
translation: 正确！为你的电子邮箱账户启用双重验证将有助于保护你的邮箱账户免遭盗用。

english: About the treaty with the Karamjan Monkeys...
translation: 关于与卡拉姆詹猴的条约……

english: Seed
translation: 种子

english: Meiyerditch.
translation: 迈尔迪奇。

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a sapphire glacialis. You'll need to bring back one of its wings.
translation: 你目前正在为我狩猎。这个传闻是关于蓝宝石冰蝶的。你需要带回它的一片翅膀。

english: Clue
translation: 线索

english: Apologies, but I was sent to tell you that one of the nagua from the ruins managed to bypass our defenses.
translation: 抱歉，但我被派来告诉你，废墟中的一只纳瓜设法绕过了我们的防御。

english: Mount the bloody head?
translation: 要挂上沾满血的头颅吗？

english: Dye the fur head?
translation: 要给毛皮头颅染色吗？

english: I have no plans to branch out into cat potions at the moment, but if there was sufficient demand for them I might well change my mind.
translation: 我目前没有拓展猫用药水的打算，但如果需求足够大，我很可能会改变主意。

english: Malcolm says he put the cash in the bank.
translation: 马尔科姆说他把现金存进了银行。

english: Crypt! Again... very creepy! You must have some strange hobbies.
translation: 墓穴！又来了……真够瘆人的！你一定有些奇怪的爱好。

english: I have seen proof with my own eyes. If you think otherwise, then you have been fooled as well.
translation: 我亲眼见过证据。如果你不这么认为，那你也一样被骗了。

english: I have the logs, five chickens, ten bundles of grain and the dirty clothes.
translation: 我有原木、五只鸡、十捆谷物和那些脏衣服。

english: Take both vials
translation: 拿走两个小瓶

english: Previous...
translation: 上一个……

english: That's... great!
translation: 那真是……太好了！

english: Great. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 太好了。这事就交给你了。

english: Ok, okay... what do you want so I can get rid of you and continue with my sermon?
translation: 好吧，好吧……你想要什么，好让我摆脱你继续布道？

english: Ok then! Great... tell me a little more about these chicken cages... Cough Cough Cough!
translation: 那好吧！太好了……再跟我讲讲这些鸡笼的事……咳 咳 咳！

english: Crate of rum (Brimhaven).
translation: 装有朗姆酒的箱（布尔哈文镇）。

english: Have you got Dinh's Hammer yet, laddie?
translation: 小伙子，你拿到丁的锤了吗？

english: I think I've done enough fighting here. I should head back to Lady Servil.
translation: 我想我在这里已经打得够多了。我该回到塞尔维尔夫人那里了。

english: Empty the jug.
translation: 倒空壶。

english: Looking to market another one of his business ideas is he? It will cost him double this time. We still haven't cleaned up the mess made by his last great idea.
translation: 他又想推销他的另一个商业点子了？这次他得付双倍代价。我们还没收拾完他上次那个“伟大点子”留下的烂摊子。

english: Play it safe.
translation: 保险起见。

english: No, really, it is! They're trying to observe humans to learn our weaknesses.
translation: 不，真的，就是这样！他们想观察人类来了解我们的弱点。

english: Right... So you want me to go and kill six brothers and bring you back an icon?
translation: 好吧……所以你想让我去杀掉六个兄弟，再给你带回来一个图标？

english: Start the Animal Magnetism quest?
translation: 开始动物磁力任务？

english: Enter the ruins?
translation: 进入废墟？

english: As for where to sell things, that depends. The quick and easy way is to sell to a General Store. They're easy to find and will accept almost anything, but they're unlikely to give you the best prices.
translation: 至于去哪里卖东西，那要看情况。最快最简单的方法是卖给杂货店。它们很容易找到，而且几乎什么都收，但不太可能给你最好的价格。

english: Well, in general you'll find that practice makes perfect. The best way to improve a skill is to quite simply keep working at it.
translation: 嗯，总的来说，你会发现熟能生巧。提升技能最好的方法就是坚持不懈地练习。

english: Er... What are you doing?
translation: 呃……你在干什么？

english: On that topic, you can improve your smithing by smelting ores into bars and then by smithing those bars into weapons and armour. Might be you'll want those weapons and armour yourself, or you could sell them.
translation: 关于这一点，你可以通过将矿石熔炼成锭，再将锭锻造成武器和盔甲来提升你的锻造技能。这些武器和盔甲你可能想留着自己用，也可以卖掉。

english: This is hardly the Shayzien Prison. These walls are rotting away! There must be a way through one of them.
translation: 这哪像谢兹恩城的监狱。这些墙都在腐烂！肯定有办法从其中一堵墙穿过去。

english: Once you've run out of Prayer Points, you'll need to restore them before you can use any prayers again. Prayer Points can be restored at an altar. To find an altar, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 一旦你的祈祷点数用完，就需要先恢复它们才能再次使用任何祈祷。祈祷点数可以在祭坛恢复。要找到祭坛，只需在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: Various materials can be spun into yarn or string using a spinning wheel. To find a spinning wheel, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 各种材料都可以用纺车纺成纱线或绳子。要找到纺车，只需在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: For that, I'd suggest you talk to Captain Harlan. He's the local expert on combat. You'll find him just north of the castle, outside the General Store.
translation: 关于这个，我建议你去和哈兰队长谈谈。他是本地战斗方面的专家。你可以在城堡北面、杂货店外面找到他。

english: Yes, I have a spare one here.
translation: 是的，我这里正好有一个备用的。

english: Mostly alone. He liked his privacy. He'd always be happy to get a bottle or two out if he did have visitors though. He'd always insist on me or my father having at least one drink with him if we visited.
translation: 大多是一个人。他喜欢清静。不过要是有客人来，他总是乐意拿出一两瓶酒来。我们要是去拜访，他总会坚持让我或我父亲至少陪他喝一杯。

english: Well, when it comes to murder, there are a few things we generally look at. First, there's the body itself. Determining the cause of death is a good start for any investigation.
translation: 嗯，说到谋杀，我们一般会关注几件事。首先是尸体本身。确定死因是任何调查的良好开端。

english: If you find yourself needing a weapon, I do have a few spares. Alternatively, you might want to buy one or make one yourself. The local blacksmith might be able to help with that.
translation: 如果你发现自己需要武器，我确实有几把备用的。或者，你也可以买一把或自己做一把。当地的铁匠也许能帮上忙。

english: Fine. Your farm rubbish anyway. You so rubbish you not even got rid of weird not-sheep outside.
translation: 行吧。反正你的农场很垃圾。你太垃圾了，连外面那只奇怪的假羊都没弄走。

english: You find murder funny?
translation: 你觉得谋杀很好笑？

english: Could you remind me where those stolen goods were seen?
translation: 你能再提醒我一下那些赃物是在哪里被看到的吗？

english: Spinning yarn is normally the best place to get started. It's nice and simple. Simply bring the relevant material to a spinning wheel like the one I have here, and away you go.
translation: 纺纱通常是入门的最佳选择。它简单又好上手。只要把相应的材料带到像我这里这样的纺车旁，就可以开始了。

english: Yes, best plan. You get yourself magic stick. Take one from dead magic woman, or maybe guard man help. Then we kill last thief. Other goblins see him down in graveyard.
translation: 对，最好的计划。你去弄根魔法棍。从死掉的魔法女人身上拿一根，或者也许守卫男人能帮忙。然后我们杀掉最后一个盗贼。其他哥布林在墓地里看到他。

english: Person in a hood.
translation: 一个戴兜帽的人。

english: Other than that, there isn't much advice to give! No doubt you'll end up learning a few extra useful bits over time, but the art of firemaking is very much a nice and straightforward one.
translation: 除此之外，也没什么好多说的了！毫无疑问，随着时间推移你会学到一些额外有用的小技巧，但生火这门技艺本身非常简单直接。

english: To my uncle's south of Hosidius, but... is that it? You're not going to do anything else?
translation: 去我叔叔那儿，在霍西迪乌斯城以南，但是……就这样？你不打算再做点别的了？

english: Indeed. Melee often works best against an opponent using ranged, ranged typically works best when fighting an opponent using magic, and magic is normally the best option when fighting someone using melee.
translation: 确实如此。近战对付使用远程的对手往往最有效，远程通常在对抗使用魔法的对手时最有效，而魔法通常是对抗使用近战的对手时的最佳选择。

english: Of course! However, there is a price for a cape like this. It will cost you 99,000 coins.
translation: 当然可以！不过这样的披风是有代价的。需要花费你99,000枚金币。

english: You seem upset. What's wrong?
translation: 你看起来很难过。怎么了？

english: That's right. Not that your boss seemed very happy about it.
translation: 没错。不过你的上司似乎对此不太高兴。

english: Cutter Meets Justice!
translation: “切割者”伏法！

english: Okay. Me behind you.
translation: 好。我跟着你。

english: That, combined with the lovely decoration on the wall, and the way the victim's been dismembered... Well, it doesn't paint a good picture...
translation: 再加上墙上那可爱的装饰，以及受害者被肢解的方式……嗯，这可不是什么好画面……

english: Greetings, adventurer! I see that you're new here. My name is Phileas, but people often call me the Lumbridge Guide. I'm always happy to give out tips to budding adventurers. Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 你好，冒险者！我看你是新来的。我叫Phileas，不过人们常叫我仑桥镇向导。我总是很乐意给初出茅庐的冒险者提供建议。有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: An axe please.
translation: 请给我一把斧头。

english: A lot of the time, you'll find yourself gathering or producing something. You can then sell those things, or keep them and use them yourself.
translation: 很多时候，你会发现自己是在采集或生产某些东西。然后你可以把这些东西卖掉，或者留着自用。

english: Right then... Thanks for all of your help with those thieves, adventurer. Here's your half of the bounty, along with some lamps that I think you'll find useful. All the best!
translation: 那么……感谢你帮忙对付那些盗贼，冒险者。这是你那份赏金，还有一些我觉得你会用得上的灯。祝你好运！

english: We don't have a choice. You need to get out of here, get over to Captain Jensen's house and then investigate whatever has happened there.
translation: 我们别无选择。你得离开这里，赶到Jensen船长的房子，然后调查那里发生的一切。

english: Thanks. This is very unusual...
translation: 谢谢。这太不寻常了……

english: Don't worry, flotsam never stays away from this island for very long. Yep, there it is!
translation: 别担心，漂浮物从来不会离开这座岛太久。对，它来了！

english: 'The Cutter', whose real name was Joseph Banks, was executed after a lengthy trial, presided over by Judge Jack Holland.
translation: “切割者”真名Joseph Banks，在经过漫长的审判后被处决，审判由法官Jack Holland主持。

english: Ahoy there. It be a nice day for fishing.
translation: 嗨，你好啊。今天是个钓鱼的好日子。

english: Look. Nasty human over there. Kill time now.
translation: 看。那边有个讨厌的人类。现在是杀的时候了。

english: Arrr! Don't mention it.
translation: 啊哈！不用客气。

english: So prayers are specifically a Saradomin thing?
translation: 所以祈祷是萨拉多明专属的东西？

english: It's not good, Sergeant. The killer has struck again!
translation: 情况不妙，中士。杀手又出手了！

english: Okay, there's clearly a story here.
translation: 好吧，这里面显然有故事。

english: You can't inspect the victim's head as it has been completely removed.
translation: 你无法检查受害者的头部，因为它已被完全移除。

english: Monlum gives you a bronze pickaxe.
translation: Monlum给了你一把青铜镐。

english: No, but I'll let you know once I've learnt more.
translation: 还没有，但等我了解更多后会告诉你的。

english: Actually, I'll be back later.
translation: 其实，我晚点再来。

english: Hey! Get out of here!
translation: 嘿！滚出这里！

english: Stupid human. You meant to use fancy magic.
translation: 愚蠢的人类。你本来该用花哨的魔法。

english: We no even rob you! You be nice, or you never get back things that we no rob.
translation: 我们根本没抢你！你放客气点，不然你永远拿不回我们没抢的东西。

english: No one acting suspicious at all? Or even just someone you didn't recognise?
translation: 完全没有人行为可疑？或者哪怕是你没见过的人？

english: Surely there must be someone?
translation: 肯定有某个人吧？

english: So, would you like to buy one? They cost 10000 gold each!
translation: 那么，你想买一个吗？每个要10000枚金币！

english: There are all sorts! Mithril, adamantite, runite... Shall I tell you about them?
translation: 种类可多了！秘银、精金、符文……要我给你讲讲吗？

english: Not like we are. I think for him it's more of a hobby. I seem to recall that he didn't always live around here. Shayzien is where he used to be from I think.
translation: 不像我们这样。我觉得对他来说这更像是个爱好。我好像记得他并不一直住在这附近。我想他以前是谢兹恩城那边的人。

english: Don't mention it. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 不用客气。那么，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: You flee one crime scene, arrive at another, then escape imprisonment, but now you expect me to listen to you? Why?
translation: 你逃离一个犯罪现场，又到了另一个，然后越狱，现在却指望我听你的？为什么？

english: Evil human! Mudfoot kill you now!
translation: 邪恶的人类！泥脚现在就杀了你！

english: Perhaps you'll get to the bottom of it faster with an extra pair of hands. I could be quite useful.
translation: 多一双手，也许你能更快查明真相。我可以帮上不少忙。

english: No? It's a very small house for two people. I wouldn't blame her if she'd got a bit sick of 'im.
translation: 没有？两个人住这房子可太小了。要是她有点受够了他，我也不会怪她。

english: Well... er... he didn't used to live 'ere all the time. I think this was his holiday home or somethin' like that. Then 'bout ten years ago he moved here permanently.
translation: 嗯……呃……他以前并不是一直住在这儿的。我想这是他的度假屋之类的。然后大约十年前，他永久搬到了这里。

english: We've recruited the help of [Player] who seems to be confident in taking on the horrors of the archive single-handedly. We have little choice at this stage, so let us hope they can hold this burden alone.
translation: 我们招募了[Player]的协助，此人似乎有信心独自应对档案库中的恐怖。现阶段我们别无选择，只能希望他们能独自承担这份重担。

english: Maybe his daughter killed him 'cause he was snoring too loud?
translation: 也许他女儿杀了他，因为他打呼噜太响了？

english: That there is, my child. I am from the nearby camp of peaceful monks. We spend our days dedicating ourselves to Saradomin, and sometimes spreading his teachings across the kingdom.
translation: 确实有，我的孩子。我来自附近一个和平僧侣的营地。我们终日献身于萨拉多明，有时也在王国各地传播他的教义。

english: No. Thank you, but I'd like some time alone. A quiet walk is the sort of thing I need. But...
translation: 不用了。谢谢你，但我想一个人待一会儿。安静地散散步正是我需要的。不过……

english: It was a long time ago, when I was just a child. My mother and sister were murdered, right here in Land's End, but they never found the killer...
translation: 那是很久以前的事了，那时我还是个孩子。我的母亲和姐姐被谋杀了，就在兰兹角村这里，但他们一直没找到凶手……

english: Okay... Good luck with that...
translation: 好吧……祝你好运……

english: In that case, could you give me some crafting tips?
translation: 那样的话，你能给我一些制作方面的建议吗？

english: Look, me have proof.
translation: 看，我有证据。

english: No, but given you've been rather busy yourself, I'm guessing you know everything anyway.
translation: 没有，但既然你自己也相当忙，我猜你反正什么都知道了。

english: Yes. Nasty humans try to frame innocent goblins. Me here to stop them. Me make them go dead.
translation: 对。讨厌的人类想陷害无辜的哥布林。我来阻止他们。我让他们死掉。

english: Me throw them hard. Harder me throw, more death happen.
translation: 我用力扔它们。扔得越用力，死得越多。

english: Hello there. Good day for farming, isn't it?
translation: 你好啊。今天是个务农的好日子，不是吗？

english: There's a reason why the Church of Saradomin is by far the largest religion in all these lands!
translation: 萨拉多明教会之所以是所有这些土地上最大的宗教，是有原因的！

english: I see... It seems H.A.M. are starting to become more problematic. That is unfortunate...
translation: 我明白了……看来H.A.M.开始变得越来越成问题了。真不幸……

english: What do you know about the victim?
translation: 你对受害者了解多少？

english: The conclusion? An illness. One so tragic, the surviving daughter never fully recovered. She spent years in care, but eventually her father decided to bring her home.
translation: 结论呢？一种疾病。悲惨到幸存的女儿从未完全康复。她在看护下度过了多年，但最终她父亲决定把她带回家。

english: So he's a farmer as well then?
translation: 那他也是个农夫了？

english: The last important thing to note is food. It's most likely that when it combat, you're going to take some damage. Make sure to have some food with you so that you can heal yourself.
translation: 最后要记住的重要一点是食物。战斗时你很可能会受到一些伤害。一定要随身带些食物，以便治疗自己。

english: And what about you?
translation: 那你呢？

english: Very well. What about you, adventurer? Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 很好。那你呢，冒险者？有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Certificate of Membership
translation: 会员证书

english: Pretty much! You'll definitely pick up a few extra bits as you become more experienced, but on the whole, it really is nice and simple.
translation: 差不多就是这样！随着经验增长，你肯定会学到一些额外的小技巧，但总的来说，它确实简单又好上手。

english: Well, I'm the steward here at Lumbridge Castle. It's my job to make sure the Duke has everything he needs to keep things running smoothly.
translation: 嗯，我是仑桥镇城堡这里的管家。我的职责是确保公爵拥有一切所需，让一切顺利运转。

english: Then you've got your domestic violence. An argument breaks out between the victim and someone close to them and it spirals out of control. It's by far the most common type of murder we see.
translation: 然后还有家庭暴力。受害者和亲近的人之间爆发争吵，然后失控。这是我们见过的最常见的一类谋杀。

english: People like them... the only reason they get away with the things they do is because people like you stand by and let them!
translation: 像他们那样的人……他们之所以能逍遥法外，唯一的原因就是像你这样的人袖手旁观、放任他们！

english: With good reason!
translation: 有充分的理由！

english: Was your uncle a big drinker?
translation: 你叔叔很爱喝酒吗？

english: Hmm... Well if it makes Betty feel better, then fine. Feel free to have a look around the house. Just don't go messing up any evidence.
translation: 嗯……好吧，如果这能让贝蒂好受些，那就行。你随意在房子里看看吧。只是别弄乱任何证据。

english: Well, thank you for the offer, but we've got this in hand.
translation: 嗯，谢谢你的好意，但这件事我们已经掌控了。

english: Most towns have one. The one here in Lumbridge is on the roof of the castle.
translation: 大多数城镇都有一个。仑桥镇这里的那个在城堡屋顶上。

english: For mining, you'll want to head to a mine like the one south of Lumbridge and mine some ores with a pickaxe. You can either sell the ores for money, or smelt them into bars.
translation: 至于采矿，你得去一个矿场，比如仑桥镇南边的那个，用镐子挖些矿石。你可以把矿石卖掉换钱，或者把它们熔炼成锭。

english: Ah, I don't have enough space to carry it. Never mind.
translation: 啊，我没有足够的空间携带它。算了。

english: Very well. Good luck, adventurer
translation: 很好。祝你好运，冒险者

english: Look! There she is!
translation: 看！她在那儿！

english: Maybe someone new passing through and acting suspicious, or something like that.
translation: 也许是某个路过的新面孔，行为可疑，或者类似的情况。

english: Yes! They go north towards that windmill. Me go grab poker and meet sidekick there. You make sure you grab poker as well.
translation: 对！他们往北朝那座风车去了。我去拿根棍子，在那儿和搭档会合。你也一定要拿根棍子。

english: Do you have any tools I could have?
translation: 你有什么工具可以给我吗？

english: Hey, Betty. Is your uncle not around?
translation: 嘿，贝蒂。你叔叔不在吗？

english: Unfortunately, it doesn't seem you've really uncovered anything that will help us. Still, maybe your work will reassure Betty a bit. Now, it's time we started wrapping up here.
translation: 很遗憾，看来你并没有真正发现任何能帮到我们的东西。不过，也许你的努力能让贝蒂稍微安心一点。现在，我们该收尾了。

english: Inspect the legs.
translation: 检查腿部。

english: You don't need to be doing anything. We have everything in hand here.
translation: 你不需要做什么。这里一切都在我们掌控之中。

english: Could I have a hammer?
translation: 能给我一把锤子吗？

english: I could keep going, but I think you get the idea. In general, most skills are trained in specific locations, or using specific items. Gather what you need, head to where you need to go, then get to work.
translation: 我还可以继续说下去，但我想你已经明白了。总的来说，大多数技能都是在特定地点或使用特定物品来训练的。收集你需要的东西，前往你需要去的地方，然后开始干活。

english: But he stupid. He no have good god like goblins have Big High War God. His god have short attention span and only listen to one prayer at time. If me use spear and you use fancy magic, he can't stop both.
translation: 但他很蠢。他没有像哥布林那样有伟大的大神——大高战争神。他的神注意力很短，一次只听得进一个祈祷。如果我用长矛，你用花哨的魔法，他没法同时挡住两个。

english: Did you see or hear anything around the time of the murder?
translation: 谋杀发生前后，你看到或听到什么了吗？

english: Stupid human no listen. You need to do stab, not slash.
translation: 愚蠢的人类不听。你需要刺，不是砍。

english: Yes, we do good work making them dead. Me do good work especially, but human not bad either.
translation: 是的，我们干得不错，把他们弄死了。我干得尤其好，不过人类也不赖。

english: As for when I knew for sure, I had a strong hunch, but it was just that until you led us to her.
translation: 至于我什么时候确定的，我早有强烈的预感，但在你带我们找到她之前，那也只是预感而已。

english: Rude. Me no want go through stupid gate anyway.
translation: 无礼。反正我也不想穿过那扇愚蠢的大门。

english: You don't look like you need any help, then. What about you, adventurer?
translation: 那看来你不需要任何帮助了。你呢，冒险者？

english: Yes, ranger. Other goblins tell me rangers die best when you hit them up close. That what me do. Go close and big smack.
translation: 是的，射手。其他哥布林告诉我，射手在你近身攻击时死得最痛快。我就是这么干的。靠近，狠狠一击。

english: In that case, let's head over there. It's not safe for you to travel alone, so we'll go together.
translation: 那样的话，我们就去那儿吧。你独自赶路不安全，所以我们一起去。

english: With a role like that, I'm guessing there are no shortages of possible suspects?
translation: 有这样的身份，我猜可能的嫌疑人应该不少吧？

english: Okay... Just, please don't take too long.
translation: 好吧……只是，请别花太长时间。

english: What kind of goals should I be aiming for?
translation: 我应该以什么样的目标为目标？

english: The combat triangle isn't the only thing to consider when taking on a foe. The way that you're attacking is also important. Take melee for example. You have crushing attacks, slashing attacks and stabbing attacks.
translation: 对付敌人时，战斗三角并不是唯一要考虑的事。你攻击的方式也很重要。以近战为例。你有粉碎攻击、砍击攻击和刺击攻击。

english: Me no understand. Why no work?
translation: 我不明白。为什么没用？

english: Food can be cooked on either a fire or a range, but you'll be less likely to burn things on a range. To find a range, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 食物可以在火堆或炉灶上烹饪，但在炉灶上你不太容易把东西烧焦。要找炉灶，只需在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: Old man.
translation: 老人。

english: I'm not sure, but it seems they want us to translate the letter. They're clearly intentionally leaving clues for how to do so.
translation: 我不确定，但看来他们想让我们破译这封信。他们显然在故意留下如何破译的线索。

english: Well... This one is going to have some paperwork to deal with...
translation: 唉……这一桩得处理一些文书工作了……

english: Sounds like a job for me. What do you know about these thieves?
translation: 听起来这活儿适合我。关于这些盗贼，你都知道些什么？

english: Anyway, when those goblin friends of yours told you that melee works best against a ranger, that's what they were referring to.
translation: 总之，当你那些哥布林朋友告诉你近战对付射手最有效时，他们指的就是这个。

english: She lives in Port Piscarilius now.
translation: 她现在住在皮斯卡里琉斯港。

english: Yes... Do it.
translation: 好……动手吧。

english: I found this knife under your bed...
translation: 我在你床下发现了这把刀……

english: Of course it was me. Who else could it have been?
translation: 当然是我。还能是谁？

english: No... Was just sayin', I was...
translation: 不……我只是在说，我……

english: Hello again, adventurer, Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 又见面了，冒险者，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Die, human, die!
translation: 死吧，人类，死吧！

english: What kind of mystery?
translation: 什么样的谜团？

english: Aye, I do have one spare.
translation: 是啊，我确实有一把备用的。

english: This true. Food make you feel better if you get hit, but me never get hit, so me never need food.
translation: 这是真的。食物能让你挨打后感觉好些，但我从不挨打，所以我从不需要食物。

english: No. It seems things might not be as simple as we first thought. I'll let you know once I've learnt more.
translation: 不。看来事情可能不像我们最初想的那么简单。等我了解更多后会告诉你的。

english: Feel free to use my furnace or anvil any time you like. I should warn you though, my anvil is getting a bit old. I've found it's only good enough for smithing with bronze these days.
translation: 你随时可以随意使用我的熔炉或铁砧。不过我得提醒你，我的铁砧有点旧了。我发现如今它只够用来锻造青铜了。

english: You take the letter from under the body.
translation: 你从尸体下取出了信件。

english: You're not doing a very good job...
translation: 你干得可不怎么样……

english: Betty doesn't seem to feel that way. She doesn't think you care.
translation: 贝蒂似乎不这么觉得。她认为你并不关心。

english: The bed looks noticeably fancier than any of the other furniture. You notice a carving at the bottom of it: 'We shape the stone. The stone shapes us.'
translation: 这张床明显比其他任何家具都要精致。你注意到床底有一处雕刻品：'我们塑造石头。石头塑造我们。'

english: Me killing you.
translation: 我在杀你。

english: Business must be slow if you're running a butchers in a quiet place like this. Especially given you don't seem to have much product around...
translation: 在这么安静的地方开肉铺，生意一定很冷清吧。尤其是你周围似乎没多少货……

english: If the raid scale is solo:
translation: 如果突袭规模为单人：

english: There's a good chance we've found them ourselves already, but let's hear them.
translation: 我们很可能已经自己找到了，但还是听听吧。

english: Oh I very much did. That's why one of the first things I did was look into the death of your mother and sister. The investigation into their deaths was quite thorough...
translation: 哦，我当然在意。所以我最先做的事情之一就是调查你母亲和妹妹的死因。对她们死亡的调查相当彻底……

english: You look fancy.
translation: 你看起来挺讲究的。

english: Okay... And why are you killing me?
translation: 好吧……那你为什么要杀我？

english: There is. The greater benefits of praying are only granted to those who show their dedication to Saradomin.
translation: 有的。祈祷的更大益处只赐予那些向萨拉多明展示虔诚的人。

english: To learn more about Woodcutting, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 要了解更多关于伐木的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: Right, regarding these thieves... You said that your goblin friend wasn't able to kill them?
translation: 好，关于这些盗贼……你说你的哥布林朋友没能杀掉他们？

english: Could you tell me about prayers?
translation: 能给我讲讲祈祷吗？

english: Could you give me some advice on catching fish?
translation: 能给我一些捕鱼的建议吗？

english: I guess I was just curious. Anyway, what are these benefits that come from prayers?
translation: 我猜我只是好奇。总之，祈祷能带来什么益处？

english: That means they've almost certainly revealed their location to us already. We just need to work out how they've done so. Given their love for symbols and ciphers, it's unlikely to be obvious.
translation: 这意味着他们几乎肯定已经向我们暴露了他们的位置。我们只需要弄清楚他们是怎么做到的。鉴于他们对符号和密码的喜爱，这不太可能显而易见。

english: I see. So, any tips for my investigation?
translation: 我明白了。那对我的调查有什么建议吗？

english: Heh! I don't keep it up here, do I? It's all down in the basement. I keep it there, that I do.
translation: 嘿！我可不把它放在这上面，对吧？全都在地下室里。我就放在那儿，没错。

english: Ah, well you'll want to make sure you have a ranged weapon then.
translation: 啊，那你可得确保自己有一把远程武器。

english: Could you run me through combat basics again?
translation: 能再给我讲讲战斗基础吗？

english: As it turns out, no. Mudfoot here is actually trying to deal with the thieves as well.
translation: 结果并不是。这里的泥脚其实也在对付那些盗贼。

english: How should I go about improving my skills?
translation: 我该如何提升我的技能？

english: Because he was a monster! For my entire childhood we lived in fear of him, until the day finally came when my mother decided enough was enough...
translation: 因为他是个怪物！我整个童年都在恐惧中度过，直到那一天终于到来，我母亲决定忍无可忍了……

english: Okay, but cook man just scared that me cook better than him.
translation: 好吧，但厨子只是害怕我做饭比他好。

english: H.A.M. will get rid of people like you!
translation: H.A.M.会除掉你这种人！

english: Saradomin be with you, stranger.
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，陌生人。

english: Not yet. Mudfoot seems to be having some... difficulties with that.
translation: 还没有。泥脚似乎在那方面遇到了一些……困难。

english: Anything you'd care to share?
translation: 有什么愿意分享的吗？

english: To learn more about Firemaking, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 要了解更多关于生火的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: Too right.
translation: 太对了。

english: Sorry, but I do need to keep an eye on you. Sergeant's orders.
translation: 抱歉，但我确实得盯着你。中士的命令。

english: Betty...
translation: 贝蒂……

english: You inspect the victim's legs. You don't find anything of note.
translation: 你检查了受害者的腿部。没有发现任何值得注意的东西。

english: Wrong. You dead now.
translation: 错了。你现在死了。

english: Okay... Just let me know when you're ready to go.
translation: 好吧……准备好出发时告诉我一声。

english: You... You'd do that?
translation: 你……你愿意这么做？

english: He is?
translation: 他是？

english: What's a good way to make money?
translation: 有什么赚钱的好办法？

english: And did you know him well?
translation: 你和他熟吗？

english: Commissioner Edwards. He led the Shayzien Constabulary for years, until he stepped down a couple of years ago. This is where he retired to.
translation: 爱德华兹专员。他领导谢兹恩城警队多年，直到几年前卸任。他退休后就住在这里。

english: Magic? Me try that once. They say to cast spell you wave hands, but me just wave big hammer instead. Work just as good.
translation: 魔法？我试过一次。他们说施法要挥手，但我只是挥大锤子。效果一样好。

english: Well, let's hope we can explain that to them when they come to question us.
translation: 好吧，希望他们来盘问我们时，我们能解释清楚。

english: Hello there. I was wondering if I could ask you some questions?
translation: 你好。我想问几个问题，可以吗？

english: Mudfoot gives Captain Harlan the items from the General Store.
translation: 泥脚把杂货店的物品交给了哈兰队长。

english: Come on, adventurer, let's get you out of here. Corporals... get started on cleaning up here.
translation: 来吧，冒险者，我们带你离开这里。下士们……开始清理这里吧。

english: Whatever you decide, don't forget that you don't need to go carrying everything on you. You can store all of your items, including any goods you've gathered or made, in your bank.
translation: 无论你决定做什么，别忘了你不需要把所有东西都带在身上。你可以把所有物品，包括你收集或制作的货物，都存放在银行里。

english: Now, the first thing to know is that crafting is a bit of a catch-all term. When it comes to making things, you often have dedicated professions like smithing.
translation: 首先要知道的是，制作是个比较笼统的说法。说到制造东西，你常常有像锻造这样的专门职业。

english: I heard Juliet had died. Terrible business. Her cousin and I are getting on well though. Here, take this as thanks for your help.
translation: 我听说朱丽叶死了。真是可怕的事。不过我和她表亲相处得很好。来，收下这个，作为你帮忙的谢礼。

english: Then how did you know where the killer would be next?
translation: 那你怎么知道杀手接下来会在哪里？

english: A goblin? Is this the one responsible for the robbery, adventurer?
translation: 一个哥布林？这就是抢劫的罪魁祸首吗，冒险者？

english: The first one has been dealt with. We're now moving on to the second. Apparently, this one is a mage.
translation: 第一个已经解决了。我们现在转向第二个。据说这个是个法师。

english: Anything more specific?
translation: 还有更具体的吗？

english: The wardrobe is mostly empty. From the mess inside, it looks like some things were taken from it in a hurry. One of the things still in it is an old pair of Shayzien boots.
translation: 衣柜大部分是空的。从里面的凌乱来看，有些东西是被匆忙取走的。里面还留着的东西之一是一双旧的谢兹恩靴子。

english: What motivates you to do all of this?
translation: 是什么促使你做这一切？

english: Of course! It's nice and simple. All you need is an axe. Once you have one, just begin chopping a tree of your choice, and enjoy a plentiful supply of logs.
translation: 当然！既简单又轻松。你只需要一把斧头。有了斧头后，就开始砍你选的树，享受充足的原木供应吧。

english: THE RECIPE FOR A BETTER WORLD
translation: 创造更美好世界的食谱

english: I have a reward here for you, friend.
translation: 朋友，我这儿有一份奖励给你。

english: First, you've got your petty crime that gets out of hand. Thievery and the like. From time to time, a thief ends up biting off more than they can chew, and the victim fights back.
translation: 首先，是那些失控的小偷小摸。比如盗窃之类的。有时候，小偷会贪心过头，结果受害者奋起反抗。

english: Thank you. Talk to Sergeant Hudson. He's in charge of the investigation. You'll need his permission to help.
translation: 谢谢你。去找哈德森中士吧。他负责这次调查。你需要他的许可才能帮忙。

english: Mudfoot...
translation: 泥脚……

english: Right, that's the first one of those outlaws dealt with.
translation: 好，第一个亡命徒解决了。

english: You should know what this is... You investigated it. All those clues... and you still couldn't work it out.
translation: 你应该知道这是什么……你调查过它。那么多线索……你还是没能想明白。

english: You made it.
translation: 你来了。

english: I see... In that case, come. Let us discuss this further.
translation: 我明白了……既然如此，来吧。我们进一步谈谈这件事。

english: Is there any advice you could give me?
translation: 你有什么建议可以给我吗？

english: I don't think it was him, Sergeant. A hooded figure was spotted leaving the crime scene, literally just now!
translation: 中士，我觉得不是他。就在刚才，有人看到一个兜帽人离开了犯罪现场！

english: Buy an escape crystal for 10000 coins?
translation: 花10000金币购买逃脱水晶？

english: Hello, citizen. I hear you're going to be doing some investigating with us.
translation: 你好，市民。我听说你要和我们一起做些调查。

english: I... Thank you.
translation: 我……谢谢你。

english: My father, Jack. He's been murdered! The authorities are here, but they don't seem to care! I don't know what to do.
translation: 我父亲，杰克。他被谋杀了！当局的人来了，但他们似乎根本不在乎！我不知道该怎么办。

english: But me generous also. Maybe me let human join as sidekick. Human can learn thing or two from Mudfoot.
translation: 但我也很慷慨。也许我可以让人类当我的跟班。人类可以从泥脚身上学到一两招。

english: Now, would you like to be checked?
translation: 那么，你想接受检查吗？

english: That sounds... wonderful. Where do we begin?
translation: 听起来……太棒了。我们从哪儿开始？

english: Words to live by... Anything else we should grab before we do this?
translation: 真是至理名言……动手之前我们还要拿点什么吗？

english: See. We keep things safe. No touch them at all, apart from when Damptoes try to eat chisel, but he no do that again now. Eating chisel make him throw up and die.
translation: 看。我们把东西保管得好好的。完全不碰它们，除了湿脚趾想吃凿子那次，但他现在不会再那样了。吃凿子让他吐了，然后死了。

english: Okay, time to go now.
translation: 好了，该走了。

english: Hmm... Interesting...
translation: 嗯……有意思……

english: Once you've got your bars, you can then smith them into weapons and armour. To do so, just take a hammer and the bars to an anvil.
translation: 拿到锭之后，你就可以把它们锻造成武器和盔甲。要做到这一点，只需带着锤子和锭到铁砧旁即可。

english: You inspect the victim's torso. There's a single stab wound to the heart that is almost certainly the cause of death.
translation: 你检查了受害者的躯干。心脏处有一处刺伤，几乎可以肯定就是死因。

english: Hey, what are you writing?
translation: 嘿，你在写什么？

english: Wait, so it wasn't you goblins who robbed the General Store?
translation: 等等，所以抢劫杂货店的不是你们哥布林？

english: For example, with bread, you first need to make bread dough by combining flour and water. You can use a sink or other water source to fill things like buckets and jugs with water.
translation: 比如做面包，你首先需要把面粉和水混合成面包面团。你可以用水槽或其他水源把桶和壶之类的东西装满水。

english: But now, after all these years, it's finally over! They're finally dead! All that remains now, is you.
translation: 但现在，这么多年之后，终于结束了！他们终于死了！现在剩下的，就只有你了。

english: Would you like me to take you to Hosidius?
translation: 你想让我带你去霍西迪乌斯城吗？

english: What this is, is the two of you now being suspects in a murder investigation. You were spotted at a crime scene, and yet you chose not to report what happened there.
translation: 事情是这样的，你们俩现在是一起谋杀案的嫌疑人。有人看到你们出现在犯罪现场，可你们却选择不报告那里发生的事。

english: Thank you, but I'd better be going.
translation: 谢谢你，但我该走了。

english: Inspect the head.
translation: 检查头部。

english: Smorks go fastest!
translation: 斯莫克斯跑得最快！

english: So it's just you? Does that not cause any problems at all?
translation: 所以就你一个人？这不会造成什么问题吗？

english: Lack of new members apparently.
translation: 据说是因为缺少新成员。

english: No. We goblins innocent. We never rob, apart from all the other times when we did, but this not those times. This time we no do it.
translation: 不。我们哥布林是无辜的。我们从不抢劫，除了其他那些我们确实抢过的时候，但这次不是那些时候。这次我们没干。

english: Questions? Yes, I suppose so.
translation: 问题？是的，我想有吧。

english: When preparing ingredients to be cooked, water is sometimes needed. Containers such as buckets and jugs can be filled at various water sources. To find a water source, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 准备要烹饪的食材时，有时需要水。桶和壶之类的容器可以在各种水源处装满水。要找到水源，只需在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: Do you know why someone would want your uncle dead?
translation: 你知道为什么会有人想让你叔叔死吗？

english: Hello there, Zanik! How can I help?
translation: 你好啊，扎尼克！有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Thank you for rescuing Ernest. He left this lamp for you.
translation: 谢谢你救了欧内斯特。他留下了这盏灯给你。

english: Yes. Me going to be great goblin adventurer. Other goblins will call me Mudfoot the... good at quests.
translation: 对。我要成为伟大的哥布林冒险者。其他哥布林会叫我泥脚……擅长任务的那个。

english: Ah, yeah... *hic* Go on then.
translation: 啊，对……*嗝* 那好吧。

english: And what about you? Are you not going to help with the piecing everything together?
translation: 那你呢？你不打算帮忙把一切拼凑起来吗？

english: To learn more about Smithing, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 要了解更多关于锻造的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: And I think that covers pretty much everything. I'm sure you'll still learn an extra thing or two while out on your adventures though.
translation: 我想这基本上就涵盖了一切。不过我相信你在冒险途中还会学到一两样额外的东西。

english: Okay, just this once, sidekick can have full 500.
translation: 好吧，就这一次，跟班可以拿全额的500。

english: You could just buy some, though you might want to gather and cook it yourself instead. For help with the latter, you might want to speak to the cook in the castle.
translation: 你也可以直接买一些，不过也许你更想自己采集并烹饪。关于后者的帮助，你或许可以去找城堡里的厨师谈谈。

english: To learn more about Fishing, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 要了解更多关于钓鱼的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: I suppose this explains why they were trying to frame you.
translation: 我想这解释了为什么他们想陷害你。

english: Ah, yes. Your goblin friend said you should meet him up near the windmill, north of here. Don't forget to take an appropriate weapon as well. You'll want something that can stab, like a dagger or a shortsword.
translation: 啊，对。你的哥布林朋友说你应该去北边风车附近见他。别忘了也带上合适的武器。你需要能刺的东西，比如匕首或短剑。

english: She was a prime suspect from the start. Such is always the case when dealing with a murder. In the vast majority of cases, the killer and the victim know each other.
translation: 她从一开始就是头号嫌疑人。处理谋杀案时总是如此。在绝大多数案件中，凶手和受害者都认识彼此。

english: Mikasi gives you another ring.
translation: 米卡西又给了你一枚戒指。

english: Many weapons are capable of attacking with multiple styles, but in most cases, one style will be the preferred one. Take a scimitar for example. You can stab with it, but slashing is where it works best.
translation: 许多武器都能以多种方式攻击，但在大多数情况下，总有一种方式是首选。以弯刀为例。你可以用它刺，但劈砍才是它最擅长的。

english: Do you do anything else apart from checking?
translation: 除了检查之外，你还做别的事吗？

english: I'm looking for a quest to go on.
translation: 我在找一个可以做的任务。

english: Would he drink with others, or alone?
translation: 他会和别人一起喝酒，还是独自喝？

english: Ah, I do indeed.
translation: 啊，我确实有。

english: Do you have a spare ranged weapon?
translation: 你有多余的远程武器吗？

english: So she's a mage. That means we'll want to use ranged against her.
translation: 所以她是法师。这意味着我们得用远程对付她。

english: Yes, I'm aware. I meant 'well' as in 'familiar'.
translation: 是的，我知道。我说的“好”是指“熟悉”。

english: Well, there are a lot of different things you can cook, but I don't like to overcomplicate things myself too much...
translation: 嗯，你可以烹饪很多不同的东西，但我自己不太喜欢把事情搞得太复杂……

english: If needed, I can sort you out with a suitable weapon. Alternatively, the blacksmith should be able to sell you one, or give you some advice on making your own. Oh, and you should probably take some food as well.
translation: 如果需要，我可以给你弄一把合适的武器。或者，铁匠应该能卖你一把，或者给你一些自己制作的建议。哦，你大概还应该带些食物。

english: You can chop trees all over the world, provided you have an axe. You'll rarely have trouble finding a common tree, but to find rarer trees, look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 只要你有斧头，就可以在世界各地砍树。你很少会找不到普通的树，但要找更稀有的树，请在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: I hope you can, and you will very much get your chance to do so. Corporal, find a cell for them in the local guardhouse. We'll question them once we're done here.
translation: 我希望你能，而且你很快就会有机会的。下士，在本地警卫所给他们找个牢房。我们处理完这里的事就审问他们。

english: Thanks... So, what's next?
translation: 谢谢……那么，接下来呢？

english: Could I have another hood for mine?
translation: 能再给我一个兜帽吗？

english: Some are much rarer than others, and what you'll typically find is that the rarer the tree, the more expertise you need to chop it.
translation: 有些树比其他树稀有得多，你通常会发现，树越稀有，砍伐它所需的技能就越高。

english: As for specifics, I can't cover every skill, but I can give you a few tips for some of the more common ones.
translation: 至于具体细节，我无法涵盖每一项技能，但我可以就一些比较常见的技能给你几点提示。

english: I don't think it was her, Sergeant. A hooded figure was spotted leaving the crime scene, literally just now!
translation: 中士，我觉得不是她。就在刚才，有人看到一个兜帽人离开了犯罪现场！

english: Hello. You walk a lot.
translation: 你好。你走了很多路。

english: A tinderbox please.
translation: 请给我一个火绒盒。

english: Not from this world? You very much look like you are... You don't have any slime... or tentacles... What are you on about?
translation: 不是这个世界来的？你看起来明明就是……你身上没有黏液……也没有触手……你在说什么？

english: Arrr! Happy to have been of help.
translation: 啊哈！很高兴能帮上忙。

english: Well, you'd best start piecing it all together. We need to work out where the killer is. If we can't, then I needn't remind you that you're still the prime suspect.
translation: 那么，你最好开始把一切拼凑起来。我们需要弄清楚凶手在哪里。如果我们做不到，那我就不必提醒你，你仍然是头号嫌疑人。

english: 99,000 coins? That's too much for me.
translation: 99,000金币？对我来说太多了。

english: Nope. I was sleepin'. Guess that's what he's doing now, heh!
translation: 没有。我当时在睡觉。我猜他现在也在干这个，嘿！

english: What sort of materials should I use?
translation: 我应该用什么材料？

english: Shall we get started, Master?
translation: 我们开始吧，主人？

english: Never mind...
translation: 算了……

english: Now, I'd best get to work. We have a lot of tidying up to do. All the best, adventurer.
translation: 好了，我最好开始干活了。我们有很多东西要收拾。祝你好运，冒险者。

english: Maybe I should take a look around...
translation: 也许我该四处看看……

english: Ah, yes. How goes your hunt?
translation: 啊，是的。你的追捕进展如何？

english: Anyway, that's one for me to worry about. Shall we get you sorted out with your reward?
translation: 总之，那是我该操心的事。我们是不是该把你的奖励给你安排好了？

english: You inspect the victim's head. Both of his eyes have been removed.
translation: 你检查了受害者的头部。他的双眼都被挖走了。

english: Hello there! Anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好啊！有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: No, I don't *hic* think so. I didn't know him too well though.
translation: 不，我不*嗝*这么认为。不过我也不太了解他。

english: Church? Sorry, me thought this poo pile. That what it look like. Rubbish church for rubbish god.
translation: 教堂？抱歉，我还以为这是粪堆。它看起来就像。垃圾神配垃圾教堂。

english: I suppose so. He was always a big fan of wine.
translation: 我想是的。他一直是个葡萄酒的狂热爱好者。

english: While many archivists travelled the world, some remained behind in the Archive. This cape was given to recognise their work.
translation: 许多档案管理员周游世界，但有些人留在了档案馆。这件披风是为表彰他们的工作而授予的。

english: Different pieces of equipment have different stats, making them effective in different situations. You can view your equipment stats in the Worn Equipment panel.
translation: 不同的装备有不同的属性，使它们在不同情况下各有所长。你可以在已穿戴装备面板中查看你的装备属性。

english: Is there a good way for me to make sure I don't lose my faith?
translation: 有什么好办法能确保我不失去信仰吗？

english: He was advised against it. She was unpredictable. Sometimes even violent. But he insisted.
translation: 有人劝他不要这么做。她情绪不稳定，有时甚至会有暴力倾向。但他坚持己见。

english: Now, you should know that the benefits from praying are not freely given. It requires continued focus and faith to be able to use them.
translation: 现在，你应该知道祈祷带来的好处并非无偿给予。需要持续的专注和信仰才能使用它们。

english: Ha! Stupid thief pray to stop stabs, but he can't stop magic as well!
translation: 哈！愚蠢的盗贼祈祷挡住刺击，但他没法同时挡住魔法！

english: That's what I think, anyway.
translation: 反正我是这么认为的。

english: We've recruited the help of [Player] who seems to be confident in taking on the horrors of the archive single-handedly. We have little choice at this stage, so let us hope she can hold this burden alone.
translation: 我们招募了[Player]的帮助，她似乎有信心独自应对档案馆中的恐怖。现阶段我们别无选择，只能希望她能独自承担这份重担。

english: Er... Yeah...
translation: 呃……是啊……

english: You spend some time helping the Record Keeper study the Rondache.
translation: 你花了一些时间帮助记录保管员研究圆盾。

english: Anyway, I could be goin' on, but I'd just end up borin' ye'. Best thing to do is get out there and start fishin'. You'll quickly start learnin' more.
translation: 总之，我本可以继续讲下去，但那样只会让你觉得无聊。最好的办法就是出去开始钓鱼。你很快就会学到更多。

english: Yes, Betty told us that as well, but none of this gives us much to go on. As you said, he likely had multiple enemies. We need something more specific.
translation: 是的，贝蒂也这么告诉我们了，但这些都没给我们多少线索。正如你所说，他很可能有多个仇敌。我们需要更具体的东西。

english: We can't keep the authorities out of this, Betty. But... maybe I could take a look around first. I could at least make sure we know what happened before we speak to them.
translation: 我们不能把当局排除在外，贝蒂。但是……也许我可以先四处看看。至少我可以在和他们谈话之前弄清楚发生了什么。

english: Welcome to this church of holy Saradomin.
translation: 欢迎来到这座神圣的萨拉多明教堂。

english: It looks like you can't afford any crystals. They cost 10000 coins each.
translation: 看来你买不起任何水晶。每颗售价10000金币。

english: Oh, me like to do big crush best. That why me have big hammer.
translation: 哦，我最喜欢用大锤砸。所以我才有一把大锤子。

english: Look! He right there! We kill now!
translation: 看！他就在那儿！我们现在就杀了他！

english: You see, with the third kind of murder, the killer wants the victim dead. They plan for it, sometimes for months. They set out with the intention of ending someone's life.
translation: 你看，对于第三种谋杀，凶手想要受害者死。他们会为此策划，有时长达数月。他们一开始就抱着结束某人生命的意图。

english: What can you tell me about the victim?
translation: 你能告诉我关于受害者的什么信息？

english: Right, take this one to a cell. Make sure it's a bit more secure this time...
translation: 好，把这个带到牢房去。这次确保牢房更牢固一些……

english: Curious... Let me see if I can find a way inside.
translation: 奇怪……让我看看能不能找到进去的办法。

english: Sergeant, I know you don't trust me, but you have to believe me! I had nothing to do with any of this. I'm just trying to save Betty!
translation: 中士，我知道你不信任我，但你必须相信我！我和这一切毫无关系。我只是想救贝蒂！

english: Go there and see if you're right.
translation: 去那里看看你猜得对不对。

english: Stupid human no listen. You need to have weapon that do stab.
translation: 愚蠢的人类不听。你需要有能刺击的武器。

english: Did you see much of him?
translation: 你经常见到他吗？

english: Well... No, but this one could be particularly nasty. You see, there are generally three kinds of murder.
translation: 嗯……不，但这一起可能特别恶劣。你看，谋杀一般有三种。

english: *hic* Jack Holland! That was his name. Older *hic* chap. Lived here a long time with his daughter, Betty.
translation: *嗝*杰克.霍兰德！那是他的名字。年纪较大的*嗝*家伙。和他的女儿贝蒂在这里住了很久。

english: Well, I will not allow this ignominious incident to sully this otherwise resplendent day. Now, I beseech thee, be gone with alacrity. I wish to partake in beverages without the trouble of your presence.
translation: 好吧，我不会让这桩不光彩的事件玷污这原本灿烂的一天。现在，我恳求你，赶紧离开吧。我想在没有你打扰的情况下享用饮品。

english: Hmm... But me suppose you do good job. Me actually quite proud of sidekick. Not as proud as me am of me, but still close. One day you maybe be as good at quests as me.
translation: 嗯……但我觉得你干得不错。我其实挺为我的搭档感到骄傲的。虽然不如我为自己感到的骄傲，但也差不多了。总有一天你也许能像我一样擅长做任务。

english: Nasty human must be member of nasty group. Always calling goblins monsters. We no monsters... apart from maybe Dungface. He once kill chicken just because it lay egg on his foot.
translation: 讨厌的人类一定是讨厌组织的成员。总是叫哥布林怪物。我们不是怪物……也许除了粪脸。他曾经杀了一只鸡，就因为它在他的脚上下了个蛋。

english: Indeed, but the armour typically worn by a ranger is quite resilient to crushing attacks. You'll likely find you have better luck with a stabbing attack instead.
translation: 确实如此，但射手通常穿的盔甲对砸击攻击相当有抵抗力。你可能会发现改用刺击攻击效果更好。

english: Finlay gives you a small net.
translation: 芬利给了你一张小网。

english: He was important once. Put criminals away... or killed them.
translation: 他曾经是个重要人物。把罪犯关进监狱……或者杀掉他们。

english: So, would you like to be checked?
translation: 那么，你愿意接受检查吗？

english: Oh, a goblin... Hello there, goblin.
translation: 哦，一个哥布林……你好啊，哥布林。

english: No... We can't trust him! This kingdom is rotten to its core. It's the very thing my father spent so long fighting. We can't trust anyone of authority here.
translation: 不……我们不能信任他！这个王国已经烂到骨子里了。这正是我父亲花了那么长时间对抗的东西。我们不能信任这里的任何当权者。

english: Have you seen anything odd around here lately?
translation: 你最近在这附近见过什么奇怪的事吗？

english: Some. You yourself said that the killer has been toying with us from the get go. It seems they want to be found... or at least, they want to prove that we're not smart enough to find them.
translation: 有一些。你自己说过，凶手从一开始就在耍我们。看来他们想被找到……或者至少，他们想证明我们不够聪明，找不到他们。

english: Different attack options will also grant different types of XP. For example, some options will reward Attack XP when used, whereas others will reward Strength XP. Each attack option shows what XP will be given.
translation: 不同的攻击选项也会给予不同类型的经验值。例如，有些选项使用时给予攻击经验值，而另一些则给予力量经验值。每个攻击选项都会显示将给予什么经验值。

english: Uh, I'm kind of busy. Maybe another time.
translation: 呃，我有点忙。也许改天吧。

english: I see. Sounds like that's where I should start then.
translation: 我明白了。听起来那就是我该开始的地方。

english: Adventurer? You still have that goblin with you. What's going on?
translation: 冒险者？你还带着那个哥布林。怎么回事？

english: I'm sorry you feel that way. Will you at least allow me to arrange an escort to take you to your uncle's home?
translation: 很抱歉你有这种感觉。你至少能让我安排一个护卫送你到你叔叔家吗？

english: I do indeed. Would you like an axe, a tinderbox, or both?
translation: 我确实有。你想要一把斧头、一个火绒盒，还是两样都要？

english: Could you give me some mining advice?
translation: 你能给我一些采矿方面的建议吗？

english: These ancient capes were awarded to the archivists of this place. Today they are used to honour those who defend them.
translation: 这些古老的披风曾授予此地的档案管理员。如今它们被用来表彰那些守护此地的人。

english: Could you tell me more about Saradomin?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于萨拉多明的事吗？

english: Hmm... And if I do manage to work it out?
translation: 嗯……那如果我真的弄明白了呢？

english: Big religion?
translation: 大宗教？

english: Both parties panic in that situation, and it sometimes ends badly.
translation: 在这种情况下双方都会惊慌失措，有时结局会很糟。

english: Okay, me go. Goblins have better super secret pub anyway.
translation: 好吧，我走。反正哥布林有更好的超级秘密酒馆。

english: Stupid human. You meant to do far away hits.
translation: 愚蠢的人类。你本来想进行远程攻击。

english: Well... No. Sorry, but I don't have time. I hope it all works out for you though.
translation: 嗯……不。抱歉，但我没时间。不过我希望你一切顺利。

english: Betty said you were the one in charge of the investigation into her father's murder. I was wondering if I could help.
translation: 贝蒂说你是负责调查她父亲谋杀案的人。我想知道我能不能帮上忙。

english: Now, a little warning for ye' to consider: some fish be a bit tricker to catch than others. If ye' ain't skilled enough, then ye' won't be havin' any luck.
translation: 现在，给你提个醒：有些鱼比其他鱼更难钓。如果你技能不够，那就不会有任何收获。

english: So south east of here. Shall we get going?
translation: 所以就在这儿的东南方。我们出发吧？

english: You inspect the victim's arms. One of the hands has a fresh cut on it, suggesting the victim tried to fight back.
translation: 你检查了受害者的手臂。其中一只手上有新鲜的伤口，表明受害者曾试图反抗。

english: Thank you for the offer, but I think it would be best if you left the investigating to us this time.
translation: 谢谢你的好意，但我觉得这次最好还是把调查交给我们。

english: Like murder? Yup, that's our domain. Very cheery.
translation: 比如谋杀？没错，那是我们的领域。非常愉快。

english: Me no know. That why it mystery. Bye now.
translation: 我不知道。所以才叫谜团。再见。
