english: It all seemed a bit silly to me, but it kept them happy, at least... until the group closed down a few months ago.
translation: 这一切在我看来有点傻，但至少让他们开心了……直到几个月前这个团体解散了。

english: You inspect the victim's head. Beneath the helmet, there is a bruise on her forehead and her nose appears to be broken. However, this doesn't appear to have been the cause of death.
translation: 你检查了受害者的头部。头盔之下，她的额头有一块瘀伤，鼻子似乎也断了。然而，这似乎并不是死因。

english: No. You people can't protect me. I'll be better off on my own.
translation: 不。你们这些人保护不了我。我一个人会更好。

english: He doesn't normally lock them?
translation: 他平时不锁门吗？

english: Slender build.
translation: 身材纤细。

english: Yes... Me know all this already of course. Me just pretended not to so trusty human sidekick can do learning. Me know human afraid to ask for help.
translation: 是的……当然，这些我早就知道了。我只是装作不知道，好让可靠的人类搭档能学到东西。我知道人类害怕求助。

english: Okay. Me meet you back outside goblin house when you done.
translation: 好。你办完事后，我在哥布林屋外等你。

english: Did you learn anything of note at the other crime scenes?
translation: 你在其他犯罪现场有发现什么值得注意的东西吗？

english: But... if they're leaving clues, yet you don't have enough to translate the letter yet, that can only mean...
translation: 但是……如果他们留下了线索，而你们还不足以翻译那封信，那只能说明……

english: It was... It was you!
translation: 是……是你！

english: Nothing you can help me with.
translation: 你帮不上我什么忙。

english: Perhaps, but breaking out of here is going to make us look even more guilty!
translation: 也许吧，但从这里逃出去只会让我们显得更有罪！

english: It's not a problem... though I really am surprised you didn't already know about Saradomin...
translation: 没问题……不过我真的很惊讶你竟然不知道萨拉多明……

english: Then what is it you're not telling me?
translation: 那你有什么没告诉我的？

english: Ores can be smelted into bars at a furnace. To find a furnace, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 矿石可以在熔炉中冶炼成锭。要找到熔炉，只需在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: We work for the Shayzien Constabulary. It's part of the Shayzien Military. We investigate crimes all across the kingdom.
translation: 我们为谢兹恩城警队工作。它隶属于谢兹恩军队。我们调查整个王国的犯罪。

english: You must have interacted with each other quite a bit then in that time?
translation: 那段时间你们一定有过不少接触吧？

english: I'm afraid there's been a murder. Now please, move along. We need space to conduct our investigation.
translation: 恐怕发生了一起谋杀案。现在请让开。我们需要空间进行调查。

english: If you're sure... Take care of yourself, Betty. We'll be in touch soon.
translation: 如果你确定的话……照顾好自己，贝蒂。我们很快会联系你。

english: Arrr! Anyway, if ye' be wantin' to fish, just grab some suitable gear and head to the water. You'll be findin' fishing spots in seas and rivers alike.
translation: 啊哈！总之，如果你想钓鱼，只要拿上合适的装备到水边去。海洋和河流里都能找到钓鱼点。

english: The victim was once a judge and made a fair few enemies. It's possible one of them specifically targeted him. If so, it might not be the first time. Many years ago, his wife and daughter were killed as well.
translation: 受害者曾是一名法官，树敌不少。可能是其中一人专门针对他。如果是这样，这可能不是第一次。许多年前，他的妻子和女儿也被杀害了。

english: Inspect the blood.
translation: 检查血迹。

english: What is it, Corporal?
translation: 什么事，下士？

english: You never really cared! You people never do! This was all just a bit of fun to you. But now the fun is over...
translation: 你从来就没真正在乎过！你们这些人从来都是这样！这一切对你们来说只是好玩。但现在好玩的结束了……

english: Of course. It's not a problem.
translation: 当然。没问题。

english: Ah, you don't have enough space for me to give you a shortsword, or a shield to go with it.
translation: 啊，你没有足够的空间让我给你一把短剑，或者配一把盾。

english: Following the trial, Judge Holland announced that he now intends to pass on the baton of justice and retire.
translation: 审判结束后，霍兰德法官宣布他现在打算交出正义的接力棒并退休。

english: Thanks. I'd best get going.
translation: 谢谢。我最好走了。

english: That's right. What do you need?
translation: 没错。你需要什么？

english: What? We can't just stay here! Don't you see? They were already here when we arrived! They can't have known where we were going. Something bad must have happened! We need to find out what!
translation: 什么？我们不能就这么待在这里！你还不明白吗？我们到的时候他们就已经在这里了！他们不可能知道我们要去哪里。一定发生了什么坏事！我们得查清楚！

english: We'll continue our investigation back at the Shayzien Administration. We have some leads to explore and a person of interest to question further. We'll let you know if we learn anything.
translation: 我们会回到谢兹恩行政部继续调查。我们有一些线索要追查，还有一个嫌疑人要进一步审问。如果有发现，我们会通知你。

english: Are you Sergeant Hudson?
translation: 你是哈德森中士吗？

english: Of course, for that, you'll need the right weapon. As you've already noted, something like a warhammer works well for crushing, but if your aim is to stab, a weapon like a dagger or shortsword will work best.
translation: 当然，为此你需要合适的武器。正如你已注意到的，像战锤这样的武器很适合砸击，但如果你的目标是刺击，那么匕首或短剑之类的武器效果最好。

english: If it makes you feel better, your work did end up being useful. You found a couple of things we missed, and you did a good job piecing everything together.
translation: 如果这能让你好受些，你的工作最终确实派上了用场。你发现了几个我们遗漏的东西，而且你把所有线索拼凑得很好。

english: Excellent! Did you manage to work out why they did it?
translation: 太好了！你弄清楚他们为什么这么做了吗？

english: After that, there's searching the crime scene, or any other areas of interest. We look for anything the killer might have left behind, but also possible hints at a motive that could be hidden amongst the victim's possessions.
translation: 之后，就是搜查犯罪现场或其他任何值得注意的区域。我们寻找杀手可能留下的任何东西，同时也要留意可能隐藏在受害者物品中的动机线索。

english: Ah, you mean that blaspheming dissident! He is not someone worth knowing about, but alas, I have had the misfortune of interacting with him.
translation: 啊，你说的是那个亵渎神明的异见分子！他不值得认识，但唉，我曾不幸与他打过交道。

english: Alright, let's get going then.
translation: 好吧，那我们出发吧。

english: If you wish to investigate the crime scene, I won't stop you, but I'm not going to waste time telling you how to do it. I'm busy enough as it is.
translation: 如果你想调查犯罪现场，我不会阻止你，但我不会浪费时间告诉你怎么做。我已经够忙的了。

english: Other goblins say they see next thief by ruined building, west of shop. They say she use big stick that make air go magic.
translation: 其他哥布林说他们在商店西边的废墟旁看到了下一个盗贼。他们说她用一根大棍子让空气变得有魔法。

english: Alright there. Here for some mining?
translation: 你好啊。来采矿的吗？

english: I don't think it was them, Sergeant. A hooded figure was spotted leaving the crime scene, literally just now!
translation: 我觉得另有其人，中士。有人看到一个兜帽人刚刚离开犯罪现场，就在刚才！

english: You inspect the victim's legs. They are coated in blood and both feet have been removed.
translation: 你检查了受害者的双腿。上面沾满了血，两只脚都被砍掉了。

english: Could you give me some smithing advice?
translation: 你能给我一些锻造方面的建议吗？

english: Could you tell me more about prayers?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于祈祷的事吗？

english: To learn more about combat, see the guides for Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Magic, Prayer and Hitpoints in the Skills panel.
translation: 要了解更多关于战斗的信息，请参阅技能面板中攻击、力量、防御、远程、魔法、祈祷和生命值的指南。

english: Maybe he's downstairs... Wait here. I'll go have a look.
translation: 也许他在楼下……在这里等着。我去看看。

english: Alternatively, you could make or gather items to then sell on. For example, logs from woodcutting, ores from mining, weapons and armour from smithing... the list goes on.
translation: 或者，你也可以制作或收集物品来出售。例如，伐木得到的原木、采矿得到的矿石、锻造得到的武器和盔甲……这样的例子还有很多。

english: I'm looking into the murder that happened just up the road. I wanted to ask you a few questions.
translation: 我正在调查就在路那头发生的谋杀案。我想问你几个问题。

english: Running away from the house.
translation: 从房子里跑出来。

english: Many thanks. Now, the bounty was for 1,000 coins, so that's 500 coins each.
translation: 非常感谢。那么，赏金是1,000金币，所以每人500金币。

english: When did you realise?
translation: 你是什么时候意识到的？

english: You go to search the drawers and notice one is open. There is a dagger inside.
translation: 你去搜查抽屉，发现其中一个开着。里面有一把匕首。

english: However, it does require a trek up to Varrock, and the road isn't always the safest, so I'd only recommend making the journey once you're feeling comfortable.
translation: 不过，这需要长途跋涉到维洛克城，而且路上并不总是最安全的，所以我建议你等自己觉得有把握了再踏上这段旅程。

english: No goblins in the pub please!
translation: 酒馆里请不要带哥布林！

english: Yes, it would have been, but through your own choices, you made yourself a suspect as well. It's nothing personal, but that is the way of things I'm afraid.
translation: 是的，本来会是这样，但通过你自己的选择，你也让自己成了嫌疑人。这不是针对你个人，但恐怕事情就是这样。

english: Different styles of attack will work better against different types of opponent, but you'll need to make sure you have the right weapon for the job.
translation: 不同的攻击方式对不同类型的对手效果更好，但你需要确保自己有适合这项工作的武器。

english: Arrr! It be a fine hobby, and a useful craft to boot. Aye, me parrot concurs.
translation: 啊哈！这是个好爱好，也是一门有用的手艺。没错，我的鹦鹉也同意。

english: A traveller passing through reckons he saw some of those goblins on the other side of the river playing with them.
translation: 一个路过的旅行者说他看到一些哥布林在河对岸玩那些东西。

english: Well, first up, there are three types of combat: melee, ranged and magic. Melee uses close up weapons like swords and warhammers, whereas ranged uses things like bows, crossbows or throwing knives.
translation: 嗯，首先，战斗有三种类型：近战、远程和魔法。近战使用剑和战锤之类的近身武器，而远程使用弓、弩或飞刀之类的东西。

english: Sorry, but who are you?
translation: 抱歉，你是谁？

english: A better but slower option is to sell to specialist stores. For example, a blacksmith will most likely offer you a better price for weapons and armour, but won't accept any of your other goods.
translation: 一个更好但更慢的选择是卖给专业商店。例如，铁匠很可能会为武器和盔甲给你更好的价格，但不会收你的其他货物。

english: At this point, all manner of things. Once again, you are currently the prime suspect. I don't wish to share any more with you than I need to. If you wish to prove your innocence, the onus is on you.
translation: 到了这个地步，各种各样的事。再说一次，你目前是头号嫌疑人。我不想与你分享超出必要范围的信息。如果你想证明自己的清白，责任在你身上。

english: Given you're going into a fight, some food would be wise.
translation: 既然你要去战斗，带些食物是明智的。

english: I am attempting to do so right now.
translation: 我现在正试图这么做。

english: Sergeant Hudson? What is this?
translation: 哈德森中士？这是怎么回事？

english: Well, it's still a bit early to suggest too much. That said, this one doesn't look good.
translation: 嗯，现在下太多结论还为时过早。话虽如此，这起案子看起来不太妙。

english: Judge Holland, who recently suffered the tragic loss of his wife and eldest daughter, is being praised as a hero. Due to 'The Cutter's' dangerous threats, no other judge was brave enough to oversee the trial.
translation: 霍兰德法官最近不幸痛失妻子和长女，如今被誉为英雄。由于“切割者”的危险威胁，没有其他法官有勇气主持审判。

english: Sergeant Hudson departs.
translation: 哈德森中士离开了。

english: I see. Sounds like we have a plan then.
translation: 我明白了。听起来我们有计划了。

english: Betty?!
translation: 贝蒂？！

english: You inspect the victim's arms. Next to one of the hands is a half-drunk bottle of wine. Curiously, the fluid inside appears to have separated in a way that you wouldn't expect from wine.
translation: 你检查了受害者的手臂。其中一只手旁边有一瓶喝了一半的葡萄酒。奇怪的是，里面的液体似乎以某种葡萄酒不该有的方式分离了。

english: Do you have a pickaxe I could have?
translation: 你有镐子可以给我吗？

english: If you want to work with any other kind of metal, you'll need to find a better anvil. That shouldn't be too hard. For example, I know Varrock has plenty.
translation: 如果你想加工其他种类的金属，你需要找一个更好的铁砧。那应该不难。例如，我知道维洛克城有很多。

english: For example, if you want to use a crushing attack, you'll be wanting something like a mace or a warhammer, but if your aim is to stab, a dagger or shortsword will be what you'll need.
translation: 例如，如果你想使用砸击攻击，你会想要钉锤或战锤之类的东西，但如果你的目标是刺击，那么你需要的是匕首或短剑。

english: Now, to get started, you're going to want to get yourself some ore. You can either buy it or mine it yourself. If you do decide to mine it, the mine south of Lumbridge is a good place to start.
translation: 现在，要开始的话，你需要弄到一些矿石。你可以购买，也可以自己开采。如果你决定自己开采，仑桥镇南边的矿场是个不错的起点。

english: He's... He's...
Magic is a little different. It's an innate ability, so doesn't actually need any weapons at all. That said, your spells will work better if you channel them using a staff.
translation: 魔法有点不同。它是一种与生俱来的能力，所以实际上完全不需要任何武器。话虽如此，如果你用法杖引导法术，效果会更好。

english: Like the Betty case? No, just a few robberies gone wrong in Piscarilius.
translation: 像贝蒂那起案子？不，只是皮斯卡里琉斯城几起出了岔子的抢劫案。

english: Aye! To get mining, just grab yourself a pickaxe and find some suitable rocks. There are lots of different types. Here for example we've got tin and copper rocks.
translation: 没错！要开始采矿，只需拿一把镐子，找些合适的岩石。岩石有很多不同的种类。比如这里，我们有锡矿石和铜矿石。

english: I see. And what about different weapon types?
translation: 我明白了。那不同的武器类型呢？

english: You still have that goblin with you. Have you worked out what's going on yet.
translation: 你还带着那个哥布林。你弄清楚发生什么事了吗？

english: That's not too surprising and doesn't actually narrow things down much. He knew a lot of people, and would remember a lot more from his past.
translation: 这并不太令人意外，实际上也没能缩小多少范围。他认识很多人，而且从他的过去中还能想起更多。

english: Do you know why it closed?
translation: 你知道它为什么关闭吗？

english: Do you know anything about the person who lives in this house?
translation: 你知道住在这所房子里的人的情况吗？

english: As I say, spinning yarn is just one of the many things you can do when it comes to crafting. I can't help too much with the others, but in time, I'm sure you'll end up learning more yourself.
translation: 正如我所说，纺纱只是制作中你能做的众多事情之一。其他方面我帮不上太多忙，但假以时日，我相信你自己会学到更多。

english: You inspect the victim's legs. The shoes are covered in dirt.
translation: 你检查了受害者的双腿。鞋子上沾满了泥土。

english: Hello there. Could I ask you some questions about the recent murder?
translation: 你好。我能问你几个关于最近那起谋杀案的问题吗？

english: Prayers are powerful passive abilities that you can activate to give you an advantage in combat. You can activate and deactivate prayers from within the Prayer panel.
translation: 祈祷是强大的被动能力，你可以激活它们来在战斗中获得优势。你可以在祈祷面板中激活和停用祈祷。

english: You seem to have a goblin with you. Is he one of them?
translation: 你似乎带着一个哥布林。他是他们中的一员吗？

english: Greetings, adventurer. Captain Harlan, leader of the Lumbridge Guard, at your service. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好，冒险者。仑桥镇守卫队长哈兰，听候差遣。有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

english: But why triangle?
translation: 但为什么是三角？

english: Did anything come from questioning that butcher?
translation: 审问那个屠夫有什么收获吗？

english: We've recruited the help of [Player] who seems to be confident in taking on the horrors of the archive single-handedly. We have little choice at this stage, so let us hope he can hold this burden alone.
translation: 我们招募了[Player]的帮助，他似乎有信心独自应对档案馆中的恐怖。现阶段我们别无选择，只能希望他能独自承担这一重担。

english: I've found a few potential things of note, but nothing obvious that could lead us to the killer.
translation: 我发现了一些可能值得注意的东西，但没有能直接指向杀手的明显线索。

english: Do you have any fishing tools I could have?
translation: 你有什么钓鱼工具可以给我吗？

english: This can't be happening... This can't be happening!
translation: 这不可能发生……这不可能发生！

english: They plan to strike again... if they haven't already. Betty, we need to get you to safety. We need to go to Sergeant Hudson.
translation: 他们打算再次下手……如果他们还没动手的话。贝蒂，我们得把你带到安全的地方。我们得去找哈德森中士。

english: But you did know him?
translation: 但你确实认识他？

english: If you do decide to gather things yourself, there's a good spot for catching shrimp south of the graveyard, and there are plenty of cows around if you want some beef.
translation: 如果你决定自己收集东西，墓地南边有个抓虾的好地方，而且周围有很多奶牛，如果你想要牛肉的话。

english: On the topic of those logs, the kind you'll get will unsurprisingly depend on the tree you chop. Alongside the common tree, there are oak trees, willow trees and yew trees, just to name a few.
translation: 说到那些原木，你得到的种类自然取决于你砍的树。除了普通的树，还有橡树、柳树和紫杉树等等，仅举几例。

english: Mudfoot shows you a collection of items from the General Store.
translation: 泥脚给你看了一堆从杂货店拿来的物品。

english: How about you, adventurer?
translation: 你呢，冒险者？

english: They seem to be part of some sort of cipher. There was also a letter back at your home that had the same symbols on it.
translation: 它们似乎是某种密码的一部分。你家里还有一封信，上面也有同样的符号。

english: Once you have your raw meat, you just need to cook it. You can just use a fire, but you'll be less likely to burn things if you use a range like the one I have here.
translation: 拿到生肉后，你只需要把它煮熟。你可以直接用火，但如果你用像我这里这样的炉灶，烧焦东西的可能性会更小。

english: It can be anything really. Common examples including sorting out any repair work that needs doing on the castle itself, or indeed to any of the Duke's belongings.
translation: 其实什么都有可能。常见的例子包括处理城堡本身需要进行的任何修缮工作，或者公爵的任何物品。

english: Rocks?
translation: 岩石？

english: I see. Is there anything else I should know?
translation: 我明白了。还有什么我应该知道的吗？

english: This power will be ours!
translation: 这股力量将属于我们！

english: Ah, of course. Saradomin looks kindly upon his most devout followers, and is more than willing to provide them with powerful benefits.
translation: 啊，当然。萨拉多明眷顾他最虔诚的信徒，并非常乐意赐予他们强大的增益。

english: Yes, I've found a few things that might be of note, but the main one is that I found some symbols, just like the ones back at your home.
translation: 是的，我发现了一些可能值得注意的东西，但最主要的是我发现了一些符号，和你家里那些一模一样。

english: If you lead the Lumbridge Guard, where are the other guards?
translation: 如果你领导仑桥镇守卫，那其他守卫在哪？

english: You were seriously great when you defeated the Culinaromancer! I can't believe I nearly caused all of those people to be killed!
translation: 你击败烹饪大师的时候真是太厉害了！我简直不敢相信我差点害死所有那些人！

english: Not really much else to it, to be honest. Get some practice in though, and I'm sure you'll pick up and extra thing or two.
translation: 说实话，除此之外也没什么别的了。不过多练习练习，我相信你会学到额外的一两招。

english: Have you spoken to Sergeant Hudson yet?
translation: 你和哈德森中士谈过了吗？

english: I can't offer you much as thanks, but I do have an amulet here that might be useful to you.
translation: 我没什么能作为感谢给你的，但我这里有一个护身符，也许对你有用。

english: Don't you see? We can't trust him! We can't trust anyone! No. We need to work out what happened on our own.
translation: 你还不明白吗？我们不能相信他！我们不能相信任何人！不。我们得靠自己弄清楚发生了什么。

english: It seems they were trying to stir up trouble and frame the goblins for it. At least one of them was a H.A.M. supporter, or maybe a full member.
translation: 看来他们是想挑起事端，并嫁祸给哥布林。他们中至少有一个是H.A.M.的支持者，或者也许是正式成员。

english: Stupid human no listen. You need to do stab, not crush.
translation: 愚蠢的人类不听。你需要刺击，不是砸击。

english: Alternatively, they can offer you protection, stopping you from suffering any harm from certain kinds of attacks.
translation: 或者，它们可以为你提供保护，让你免受某些类型攻击的伤害。

english: That would be against procedure.
translation: 那会违反程序。

english: Thinking mode?
translation: 思考模式？

english: Betty...? What is this...?
translation: 贝蒂……？这是怎么回事……？

english: No. This is a very safe area. He never normally needs to.
translation: 不。这是一个非常安全的区域。他平时从来不需要锁。

english: Aye, I do have one spare, but it doesn't look like you need it, given you already have one on you.
translation: 没错，我确实有一把备用的，但看起来你不需要，因为你身上已经有一把了。

english: Metal bars can be smithed into weapons and armour at an anvil, provided you have a hammer. To find an anvil, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 只要有锤子，金属棒就可以在铁砧上锻造成武器和盔甲。要找到铁砧，只需在你的地图上寻找相关图标。

english: Absolutely! All you need is a tinderbox and some logs. You can get the logs by buying them or by chopping them yourself. Most logs can be burned, but rarer logs do require a bit more skill to light.
translation: 当然！你只需要一个火绒盒和一些原木。你可以购买原木，也可以自己砍。大多数原木都可以燃烧，但更稀有的原木确实需要更高的技能才能点燃。

english: Rocks can be mined at mining sites, provided you have a pickaxe. To find a mining site, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 只要有镐子，就可以在采矿点开采岩石。要找到采矿点，只需查看地图上相应的图标。

english: Other goblins say they see her by ruined building, west of shop.
translation: 其他哥布林说他们在商店西边的废墟旁见过她。

english: I see. What are your thoughts so far?
translation: 我明白了。你目前有什么想法？

english: Fine. Castle rubbish anyway.
translation: 好吧。反正也是城堡里的垃圾。

english: What a mess... Let's hope we can find something here that can lead us to the killer. I needn't remind you that if we can't, then you're still the prime suspect.
translation: 真是一团糟……希望我们能在这里找到能帮我们找到凶手的线索。不用我提醒你，如果我们找不到，你仍然是头号嫌疑人。

english: No, no, no! This can't be happening...
translation: 不，不，不！这不可能发生……

english: Useless corpses... Give me your strength!
translation: 没用的尸体……把你的力量给我！

english: The girl has just lost her father. Of course she's going to be emotional right now. She has nothing to fear though. We'll get to the bottom of this.
translation: 那女孩刚刚失去了父亲。她现在情绪激动是理所当然的。不过她没什么好怕的。我们会查明真相的。

english: Feoras gives you a hammer.
translation: Feoras给了你一把锤子。

english: Yes. That why me stick with spear. This good for us though. Goblins say human do big religion.
translation: 是的。所以我才用长矛。不过这对我们是好事。哥布林说人类搞大宗教。

english: You killed them?
translation: 你杀了他们？

english: Like I said, I am Count Check. I am a vampyre, from Morytania. I left there when I heard the terrible news and now I choose to spend my days warning others of the perils that lay in wait for them.
translation: 就像我说的，我是检查伯爵。我是来自莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼。我听到那个可怕的消息后就离开了那里，现在我选择用我的日子来警告他人潜伏在身边的危险。

english: Right then... Let's get you sorted with your half of the bounty. Alongside the coins I promised, I also have some lamps here that I think you'll find useful. I just need you to make some space for them.
translation: 那好吧……让我来把你那份赏金结给你。除了我承诺的金币，我这里还有一些灯，我想你会发现它们很有用。我只需要你腾出一些空间来放它们。

english: For fishing, you can catch all kinds of fish at various fishing spots. You could just sell what you catch, but I'd suggest cooking them into food, which will also improve your cooking abilities.
translation: 至于钓鱼，你可以在各种钓鱼点钓到各种各样的鱼。你可以直接把钓到的东西卖掉，但我建议把它们烹饪成食物，这也会提升你的烹饪能力。

english: There is a large amount of blood on top of the drawers.
translation: 抽屉柜上有一大片血迹。

english: Stupid human. You meant to use fancy magic. Let me do close up hits.
translation: 愚蠢的人类。你本来想用花哨的魔法。让我来近身攻击。

english: Well, you don't need any help from me then. How about you, adventurer?
translation: 那么，你就不需要我的帮助了。你呢，冒险者？

english: Did you see or hear anything before your father's death?
translation: 在你父亲死前，你看到或听到什么了吗？

english: Zamorak fuels us!
translation: 扎莫拉克赐予我们力量！

english: Again!
translation: 再来！

english: So you can't think of any actual reason why someone would want him dead?
translation: 所以你想不出任何真正有人想让他死的理由？

english: Best I get to it then.
translation: 那我最好赶紧去办。

english: I see... Well, perhaps I can help you with your quest. I'm actually on a quest myself to find whoever robbed the General Store. Maybe we can work together?
translation: 我明白了……那么，也许我能帮你完成你的任务。其实我自己也在执行任务，要找出抢劫杂货店的人。也许我们可以合作？

english: You inspect the victim's arms. You don't find anything of note.
translation: 你检查了受害者的手臂。你没有发现任何值得注意的东西。

english: There's been a murder. No need to worry though, we're here to get to the bottom of it.
translation: 发生了一起谋杀案。不过不用担心，我们来这里是为了查明真相。

english: Humans silly anyway. They no consider powerful hero like Mudfoot! Me on quest to stop all the nasty humans.
translation: 人类反正很愚蠢。他们不把像泥脚这样强大的英雄放在眼里！我正在执行任务，要阻止所有可恶的人类。

english: And the three together make up the combat triangle?
translation: 这三种合起来就构成了战斗三角？

english: They're not wrong though. We did fail to report a murder to them.
translation: 不过他们说得没错。我们确实没有向他们报告谋杀案。

english: Okay. Me meet you back outside windmill when you done.
translation: 好。你办完后，我们在风车外面见。

english: Get this monster away from me!
translation: 把这个怪物从我身边弄走！

english: That's the door open. No sign of your uncle though...
translation: 门打开了。不过没看到你叔叔的踪影……

english: Loss for you. Goblins way better than humans.
translation: 那是你的损失。哥布林可比人类好多了。

english: Actually, I don't want either.
translation: 其实，我两个都不想要。

english: If the raid scale is duo+:
translation: 如果突袭规模为双人及以上：

english: An odd acting butcher who has no produce, yet did have a blood-covered knife hidden under his bed. Does that not seem a bit suspicious?
translation: 一个行为古怪的屠夫，没有任何货物，床下却藏着一把沾满血的刀。这难道不显得有些可疑吗？

english: Sergeant Hudson! Sergeant Hudson!
translation: 哈德森中士！哈德森中士！

english: Well, I do know a bit about crafting. I'm sure I can teach you a thing or two...
translation: 嗯，我确实懂一点制作。我相信我能教你一两招……

english: Okay, Mudfoot... We need to find whoever robbed the General Store. Where do we begin?
translation: 好吧，泥脚……我们需要找出抢劫杂货店的人。我们从哪里开始？

english: Okay. Me meet you back outside ruined building behind castle when you done.
translation: 好。你办完后，我们在城堡后面的废墟外面见。

english: 500? But me the boss. Human just trusty sidekick. Me should get more money. Bigger money too. Boss always bigger than sidekick, so money be bigger to match.
translation: 500？可我是老大。人类只是可靠的跟班。我应该拿更多钱。钱也要更大。老大总是比跟班大，所以钱也得更大才对。

english: And once we're ready, where do we find this mage?
translation: 那我们准备好之后，去哪里找这个法师？

english: Ah, yes. What about it?
translation: 啊，是的。关于它怎么了？

english: A little. Seen him picking berries before.
translation: 有一点。以前见过他采浆果。

english: Wise words.
translation: 至理名言。

english: No goblins allowed! Be gone with you!
translation: 哥布林禁止入内！滚开！

english: Ah, what ho! I am utterly astonished that you espied me! I did think myself to be executing a most remarkable ruse. Alas, it seems I have faltered in my attempt to blend in with the plebeian populace.
translation: 啊，你好啊！你竟然识破了我，真是让我大吃一惊！我本以为自己在执行一场极其出色的伪装。唉，看来我试图融入平民百姓的努力还是失败了。

english: Anyway, I think that covers everything you need to get started, though I'm sure you'll end up learning plenty more as you progress.
translation: 总之，我想这些已经涵盖了你入门所需的一切，不过我相信你在进步的过程中还会学到更多。

english: Any interesting ones?
translation: 有什么有趣的案子吗？

english: They can often fill in critical gaps in the evidence, but be careful. Even when not guilty, people have a habit of telling lies.
translation: 他们往往能填补证据中的关键空白，但要小心。即使无罪，人们也有说谎的习惯。

english: Absolutely! Smithing is the art of making weapons and armour from metal. While you can always buy the equipment you need from shops like mine, it's often beneficial to know how to make your own.
translation: 当然！锻造是用金属制作武器和盔甲的手艺。虽然你随时可以从我这样的商店购买所需的装备，但懂得如何自己制作往往很有好处。

english: You depart for Port Piscarilius with Betty.
translation: 你和贝蒂动身前往皮斯卡里琉斯港。

english: Why does it have blood on it?
translation: 为什么上面有血？

english: But that what me do. Me do the close up hit. Why no work?
translation: 可那就是我做的啊。我进行近身攻击。为什么没用？

english: Stupid humans should never have crossed Mudfoot the good at quests. Guard man will want to know about good job. He probably clap for us. Humans like clapping.
translation: 愚蠢的人类根本不该招惹擅长任务的泥脚。守卫会想知道这件好事的。他大概会为我们鼓掌。人类喜欢鼓掌。

english: I've found a few things, but I think there's still more to uncover.
translation: 我发现了一些东西，但我认为还有更多有待发掘。

english: We should go tell guard man that nasty thieves have gone dead.
translation: 我们该去告诉守卫，那些可恶的盗贼已经死了。

english: I regularly travel around here, sharing the word of our holy lord. That is what I am doing right now, in fact, and it was what I was doing when he came and confronted me.
translation: 我经常在这一带游历，传播我们神圣之主的教诲。事实上，我现在就在做这件事，他来找我对峙时我也正在做这件事。

english: Look, that him there!
translation: 看，他就在那里！

english: It okay though. This why human sidekick and me in charge.
translation: 不过没关系。这就是为什么人类跟班和我负责指挥。

english: Inspect the torso.
translation: 检查躯干。

english: But he couldn't allow that! He couldn't let her be free. That's why he poisoned her! Her and my sister!
translation: 但他不能允许那样！他不能让她自由。所以他毒死了她！她和我姐姐！

english: To learn more about Prayer, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 要了解更多关于祈祷的信息，请参阅技能面板中的指南。

english: I see. Did they have armour?
translation: 我明白了。他们有盔甲吗？

english: What...? How?!
translation: 什么……？怎么会？！

english: What motivates you?
translation: 是什么激励着你？

english: Oh... Hello. The name's Betty.
translation: 哦……你好。我叫贝蒂。

english: Captain Harlan gives you a bronze shortsword and a wooden shield.
translation: 哈兰队长给了你一把青铜短剑和一面木盾。

english: Please... let me help, Sergeant. We still have a chance to save Betty.
translation: 求你了……让我帮忙吧，中士。我们还有机会救贝蒂。

english: From the meat.
translation: 来自肉。

english: Inspect the arms.
translation: 检查手臂。

english: My faith protects me!
translation: 我的信仰保护着我！

english: What about you, adventurer? Anything I can do for you?
translation: 你呢，冒险者？有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

english: Well, from what a neighbour overheard, the killer was likely known to the victim.
translation: 嗯，根据一位邻居无意中听到的，凶手很可能认识受害者。

english: Take the letter?
translation: 拿走信件？

english: Yes... It was some special group Uncle Bernard was part of. Father was a member as well. I don't really know what it was all about. Something to do with self- betterment for the good of all, I think.
translation: 是的……那是伯纳德叔叔参与的某个特殊团体。父亲也是成员。我不太清楚那到底是干什么的。我想是跟为了大众利益而自我提升有关吧。

english: Have you found a way inside yet?
translation: 你找到进去的办法了吗？

english: What did he confront you about?
translation: 他为什么事找你对峙？

english: You are owed the following: 800 Cooking XP. 4,000 Crafting XP. 3,200 Firemaking XP. 1,000 Fishing XP. 5,700 Mining XP. 500 Runecraft XP. 2,500 Smithing XP. 2,500 Woodcutting XP. 2,000 Agility XP. 1,000 Farming XP. 1,000 Hunter XP.
translation: 你应得以下奖励：800点烹饪经验值。4,000点制作经验值。3,200点生火经验值。1,000点钓鱼经验值。5,700点采矿经验值。500点符石制作经验值。2,500点锻造经验值。2,500点伐木经验值。2,000点敏捷经验值。1,000点农业经验值。1,000点狩猎经验值。

english: That's the last of those thieves dealt with!
translation: 那些盗贼全都解决了！

english: What's this goblin doing in the castle? Remove it at once!
translation: 这个哥布林在城堡里干什么？立刻把它赶出去！

english: Symbols? What do they mean?
translation: 符号？它们是什么意思？

english: And you guys at the ones who investigate things like this?
translation: 而你们就是调查这类事情的人？

english: If you need any more tips, you'll find plenty of people around here willing to lend you a hand. No doubt you'll end up finding a few other useful resources out there as well.
translation: 如果你还需要更多提示，这附近会有很多人乐意帮你一把。毫无疑问，你还会在外面找到一些其他有用的资源。

english: And you were living here back then as well?
translation: 那你当时也住在这里吗？

english: I see... I think I'll stick to a bow.
translation: 我明白了……我想我还是用弓吧。

english: You give Sergeant Hudson 1,500 coins and he gives you an amulet of sight in return.
translation: 你给哈德森中士1,500枚金币，他则给你一枚视野护身符作为回报。

english: I don't like this, Betty, but alright. I'll see if I can find a way out.
translation: 我不喜欢这样，贝蒂，但好吧。我去看看能不能找到出去的路。

english: And what is this quest you're on?
translation: 你正在做的这个任务是什么？

english: And you think that's what we're dealing with here?
translation: 你觉得我们这里面对的就是这种情况吗？

english: Until next time, adventurer,
translation: 下次再见，冒险者，

english: It happened in the night, so no one got a clear view, but a traveller passing through reckons he saw some of those goblins on the other side of the river playing with the stolen goods.
translation: 事情发生在夜里，所以没人看清，但一个路过的旅行者说他看到河对岸有些哥布林在玩那些偷来的东西。

english: Do any murders look good?
translation: 有哪起谋杀看起来是好事吗？

english: Yes, bow okay as well, but not as good as rocks. Maybe you use bow that first thief had, or maybe guard man tell you how to get one.
translation: 是的，弓也可以，但不如石头好。也许你可以用第一个盗贼的弓，或者守卫会告诉你怎么弄到一把。

english: There are quite a few, but the main thing I use my spinning wheel for is to make balls of wool.
translation: 有不少，但我用纺车主要做的是羊毛球。

english: But you never even cared!
translation: 可你根本就没在乎过！

english: You inspect the victim's arms. They are coated in blood and both hands have been removed.
translation: 你检查了受害者的手臂。上面沾满鲜血，两只手都被砍掉了。

english: Hello there, adventurer! Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 你好，冒险者！有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Oh, so I do.
translation: 哦，那我确实有。

english: I understand, and thank you.
translation: 我明白，谢谢你。

english: Have you heard of the Keystone Lodge?
translation: 你听说过基石会所吗？

english: No... But I did want to ask you some questions about the murder that happened up the road.
translation: 没有……但我想问你几个关于路上那起谋杀案的问题。

english: Well, hang on... What about the local butcher?
translation: 等等……那当地的屠夫呢？

english: What do you mean? 'If' I am a vampyre? Of course I am a vampyre! See my pale complexion, my teeth, my outfit... How could anyone doubt I am a true vampyre?
translation: 你什么意思？‘如果’我是吸血鬼？我当然是个吸血鬼！看看我苍白的肤色、我的牙齿、我的装扮……怎么会有人怀疑我是个真正的吸血鬼？

english: Search the drawers.
translation: 搜索抽屉柜。

english: You should complete the tasks in Lumbridge and Draynor so they're ticked off, then speak to me to be rewarded.
translation: 你应该完成仑桥镇和德雷诺的任务，把它们勾掉，然后来找我领取奖励。

english: Well, an adventurer like you may find them very useful in battle. They can make you stronger, letting you defeat powerful enemies with ease.
translation: 嗯，像你这样的冒险者可能会发现它们在战斗中非常有用。它们能让你更强壮，让你轻松击败强大的敌人。

english: That good. Walking a lot stop you being fat.
translation: 那很好。多走路就不会变胖。

english: Yup. I've been runnin' me butchers here for a long time. A long time indeed...
translation: 没错。我在这儿经营肉铺很久了。确实很久了……

english: Who is the victim, Corporal?
translation: 受害者是谁，下士？

english: Fish can be caught at various fishing spots. To find a fishing spot, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 可以在各个钓鱼点钓鱼。要找到钓鱼点，只需在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: What now, Mudfoot?
translation: 现在怎么办，泥脚？

english: Woodcutting is much like mining. Just grab an axe, head to some trees, and chop away. You can then sell the logs, or burn them.
translation: 伐木和采矿很像。拿把斧头，找些树，砍就是了。然后你可以把原木卖掉，或者烧掉。

english: Well, that's what altars like the one in this church are for!
translation: 嗯，这座教堂里的祭坛就是干这个用的！

english: Ores can be mined at mining sites, provided you have a pickaxe. To find a mining site, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 只要有镐子，就可以在矿区采矿。要找到矿区，只需在地图上寻找相应的图标。

english: I've found some interesting things that you should know about.
translation: 我发现了一些你应该知道的有趣事情。

english: I guess I'll start over there then.
translation: 那我想我就从那边开始吧。

english: Yes, and right now you're the prime suspect.
translation: 是的，而眼下你就是头号嫌疑人。

english: Me parrot Percy on me shoulder!
translation: 我的鹦鹉珀西在我肩上！

english: Start the Mudfoot's Big Adventure quest?
translation: 开始“泥脚的大冒险”任务？

english: Here, citizen. I have this lamp for you.
translation: 给你，市民。这盏灯是给你的。

english: Don't mention it. If you need anything else, my partner should be over in the house. He might have some useful information for you.
translation: 不用客气。如果你还需要什么，我的搭档应该在屋里。他可能有些有用的信息给你。

english: From the letter they left in Land's End. I managed to translate it. They wanted us to know. They've been toying with us the whole time!
translation: 从他们留在兰兹角村的信里。我设法翻译了它。他们想让我们知道。他们一直在耍我们！

english: Well, there are also many different kinds of weapons, and different ways of using them. Take melee for example. You have crushing attacks, slashing attacks and stabbing attacks.
translation: 嗯，武器也有很多不同的种类，使用方式也各不相同。以近战为例。有粉碎攻击、劈砍攻击和刺击攻击。

english: Not yet. I'll keep working on it.
translation: 还没有。我会继续想办法。

english: Start The Writing's on the Wall quest?
translation: 开始“墙上的字迹”任务？

english: Well, melee often works best against an opponent using ranged, ranged typically works best when fighting an opponent using magic, and magic is normally the best option when fighting someone using melee.
translation: 嗯，近战通常对使用远程的对手最有效，远程通常在对抗使用魔法的对手时最有效，而魔法通常是对抗使用近战的对手时的最佳选择。

english: Hmm... I should go and get Mudfoot first.
translation: 嗯……我应该先去找到泥脚。

english: That it was Betty.
translation: 就是贝蒂。

english: Other goblins tell me about next thief. They say she carry big stick that make air go magic.
translation: 其他哥布林告诉我下一个盗贼的事。他们说她拿着一根大棍子，能让空气变得有魔法。

english: How? Betty, we're locked in a cell.
translation: 怎么逃？贝蒂，我们被锁在牢房里了。

english: Still, it's hardly proof of anything. We haven't found any real link between him and the victim, nor do we have any more information on the odd symbols.
translation: 不过，这算不上什么证据。我们没找到他和受害者之间任何真正的联系，也没有关于那些奇怪符号的更多信息。

english: I'll stay here. I can throw the guards off your scent if they find out you're gone. And if the killer is after me, I'll hopefully be a little bit safer here... for now at least.
translation: 我留在这里。如果他们发现你不见了，我可以帮你引开守卫。而且如果杀手是冲我来的，我留在这里或许会安全一点……至少暂时如此。

english: If it's any consolation, friend, I don't think you're guilty. Hopefully you understand that we can't be too careful though.
translation: 如果这能让你好受些，朋友，我不认为你有罪。希望你能理解，我们不能不谨慎。

english: Right, I think we've done all we need to here. Someone will be out soon to take care of your father's body. In the meantime, Betty, do you have anywhere else you can go?
translation: 好了，我想我们在这里该做的都做完了。很快就会有人来处理你父亲的遗体。在此期间，贝蒂，你还有别的地方可去吗？

english: Now, the thing about those first two is that the killer never sets out to kill someone. One thing leads to another and then there's a body on the floor. That's what's so dangerous about the third kind.
translation: 现在，关于前两种，关键在于凶手从未蓄意杀人。一件事引发另一件事，然后地上就多了一具尸体。这就是第三种之所以如此危险的原因。

english: Hang on! We can explain!
translation: 等等！我们可以解释！

english: Indeed. Anyway, meat is what I spend most of my time cooking. First up you need to gather the raw meat. I prefer to just buy it personally, but you can also gather it yourself.
translation: 确实。总之，肉是我大部分时间都在烹饪的东西。首先你需要收集生肉。我个人更喜欢直接买，但你也可以自己去收集。

english: Once you have some ore, you'll want to use a furnace, like this one here, to smelt it into bars.
translation: 拿到一些矿石后，你就需要用熔炉，比如这里的这个，把它冶炼成锭。

english: There are plenty of other things you can cook as well. You've got things like stews, pies, pizzas and more. They're all a bit much for me, but maybe at some point you'll learn how to cook them yourself.
translation: 还有很多其他东西你也可以烹饪。比如炖菜、派、披萨等等。这些对我来说都有点太复杂了，但也许将来你会学会自己做。

english: And in the meantime, the killer gets to remain loose?! What if they come back?! What if I'm next?!
translation: 而在此期间，凶手就可以逍遥法外？！要是他们回来怎么办？！要是下一个是我怎么办？！

english: You inspect the victim's torso. In spite of the armour she is wearing, there's a single stab wound to the heart that is almost certainly the cause of death. It looks like this was only possible due to the armour not actually being quite on properly.
translation: 你检查了受害者的躯干。尽管她穿着盔甲，但心脏处有一处刺伤，几乎可以肯定就是死因。看起来这之所以可能，只是因为盔甲其实并没有完全穿好。

english: Yes, that why me bring best ranged weapon of all: rocks.
translation: 是的，所以我才带来最好的远程武器：石头。

english: Smorks go faster!
translation: 斯莫克斯跑得更快！

english: Other goblins see man with bow go back across river from goblin house. We find him there.
translation: 其他哥布林看到拿弓的男人从哥布林屋那边过河回去了。我们在那里找他。

english: You need a big net to gather items from this flotsam.
translation: 你需要一张大网才能从这些漂浮物中收集物品。

english: A blood-covered knife? We missed that...
translation: 一把沾满血的刀？我们竟然漏掉了……

english: Could I have a weapon for stabbing?
translation: 能给我一把用来刺击的武器吗？

english: No, I don't think so. Everything has been nice and quiet.
translation: 没有，我想没有。一切都很平静。

english: Hmm... Shall we go and find that outlaw and try again?
translation: 嗯……我们要不要去找那个亡命徒再试一次？

english: Okay... sure... A parrot, on your shoulder.
translation: 好吧……行吧……一只鹦鹉，在你肩上。

english: Surely you must know of Saradomin? He is the god of all that is good in this world! A bastion of order and peace against Zamorak and other gods of evil!
translation: 你肯定听说过萨拉多明吧？他是这世上一切善良之物的神！是秩序与和平对抗扎莫拉克和其他邪恶之神的堡垒！

english: Hopefully not, but we can't rule anything out at this point.
translation: 希望不会，但目前我们无法排除任何可能。

english: What we leave behind is not as important as how we've lived.
translation: 我们留下的东西，不如我们如何活过重要。

english: Come on then, let's get over there.
translation: 那就走吧，我们过去。

english: So here you are.
translation: 你来了。

english: I take it you saw the message left in that cell? Betty is missing!
translation: 我猜你看到牢房里留下的信息了？贝蒂不见了！

english: Ha! You scared of goblin? Stupid human is stupid wimp.
translation: 哈！你怕哥布林？愚蠢的人类是愚蠢的胆小鬼。

english: You search the shelves and find various bottles of wine. You notice one of the bottles has an inscription on it: 'We shape the stone. The stone shapes us.'
translation: 你搜索了架子，找到各种瓶子装的酒。你注意到其中一个瓶子上刻着字：‘我们塑造石头。石头塑造我们。’

english: I can sort you out with a suitable weapon if needed, adventurer. Alternatively, the local blacksmith should be able to sell you one, or give you some advice on making your own.
translation: 如果需要，我可以给你弄一把合适的武器，冒险者。或者，当地的铁匠应该能卖你一把，或者给你一些自己打造的建议。

english: Me try hit them with big hammer, but it no work.
translation: 我试着用大锤子打他们，但没用。

english: Yes, reward good. Me also give back stolen items. Me take good care of them. Nothing missing at all. Me check two times.
translation: 是的，奖励很好。我也把偷来的东西还回去。我好好保管它们。一点都没少。我检查了两次。

english: Well, there are no guarantees of course, but it will definitely improve your odds.
translation: 嗯，当然没有保证，但这肯定会提高你的胜算。

english: Oh! No not really. He was a *hic* private sort. Never looked happy really. Probably could have done with having a bit of wine.
translation: 哦！不，不算熟。他是个*嗝*喜欢独处的人。看起来从没开心过。也许喝点酒会好一些。

english: Yes, the armour of a ranger.
translation: 是的，射手的盔甲。

english: We shape the stone.
translation: 我们塑造石头。

english: Yes, be warned! The travellers of these lands face danger! I've left my vampyric ways behind me, and now I spend my days letting everyone know of this!
translation: 是的，小心！这些土地上的旅人会面临危险！我已经抛弃了吸血鬼的作风，现在我把日子都用来让所有人知道这件事！

english: However, I would say we have enough reason to take him in for questioning. I'll have the corporals arrange it...
translation: 不过，我想我们有足够的理由带他回去问话。我会让下士们安排……

english: You translated the letter? Curious...
translation: 你翻译了那封信？有意思……

english: The same weapon can be used in multiple ways. You can use the attack options in the Combat Options panel to select how you want to use your currently equipped weapon.
translation: 同一把武器可以有多种用法。你可以使用战斗选项面板中的攻击选项，来选择如何使用当前装备的武器。

english: Shall we go tell him then?
translation: 那我们去告诉他吧？

english: Thanks, I'll remember that if I see any warning signs.
translation: 谢谢，如果我看到任何警告标志，我会记住的。

english: Mudfoot departs.
translation: 泥脚离开了。

english: Do you know why someone would want your father dead?
translation: 你知道为什么会有人想杀你父亲吗？

english: It's... It's the former Commissioner.
translation: 是……是前任局长。

english: Anything else you can tell me about them?
translation: 关于他们你还能告诉我别的什么吗？

english: Arrr! The only thing I be havin' is a small net, but you're welcome to it.
translation: 啊哈！我只有一张小网，不过你尽管拿去。

english: Well, as it turns out, Mudfoot here is actually trying to deal with the thieves as well.
translation: 嗯，事实证明，这里的泥脚其实也在想办法对付那些盗贼。

english: Sorry, but I don't think I can help with that right now.
translation: 抱歉，我想我现在帮不上这个忙。

english: That I did! I was just pouring myself a bit of *hic* wine, when I heard someone shout something.
translation: 没错！我当时正给自己倒点*嗝*酒，就听到有人喊了句什么。

english: No, I wasn't here when it happened. I was doing some shopping up in Shayzien. Everything seemed normal when I left, but then I came back and I found him like... like that...
translation: 不，事发时我不在。我当时在谢兹恩城买东西。我离开时一切看起来都很正常，但等我回来，就发现他成了……那样……

english: Protection? From you? I know what you people are like. Father told me more than a few stories about the 'honourable' Shayzien Constabulary...
translation: 保护？就凭你？我知道你们这些人是什么德性。父亲给我讲过不少关于那些“正直的”谢兹恩城治安队的故事……

english: You show the knife to Lan.
translation: 你把刀拿给兰看。

english: My father used to be a judge you see. A lot of criminals would have considered him an enemy. Most likely one of them killed my family to get to him.
translation: 你知道，我父亲以前是法官。很多罪犯都会把他视为敌人。很可能是他们中的一个为了对付他而杀了我的家人。

english: You can, but it will cost you 1,500 coins.
translation: 可以，但需要花费1,500枚金币。

english: Hmm... Alright, where can we find her?
translation: 嗯……好吧，我们去哪儿能找到她？

english: You're lying!
translation: 你在撒谎！

english: Well, I suppose you could pray to other gods... but I don't know why you'd want to. What could any other god possibly offer that Saradomin does not already provide?
translation: 嗯，我想你也可以向其他神明祈祷……但我不明白你为什么会想这么做。其他神明能提供什么萨拉多明已经提供不了的东西呢？

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm Corporal Michael Breiman. I work with Corporal Campter and Sergeant Hudson.
translation: 很高兴见到你。我是迈克尔.布雷曼下士。我和坎普特下士以及哈德森中士一起工作。

english: No... I'll make my own way there... after I've properly said goodbye to my father.
translation: 不……我会自己过去……等我好好跟父亲道别之后。

english: Meaning they're using melee, so we need to use magic.
translation: 意思是他们用的是近战，所以我们需要用魔法。

english: You inspect the victim's head. His eyes are wide open and are looking towards the wall by the door.
translation: 你检查了受害者的头部。他双眼圆睁，正盯着门边的墙。

english: Now, that said, do bear in mind that the combat triangle isn't an absolute rule. It's a good starting point, but you will sometimes come across foes that don't follow it.
translation: 不过话说回来，请记住战斗三角并非绝对法则。它是一个很好的起点，但你有时会遇到不遵循它的敌人。

english: Cease this futile resistance!
translation: 停止这徒劳的抵抗！

english: Nope. I think he was some big important somebody up in Shayzien once, but that was a long time ago. By the end he was just a nobody. Forgotten. Just like the rest of us...
translation: 不知道。我想他以前在谢兹恩城是个什么大人物，但那是很久以前的事了。到最后他只是个无名小卒。被遗忘了。就像我们其他人一样……

english: Once we've done that, we present it to the Sergeant and he pieces it all together. He's caught more killers than you could count!
translation: 做完这些后，我们把它交给中士，由他把一切拼凑起来。他抓过的杀手多得数不清！

english: You're not planning to use me as bait, are you?
translation: 你不是打算拿我当诱饵吧？

english: Okay, me go now. Time to find new quest. Maybe me solve big mystery this time.
translation: 好，我现在走了。该去找新任务了。也许这次我能解开个大谜团。

english: There is nothing you need to do my friend, for I am the Doomsayer! I roam the world sensing danger.
translation: 我的朋友，你什么都不用做，因为我就是厄运预言者！我游历世界，感知危险。

english: Yes, sometimes...
translation: 是的，有时候……

english: If you pay your respects to the dead by burying their bones, you will very much gain his favour.
translation: 如果你通过埋葬死者的骨头来表达敬意，你就会大大获得他的眷顾。

english: A human helping a goblin? You're a disgrace!
translation: 一个人类帮哥布林？你真可耻！

english: Get up.
translation: 起来。

english: Me? Why? I tried to help you!
translation: 我？为什么？我试图帮过你！

english: Hmm... Very well, but the Corporal here will be keeping a very close eye on you.
translation: 嗯……好吧，但这里的下士会密切监视你。

english: Oh... you have a goblin with you... Er... What can I do for you?
translation: 哦……你带了个哥布林……呃……我能为你做什么？

english: Happy to have helped!
translation: 很高兴能帮上忙！

english: She mentioned H.A.M.
translation: 她提到了H.A.M.。

english: Well, like I say, this is a mostly peaceful town, so we don't have too many issues... though I suppose it is true that one or two problems do crop up from time to time...
translation: 嗯，就像我说的，这是个相当平静的镇子，所以我们没太多麻烦……不过我想确实偶尔也会冒出一两个问题……

english: Ah... Tell me... Mudfoot... have you heard of something called the combat triangle?
translation: 啊……告诉我……泥脚……你听说过一种叫战斗三角的东西吗？

english: Hello there, Zanik! You look like a strong fighter!
translation: 你好啊，扎尼克！你看起来像个强壮的战士！

english: It seems you know what you need to do next. Good luck, adventurer.
translation: 看来你知道接下来该做什么了。祝你好运，冒险者。

english: A goblin? Get out! Get out! Get out!
translation: 一个哥布林？滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！

english: Ahoy there, Zanik! You look like you know your hook from your bait!
translation: 嗨，扎尼克！你看起来对钓鱼很在行啊！

english: Hey, it's one of the goblins that robbed us. Get out!
translation: 嘿，这就是抢过我们的哥布林之一。滚出去！

english: The people you killed were innocent, Betty. No one is to blame for what happened to your mother and sister. You've just never been able to accept that.
translation: 你杀的人是无辜的，贝蒂。你母亲和妹妹的遭遇怪不得任何人。你只是一直无法接受这一点。

english: To learn more about Crafting, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 想了解更多关于制作的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: Maybe I could help you out with one of them?
translation: 也许我可以帮你处理其中一件？

english: He pray to his stupid god to help him. Means he protected. You do close up poke, he pray to stop close up poke. You do far away throw, he pray to stop far away throw.
translation: 他向他的蠢神祈祷求助。意思是他受到保护。你近身戳，他就祈祷阻止近身戳。你远程扔，他就祈祷阻止远程扔。

english: May Saradomin guide you.
translation: 愿萨拉多明指引你。

english: Hello there. Here to chop some trees? The wood is great for making fires.
translation: 你好啊。来砍点树吗？木材很适合生火。

english: Well, this is Kourend, so there's never any shortage of work to be doing. We've had three murders in the past couple of days alone.
translation: 嗯，这里是库兰德王国，所以从来不缺活干。光过去几天我们就已经有三起谋杀了。

english: Ah, well, with Lumbridge being a fairly peaceful town, the King requested the Duke send all able bodies up to help in Varrock instead. They have much greater need for guards up there.
translation: 啊，嗯，因为仑桥镇是个相当平静的镇子，国王要求公爵把所有能调派的人手都派去维洛克城帮忙。那边对守卫的需求大得多。

english: Well? No I don't think he *hic* is very well. Someone killed him!
translation: 怎么？不，我觉得他*嗝*身体不太好。有人杀了他！

english: Sorry, I was just joking.
translation: 抱歉，我只是开个玩笑。

english: Until next time, adventurer.
translation: 下次见，冒险者。

english: So me go get big poker, then nasty bow man die?
translation: 那我拿大戳子去，然后坏弓手就死了？

english: You choose to stand against me? Fall then.
translation: 你选择与我为敌？那就倒下吧。

english: So directly south of here. In that case, shall we get going?
translation: 那就是在这正南方。既然如此，我们出发吧？

english: That's right. He's the brains of the operation you see. I'm Corporal Sarah Campter. It's my job, along with my partner, to gather up any evidence and interview the witnesses.
translation: 没错。你知道，他是这次行动的智囊。我是莎拉.坎普特下士。我的工作，和我的搭档一起，是收集所有证据并询问证人。

english: We have things under control. That said, if you think you can contribute, you might want to speak to Sergeant Hudson. He's in charge here.
translation: 我们已经控制住局面了。话虽如此，如果你觉得自己能帮上忙，也许可以去找哈德森中士谈谈。他在这里负责。

english: You inspect the victim's torso. There's a single stab wound to the heart that is almost certainly the cause of death. You also spot a letter, hidden under the victim.
translation: 你检查了受害者的躯干。心脏处有一处刺伤，几乎可以肯定就是死因。你还发现受害者身下藏着一封信。

english: By following the clues, Betty. Isn't that what you wanted?
translation: 通过追踪线索，贝蒂。这不正是你想要的吗？

english: But you never once looked deeper! Don't you see? You're just as big a part of the problem as they were!
translation: 可你从来没有深入看过！你还不明白吗？你和他们一样，都是问题的一大部分！

english: Sometimes if I'm feeling adventurous, I'll make something like bread, or even a cake! For those kinds of things, you need to combine a few ingredients first, but then you just cook them as normal.
translation: 有时如果我来了兴致，我会做点像面包，甚至蛋糕之类的东西！做这类东西，你需要先混合几种原料，然后像平常一样烹饪就行了。

english: The stone shapes us.
translation: 石头塑造我们。

english: And? Surely you must have some thoughts by now?
translation: 然后呢？到现在你肯定有些想法了吧？

english: I'm Mikasi, the taskmaster for the Lumbridge & Draynor Achievement Diary.
translation: 我是米卡西，仑桥镇与德雷诺村成就日记的任务大师。

english: Ahahahaha! I am Count Check, the renowned expert on checking! Tell me... do you wish to be... checked?
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！我是检查伯爵，著名的检查专家！告诉我……你希望被……检查吗？

english: Take these spots here. Ye' can be usin' a small net to catch shrimps, or sometimes anchovies. Other spots though might be havin' different fish, and needin' different tools to catch 'em.
translation: 就在这些渔点这儿。你可以用小网捕虾，有时还能捕到凤尾鱼。不过其他渔点可能有不同的鱼，需要不同的工具才能捕到。

english: Oh... Very well.
translation: 哦……好吧。

english: What's the best way to get better at combat?
translation: 怎样才能最好地提升战斗能力？

english: Stupid human have no manners. You need learn to say please.
translation: 蠢人类没礼貌。你需要学会说请。

english: Patience. These things cannot be rushed.
translation: 耐心。这些事急不得。

english: No. Uncle Bernard wasn't like my father, working some dangerous job. Before he retired, he was just a clerical assistant. He spent his days filing papers! He wasn't even a proper member of the army!
translation: 不。伯纳德叔叔不像我父亲那样干着危险的工作。退休前，他只是个文书助理。他整天都在归档文件！他甚至都不是军队的正式成员！

english: Yes... I guess you're right.
translation: 是的……我想你说得对。

english: No. All it did was confirm what we already knew. He had no obvious motive, and a butcher being in possession of a knife isn't enough evidence to mean anything.
translation: 没有。只是证实了我们已知的情况。他没有明显的动机，而一个屠夫拥有刀并不足以说明任何问题。

english: You can't carry any more flotsam.
translation: 你无法携带更多漂浮物了。

english: But... your own father... Why?
translation: 可是……你自己的父亲……为什么？

english: Captain Harlan gives Mudfoot his half of the bounty.
translation: 哈兰队长把一半赏金给了泥脚。

english: So you can execute me in front of a cheering crowd? Or lock me in a cell to live the rest of my life with no sunlight and a diet of mouldy bread? No. This ends here!
translation: 好让你在欢呼的人群面前处决我？或者把我锁在牢房里，让我余生不见阳光、只吃发霉的面包？不。到此为止！

english: No. Every criminal in this kingdom would likely consider Edwards their enemy.
translation: 没有。这个王国里的每个罪犯很可能都会把爱德华视为敌人。

english: You can store your items in a bank. To find one, look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 你可以把物品存放在银行里。要找银行，只需在地图上寻找相关图标。

english: Do you know why someone would want the victim dead?
translation: 你知道为什么有人想置受害者于死地吗？

english: All of those thieves have been dealt with.
translation: 那些盗贼都已经解决了。

english: I'm afraid I've already given you some items recently. I only have so many available, so I can't go overboard. You'll have to come back in 25 minutes.
translation: 恐怕我最近已经给过你一些物品了。我手头只有这么多，所以不能给得太多。你得等25分钟后再来。

english: Now, I think it's time to bring this madness to an end. You're coming with us, Betty.
translation: 好了，我想是时候结束这场疯狂了。你得跟我们走，贝蒂。

english: Maybe... but... it surely can't be possible...
translation: 也许……可是……这肯定不可能……

english: Aye, that's the home of Bernard Holland. He's not the most social of people, but he's normally friendly enough. Always says hello when he heads out to tend to his onions.
translation: 是啊，那是伯纳德.霍兰的家。他不是最爱交际的人，但通常还算友好。他出门照料洋葱时总会打招呼。

english: Hey, that's my knife! I've been lookin' for that for a long while... A very long while indeed.
translation: 嘿，那是我的刀！我找它找了好久了……真的很久很久了。

english: An accomplice then... Sent here to cause a distraction for the killer so they could strike again.
translation: 那就是个同伙……被派来给杀手制造干扰，好让他们再次下手。

english: We'd better get to Shayzien right away. We need to tell Sergeant Hudson about this.
translation: 我们最好立刻赶去谢兹恩城。我们得把这件事告诉哈德森中士。

english: See you around, Mudfoot.
translation: 回头见，泥脚。

english: Anyway, I think that covers the basics. I'd say practice is the best way to learn more, though I'm sure there are plenty of other ways for you to learn as well.
translation: 总之，我想这些就是基础了。我得说练习是学习更多的最佳方式，不过我相信你还有很多其他学习途径。

english: Well, in truth, I'm not really sure. I think you've managed to reach a point where my advice isn't really going to be useful any more. I'd say it's all on you now.
translation: 嗯，说实话，我也不太确定。我想你已经到了我的建议不再真正有用的地步了。我得说，现在全靠你自己了。

english: Thank you. My uncle lives south of the city itself, just north west of the Tithe Farm. I'll meet you there.
translation: 谢谢。我叔叔住在城外南边，就在什一税农场西北方。我们在那儿见。

english: I shouldn't ask any more of you... but I just don't trust the authorities to see this through. Could you meet me at my uncle's house? I want to talk through everything a bit more.
translation: 我不该再麻烦你了……但我就是不相信当局能把这事查到底。你能在我叔叔家跟我碰面吗？我想再详细谈谈所有事情。

english: Wonderful! You have passed my checks!
translation: 太好了！你通过了我的检查！

english: Other goblins see three humans who dump robbed stuff. We find all humans and make them dead. First one was man with bow. Other goblins see him go back across river. We find him there.
translation: 其他哥布林看到三个人丢弃了赃物。我们找到所有人类，把他们弄死。第一个是拿弓的男人。其他哥布林看到他过河回去了。我们在那儿找到他。

english: Hmm... me not really need help. Me very good at quest...
translation: 嗯……我其实不需要帮忙。我很擅长做任务……

english: No one at all. I'm very good at remembering people. It's an important part of my work.
translation: 一个都没有。我很擅长记住人。这是我工作中很重要的一部分。

english: Someone new? We don't get many new people coming through here. We're nice and out of the way. Typically it's just people heading past to go to the Tithe Farm.
translation: 新面孔？我们这儿很少有新面孔经过。我们这儿又安静又偏僻。通常只是路过前往什一税农场的人。

english: Meditating? Stupid humans with stupid word for thinking hard. Be more like goblin. We never think hard.
translation: 冥想？蠢人类用蠢词来形容使劲想。学学哥布林吧。我们从不使劲想。

english: Oh, sorry, but we don't really want goblins in here...
translation: 哦，抱歉，但我们这儿真的不太欢迎哥布林……

english: He said I had no business spreading the word of Saradomin anywhere near his home. He said it was an affront to his order, whatever that means. He then threatened to get violent if I did it again!
translation: 他说我无权在他家附近任何地方传播萨拉多明的教义。他说这是对他教团的侮辱，不管那是什么意思。然后他威胁说如果我再这么做就动武！

english: Ah, yes. How goes your search?
translation: 啊，是的。你的调查进展如何？

english: Other goblins say this one great warrior, but not as great as me.
translation: 其他哥布林说这家伙是个伟大的战士，但没我伟大。

english: Could I have another amulet?
translation: 能再给我一个护身符吗？

english: The corporal escorts you and Betty to a cell in the nearby guardhouse.
translation: 下士将你和贝蒂押送到附近警卫室的一间牢房。

english: Normally the most reliable way is to sell things. As for where you get said things, you could collect items from dead foes. Goblins for example sometimes have a few things of note on them.
translation: 通常最可靠的办法就是卖东西。至于东西从哪来，你可以从死去的敌人身上收集物品。比如哥布林身上有时就带着些值得一提的东西。

english: Sergeant Hudson! We need to act fast! I think the killer is targeting a Shayzien leader!
translation: 哈德森中士！我们得赶快行动！我觉得杀手的目标是谢兹恩城的一位领袖！

english: Where to, Mudfoot?
translation: 去哪儿，泥脚？

english: Oh, don't worry. We'll be keeping a close eye on you... from a distance.
translation: 哦，别担心。我们会密切盯着你的……从远处。

english: It would have been nice of you to tell me...
translation: 你要是早点告诉我就好了……

english: Do you know anything about the person who lives in that house?
translation: 你知道住在那栋房子里的人的情况吗？

english: Ah, don't worry about him. He can be a bit short with people sometimes. It's how he is when he's in his thinking mode.
translation: 啊，别在意他。他有时候对人有点冷淡。他进入思考模式时就是这样。

english: Well, I do actually have a bounty available at the moment that you might be interested in. 1,000 coins to whoever can bring justice to some thieves that robbed the General Store.
translation: 嗯，其实我现在正好有个悬赏，你可能会感兴趣。谁能把抢劫杂货店的盗贼绳之以法，就能得到1,000枚金币。

english: To learn more about a specific skill, see the relevant guide in the Skills panel.
translation: 想了解更多关于某项技能的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: What about you, adventurer?
translation: 那你呢，冒险者？

english: Celebrations are being held all across the kingdom today, for the deadly killer known as 'The Cutter' has finally breathed his last.
translation: 今天王国各地都在庆祝，因为被称为“切割者”的致命杀手终于咽下了最后一口气。

english: Prayer XP is gained by burying bones. The higher your Prayer level, the more Prayer Points you will have available, and the more prayers you'll be able to use.
translation: 埋葬骨头可以获得祈祷经验值。你的祈祷等级越高，可用的祈祷点数就越多，能使用的祈祷也越多。

english: So, about those thieves...
translation: 那么，关于那些盗贼……

english: This certificate confirms that Bernard Holland is an honoured member of the Keystone Lodge.
translation: 本证书证明伯纳德.霍兰德是基石会所的荣誉会员。

english: I'd better be going.
translation: 我该走了。

english: But that was so long ago... Could they really have come back now?
translation: 可那是很久以前的事了……他们真的可能现在回来了吗？

english: You have a Jagex Account, and you have set a Bank PIN, so you pass Count Check's checks!
translation: 你拥有Jagex账户，并且设置了银行PIN码，所以你通过了检查伯爵的检查！

english: Oh... er... I think it was... 'You!'
translation: 哦……呃……我想是……“你！”

english: About that cape you're wearing...
translation: 关于你穿的那件披风……

english: You must be quite the handyman then?
translation: 那你一定是个相当能干的杂工了？

english: Triangle? Like roof?
translation: 三角形？像屋顶那样？

english: My father... he was good friends with a Shayzien captain, before they both retired. Captain Jensen is her name. She was one of the good ones. She can help us. I trust her.
translation: 我父亲……他退休前和一位谢兹恩城船长是好朋友。她叫詹森船长。她是好人之一。她能帮我们。我信任她。

english: Could you give me some advice on lighting fires?
translation: 你能给我一些生火的建议吗？

english: Not much compared to the bigger shops up in Varrock, but maybe something will still take your fancy. Why don't you take a look?
translation: 和维洛克城的大商店比起来不算什么，但也许还是有你中意的东西。为什么不看看呢？

english: A goblin? I don't think you should be in here...
translation: 一个哥布林？我觉得你不该待在这里……

english: Look! There she is! Time for kill!
translation: 看！她在那儿！该杀了！

english: The victim was seemingly killed by a stab wound to the heart, and it seems they were specifically targeted by the killer. Some sort of encoded message was left on them, and there were more symbols on the wall as well.
translation: 死者似乎是被刺中心脏而死的，而且看起来是杀手特意针对的目标。他们身上留下了某种加密信息，墙上还有更多符号。

english: To learn more about Cooking, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 想了解更多关于烹饪的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: Oh... I guess tha's okay...
translation: 哦……我想那没问题……

english: Can't those fools see what they're doing?! Something horrible is happening, and rather than doing anything about it, they just throw us in a cell instead!
translation: 那些蠢货难道看不出自己在干什么吗？！可怕的事情正在发生，他们不但什么都不做，反而把我们关进牢房！

english: Well, I do have one spare, but it doesn't look like you have room to carry it.
translation: 嗯，我确实有一个备用的，但看起来你没地方带了。

english: Me impossible to frame. Rattrap try it once, but he fail. Me too wriggly.
translation: 我是不可能被陷害的。捕鼠夹试过一次，但他失败了。我太滑溜了。

english: Fair enough. Just let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意就告诉我。

english: Fish can be caught at various fishing spots, provided you have the suitable equipment. To find a fishing spot, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 只要有合适的装备，就可以在各个钓鱼点钓鱼。要找到钓鱼点，只需在地图上寻找相关图标。

english: A cipher...? I don't understand. Why would the killer be doing this?
translation: 密码……？我不明白。杀手为什么要这么做？

english: Then, with a little help from his Keystone Lodge friends, he had it all covered up!
translation: 然后，在他基石会所朋友的些许帮助下，他把一切都掩盖了！

english: Arrr! The only thing I be havin' is a small net, but it looks like you already have one.
translation: 啊哈！我身上只有一张小网，但看起来你已经有一张了。

english: All that said, the best option is often the Grand Exchange. You can buy or sell pretty much anything there, and in many cases it's where you'll get the best prices.
translation: 话虽如此，最好的选择往往是大交易所。你在那里几乎可以买卖任何东西，而且很多时候能拿到最好的价格。

english: What's happening here? What's all the commotion?
translation: 这里发生什么事了？怎么这么吵？

english: For now, if you're feeling unsafe, I can arrange for you to have some protection.
translation: 目前，如果你觉得不安全，我可以安排人保护你。

english: Another nasty thief go dead!
translation: 又一个可恶的盗贼死了！

english: Weapon good. No steal one though. Stealing bad, as Mudfoot always say, apart from when it okay, which isn't now.
translation: 武器好。但不能偷。偷东西不好，就像泥脚常说的，除非可以偷的时候，但现在不行。

english: How goes it? You're the one doing some of your own investigating, right?
translation: 进展如何？你就是那个自己在调查的人，对吧？

english: I have a little something here for you, young one. Consider it a gift for slaying that demon.
translation: 小家伙，我这儿有点东西给你。就当是斩杀那个恶魔的礼物吧。

english: Both please.
translation: 两个都要。

english: Well, I suppose I have ended up learning a bit about crafting as part of this job.
translation: 嗯，我想我在做这份工作的过程中确实学到了一些制作方面的知识。

english: Could you give me some cooking advice?
translation: 你能给我一些烹饪建议吗？

english: Could you give me some advice on chopping trees?
translation: 你能给我一些砍树的建议吗？

english: To learn more about Mining, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.
translation: 想了解更多关于采矿的信息，请参阅技能面板中的相关指南。

english: Using prayers will drain your Prayer Points, with stronger ones draining Prayer Points faster than weaker ones. Your current Prayer Points are shown in the orb next to your minimap.
translation: 使用祈祷会消耗你的祈祷点数，较强的祈祷比较弱的消耗得更快。你当前的祈祷点数显示在小地图旁的宝珠中。

english: I don't know... The doors are locked, which is very odd...
translation: 我不知道……门锁着，这很奇怪……

english: Anyway, I'll let you get on with your investigation. If you need anything, just let me or my partner know. She should be outside somewhere.
translation: 总之，你继续调查吧。如果需要什么，告诉我和我的搭档就行。她应该在外面某处。

english: It seems things might not be as simple as we first thought. I'll let you know once I've learnt more.
translation: 看来事情可能不像我们最初想的那么简单。等我了解更多后再告诉你。

english: No goblins in the church please!
translation: 教堂里请不要有哥布林！

english: All manner of things, but none of them have led us to the killer yet.
translation: 各种各样的事，但都还没让我们找到杀手。

english: Pay 1,500 coins for an amulet of sight?
translation: 支付1,500枚金币购买一个视界护身符？

english: Both tin and copper are pretty common, but there are plenty of rarer rocks out there as well. In most cases, the rarer ones will take a bit more skill to mine.
translation: 锡和铜都很常见，但外面也有很多更稀有的岩石。大多数情况下，越稀有的岩石需要更高的技能才能开采。

english: Well, on that note, just one left to go. What do you know about the last thief?
translation: 那么，说到这个，只剩最后一个了。你对最后一个盗贼了解多少？

english: I promise you, we don't want a killer out there any longer than they need to be. We will find them, Betty. You have my word.
translation: 我向你保证，我们比谁都不想让杀手在外面多待一刻。我们会找到他们的，贝蒂。我向你保证。

english: Nope. He kept 'imself to 'imself. I like to do the same. It's nice an' peaceful here. No disturbances. You can get on with things without people botherin' you.
translation: 没有。他一直独来独往。我也喜欢这样。这里又安静又祥和。没有打扰。你可以安心做事，没人来烦你。

english: Well, maybe I could help. I could do some investigating of my own.
translation: 嗯，也许我能帮忙。我可以自己做一些调查。

english: Er... What is this?
translation: 呃……这是什么？

english: Me kill the nasty humans. Nasty humans rob other humans, but then they dump the stuff they rob here. Now we get blamed.
translation: 我杀可恶的人类。可恶的人类抢别人，然后把抢来的东西丢在这里。现在却怪我们。

english: Me on quest.
translation: 我在做任务。

english: Not one for talking?
translation: 不爱说话？

english: I said get up.
translation: 我说了，起来。

english: Could you give me some combat advice?
translation: 你能给我一些战斗建议吗？

english: Ah, I don't have enough on me. Never mind.
translation: 啊，我身上带的不够。算了。

english: It definitely looks that way. Our victim here was a bit of a public figure before he retired. I even remember hearing stories about him when I was a kid.
translation: 看起来确实如此。我们这位死者退休前算是个公众人物。我小时候甚至还记得听过关于他的故事。

english: A quest?
translation: 任务？

english: Look! That him!
translation: 看！就是他！

english: Good luck, adventurer.
translation: 祝你好运，冒险者。

english: I'd like to get rid of some of your warning signs.
translation: 我想清除你的一些警告标志。
